text: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
original: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
ai: Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One.

text: Abhidhammapiṭake
original: Abhidhammapiṭake
ai: In the Abhidhamma Piṭaka

text: Dhammasaṅgaṇīpāḷi
original: Dhammasaṅgaṇīpāḷi
ai: Dhammasaṅgaṇī

text: Mātikā
original: Mātikā
ai: Matrix

text: 1. Tikamātikā
original: 1. Tikamātikā
ai: 1. Triad Matrix

text: 1. (Ka) kusalā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) akusalā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) abyākatā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are good, bad, indeterminate.
original: (Ka) kusalā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) akusalā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) abyākatā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Wholesome states. ⤵ (Kha) Unwholesome states. ⤵ (Ga) Indeterminate states.

text: 2. (Ka) sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with pleasant feeling, painful feeling, neutral feeling.
original: (Ka) sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) States associated with pleasant feeling. ⤵ (Kha) States associated with painful feeling. ⤵ (Ga) States associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

text: 3. (Ka) vipākā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) vipākadhammadhammā. ⤵ (Ga) nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā.
rys_davids: States that are results; that have resultant quality; that are neither.
original: (Ka) vipākā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) vipākadhammadhammā. ⤵ (Ga) nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā.
ai: (Ka) Resultant states. ⤵ (Kha) States with resultant quality. ⤵ (Ga) States that are neither resultant nor have resultant quality.

text: 4. (Ka) upādiṇṇupādāniyā [upādinnupādāniyā (syā.)] dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anupādiṇṇupādāniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) anupādiṇṇaanupādāniyā [anupādinnānupādāniyā (syā.)] dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are grasped at and favourable to grasping; that are not grasped at but are favourable to grasping; that are neither.
original: (Ka) upādiṇṇupādāniyā [upādinnupādāniyā (syā.)] dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anupādiṇṇupādāniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) anupādiṇṇaanupādāniyā [anupādinnānupādāniyā (syā.)] dhammā.
ai: (Ka) States clung to and fit for clinging. ⤵ (Kha) States not clung to but fit for clinging. ⤵ (Ga) States neither clung to nor fit for clinging.

text: 5. (Ka) saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā [asaṃkiliṭṭhāsaṃkilesikā (syā.)] dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are vitiated and vicious; that are not vitiated but are vicious; that are neither.
original: (Ka) saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā [asaṃkiliṭṭhāsaṃkilesikā (syā.)] dhammā.
ai: (Ka) States that are defiled and defiling. ⤵ (Kha) States that are not defiled but defiling. ⤵ (Ga) States that are neither defiled nor defiling.

text: 6. (Ka) savitakkasavicārā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) avitakkavicāramattā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) avitakkaavicārā [avitakkāvicārā (syā.)] dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have applied and sustained thinking; sustained thinking only; neither.
original: (Ka) savitakkasavicārā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) avitakkavicāramattā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) avitakkaavicārā [avitakkāvicārā (syā.)] dhammā.
ai: States with initial and sustained application ⤵ States with only sustained application ⤵ States without initial and sustained application.

text: 7. (Ka) pītisahagatā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) sukhasahagatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) upekkhāsahagatā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are accompanied by zest; by happiness; by indifference.
original: (Ka) pītisahagatā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) sukhasahagatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) upekkhāsahagatā dhammā.
ai: States accompanied by zest ⤵ States accompanied by happiness ⤵ States accompanied by equanimity.

text: 8. (Ka) dassanena pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are to be put away by vision; by culture; by neither.
original: (Ka) dassanena pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā.
ai: States to be abandoned by seeing ⤵ States to be abandoned by development ⤵ States to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development.

text: 9. (Ka) dassanena pahātabbahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā dhammā.
rys_davids: States, the moral roots of which are to be put away by vision; by culture; by neither.
original: (Ka) dassanena pahātabbahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā dhammā.
ai: States whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing ⤵ States whose roots are to be abandoned by development ⤵ States whose roots are neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development.

text: 10. (Ka) ācayagāmino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) apacayagāmino dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) nevācayagāmināpacayagāmino [nevācayagāmino nāpacayagāmino (syā.)] dhammā.
rys_davids: States going to building up; going to pulling down; going to neither.
original: (Ka) ācayagāmino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) apacayagāmino dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) nevācayagāmināpacayagāmino [nevācayagāmino nāpacayagāmino (syā.)] dhammā.
ai: States leading to accumulation ⤵ States leading to diminution ⤵ States leading neither to accumulation nor diminution.

text: 11. (Ka) sekkhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asekkhā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) nevasekkhanāsekkhā [nevasekkhānāsekkhā (sī. syā.)] dhammā.
rys_davids: States of one in training; of the adept; of one who is neither.
original: (Ka) sekkhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asekkhā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) nevasekkhanāsekkhā [nevasekkhānāsekkhā (sī. syā.)] dhammā.
ai: States of trainees ⤵ States of perfected ones ⤵ States of neither trainees nor perfected ones.

text: 12. (Ka) parittā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) mahaggatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) appamāṇā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are limited, sublime, infinite.
original: (Ka) parittā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) mahaggatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) appamāṇā dhammā.
ai: Limited states ⤵ Sublime states ⤵ Immeasurable states.

text: 13. (Ka) parittārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) mahaggatārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) appamāṇārammaṇā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have a limited object; a sublime object; neither.
original: (Ka) parittārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) mahaggatārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) appamāṇārammaṇā dhammā.
ai: States having a limited object ⤵ States having a sublime object ⤵ States having an immeasurable object.

text: 14. (Ka) hīnā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) majjhimā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) paṇītā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are base; of medium worth; excellent.
original: (Ka) hīnā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) majjhimā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) paṇītā dhammā.
ai: Inferior states ⤵ Middling states ⤵ Superior states.

text: 15. (Ka) micchattaniyatā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) sammattaniyatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) aniyatā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are of a wrongfulness fixed as to consequences; that are of a righteousness fixed as to consequences; that do not entail fixed consequences.
original: (Ka) micchattaniyatā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) sammattaniyatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) aniyatā dhammā.
ai: States fixed in wrongness ⤵ States fixed in rightness ⤵ Unfixed states.

text: 16. (Ka) maggārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) maggahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) maggādhipatino dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have the Path as object; whose moral root is the Path; whose dominant influence is the Path.
original: (Ka) maggārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) maggahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) maggādhipatino dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that have the path as object; ⤵ phenomena that have the path as root; ⤵ phenomena that have the path as predominant condition.

text: 17. (Ka) uppannā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anuppannā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) uppādino dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have arisen; that have not arisen; that are bound to arise.
original: (Ka) uppannā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anuppannā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) uppādino dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that have arisen; ⤵ phenomena that have not arisen; ⤵ phenomena that are bound to arise.

text: 18. (Ka) atītā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anāgatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) paccuppannā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are past; present; future.
original: (Ka) atītā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anāgatā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) paccuppannā dhammā.
ai: Past phenomena; ⤵ future phenomena; ⤵ present phenomena.

text: 19. (Ka) atītārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anāgatārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) paccuppannārammaṇā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have the past as their object; the present as their object; the future as their object.
original: (Ka) atītārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anāgatārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) paccuppannārammaṇā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that have a past object; ⤵ phenomena that have a future object; ⤵ phenomena that have a present object.

text: 20. (Ka) ajjhattā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bahiddhā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) ajjhattabahiddhā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that belong to one's self; are external to one's self; are belonging or external to one's self.
original: (Ka) ajjhattā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bahiddhā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) ajjhattabahiddhā dhammā.
ai: Internal phenomena; ⤵ external phenomena; ⤵ internal and external phenomena.

text: 21. (Ka) ajjhattārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bahiddhārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have for an object one's self; an object external to one's self; an object that is both.
original: (Ka) ajjhattārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bahiddhārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that have an internal object; ⤵ phenomena that have an external object; ⤵ phenomena that have an internal and external object.

text: 22. (Ka) sanidassanasappaṭighā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anidassanasappaṭighā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) anidassanaappaṭighā [anidassanāppaṭighā (syā.)] dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are visible and reacting; invisible and reacting; neither.
original: (Ka) sanidassanasappaṭighā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anidassanasappaṭighā dhammā. ⤵ (Ga) anidassanaappaṭighā [anidassanāppaṭighā (syā.)] dhammā.
ai: Visible and impinging phenomena; ⤵ invisible and impinging phenomena; ⤵ invisible and non-impinging phenomena.

text: Tikamātikā.
original: Tikamātikā.
ai: Triplet Matrix.

text: 2. Dukamātikā
original: 2. Dukamātikā
ai: 2. Duplet Matrix

text: Hetugocchakaṃ
original: Hetugocchakaṃ
ai: Root Cluster

text: 1. (Ka) hetū dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na hetū dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are moral roots; not moral roots.
original: (Ka) hetū dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na hetū dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are not roots.

text: 2. (Ka) sahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) ahetukā dhammā.
rys_davids: States concomitant with a moral root; not so concomitant.
original: (Ka) sahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) ahetukā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena accompanied by roots. ⤵ Phenomena not accompanied by roots.

text: 3. (Ka) hetusampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) hetuvippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States associated with a moral root; dissociated from a moral root.
original: (Ka) hetusampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) hetuvippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with roots. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from roots.

text: 4. (Ka) hetū ceva dhammā sahetukā ca. ⤵ (Kha) sahetukā ceva dhammā na ca hetū.
rys_davids: States that are both moral roots and concomitant with a moral root; states of mind that are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) hetū ceva dhammā sahetukā ca. ⤵ (Kha) sahetukā ceva dhammā na ca hetū.
ai: Phenomena that are roots and are accompanied by roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are accompanied by roots but are not roots.

text: 5. (Ka) hetū ceva dhammā hetusampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) hetusampayuttā ceva dhammā na ca hetū.
rys_davids: States that are both moral roots and associated with moral roots; states of mind that are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) hetū ceva dhammā hetusampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) hetusampayuttā ceva dhammā na ca hetū.
ai: Phenomena that are roots and are associated with roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with roots but are not roots.

text: 6. (Ka) na hetū kho pana dhammā sahetukāpi. ⤵ (Kha) ahetukāpi.
rys_davids: States that are not moral roots, but are either concomitant with moral roots or not.
original: (Ka) na hetū kho pana dhammā sahetukāpi. ⤵ (Kha) ahetukāpi.
ai: Phenomena that are not roots, but are accompanied by roots. ⤵ Phenomena that are also not accompanied by roots.

text: Hetugocchakaṃ.
original: Hetugocchakaṃ.
ai: Section on Roots.

text: Cūḷantaradukaṃ
original: Cūḷantaradukaṃ
ai: Minor Intermediate Dyad.

text: 7. (Ka) sappaccayā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) appaccayā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are causally related; not causally related.
original: (Ka) sappaccayā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) appaccayā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena with conditions. ⤵ Phenomena without conditions.

text: 8. (Ka) saṅkhatā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṅkhatā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are conditioned; unconditioned.
original: (Ka) saṅkhatā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṅkhatā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are conditioned. ⤵ Phenomena that are unconditioned.

text: 9. (Ka) sanidassanā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anidassanā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are visible; invisible.
original: (Ka) sanidassanā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anidassanā dhammā.
ai: Visible phenomena ⤵ invisible phenomena.

text: 10. (Ka) sappaṭighā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) appaṭighā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are reactions; not reactions.
original: (Ka) sappaṭighā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) appaṭighā dhammā.
ai: Impinging phenomena ⤵ non-impinging phenomena.

text: 11. (Ka) rūpino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) arūpino dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have material form; that are immaterial.
original: (Ka) rūpino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) arūpino dhammā.
ai: Material phenomena ⤵ immaterial phenomena.

text: 12. (Ka) lokiyā dhammā . ⤵ (Kha) lokuttarā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are mundane; supramundane.
original: (Ka) lokiyā dhammā . ⤵ (Kha) lokuttarā dhammā.
ai: Mundane phenomena ⤵ supramundane phenomena.

text: 13. (Ka) kenaci viññeyyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) kenaci na viññeyyā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that may be cognized in a given way; that may not be cognized in that given way.
original: (Ka) kenaci viññeyyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) kenaci na viññeyyā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena knowable by some ⤵ phenomena not knowable by some.

text: Cūḷantaradukaṃ.
original: Cūḷantaradukaṃ.
ai: Minor Intermediate Dyads.

text: Āsavagocchakaṃ
original: Āsavagocchakaṃ
ai: Cluster of Taints.

text: 14. (Ka) āsavā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no āsavā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are āsavas; are not āsavas.
original: (Ka) āsavā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no āsavā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are taints ⤵ phenomena that are not taints.

text: 15. (Ka) sāsavā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anāsavā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have āsavas, have not āsavas.
original: (Ka) sāsavā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anāsavā dhammā.
ai: Tainted phenomena ⤵ untouched by taints phenomena.

text: 16. (Ka) āsavasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) āsavavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with āsavas; dissociated from āsavas.
original: (Ka) āsavasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) āsavavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with taints ⤵ phenomena dissociated from taints.

text: 17. (Ka) āsavā ceva dhammā sāsavā ca. ⤵ (Kha) sāsavā ceva dhammā no ca āsavā.
rys_davids: States that both are and have āsavas; that have āsavas but are not āsavas.
original: (Ka) āsavā ceva dhammā sāsavā ca. ⤵ (Kha) sāsavā ceva dhammā no ca āsavā.
ai: Phenomena that are both cankers and associated with cankers; ⤵ phenomena that are associated with cankers but are not cankers.

text: 18. (Ka) āsavā ceva dhammā āsavasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) āsavasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca āsavā.
rys_davids: States that are both āsavas and associated with āsavas; that are associated with āsavas but are not āsavas.
original: (Ka) āsavā ceva dhammā āsavasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) āsavasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca āsavā.
ai: Phenomena that are both cankers and conjoined with cankers; ⤵ phenomena that are conjoined with cankers but are not cankers.

text: 19. (Ka) āsavavippayuttā kho pana dhammā sāsavāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anāsavāpi.
rys_davids: States that are dissociated from āsavas, but may have or may not have āsavas.
original: (Ka) āsavavippayuttā kho pana dhammā sāsavāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anāsavāpi.
ai: However, phenomena disjoined from cankers are also associated with cankers; ⤵ also not associated with cankers.

text: Āsavagocchakaṃ.
original: Āsavagocchakaṃ.
ai: The Canker Couplet.

text: Saṃyojanagocchakaṃ
original: Saṃyojanagocchakaṃ
ai: The Fetter Couplet.

text: 20. (Ka) saṃyojanā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no saṃyojanā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are fetters; are not fetters.
original: (Ka) saṃyojanā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no saṃyojanā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are fetters; ⤵ phenomena that are not fetters.

text: 21. (Ka) saṃyojaniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃyojaniyā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are favourable to fetters; are not so.
original: (Ka) saṃyojaniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃyojaniyā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are fettering; ⤵ phenomena that are not fettering.

text: 22. (Ka) saṃyojanasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) saṃyojanavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with fetters; are dissociated from fetters.
original: (Ka) saṃyojanasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) saṃyojanavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena conjoined with fetters; ⤵ phenomena disjoined from fetters.

text: 23. (Ka) saṃyojanā ceva dhammā saṃyojaniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃyojaniyā ceva dhammā no ca saṃyojanā.
rys_davids: States that are both fetters and favourable to fetters; that are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) saṃyojanā ceva dhammā saṃyojaniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃyojaniyā ceva dhammā no ca saṃyojanā.
ai: Phenomena that are both fetters and fettering; ⤵ phenomena that are fettering but are not fetters.

text: 24. (Ka) saṃyojanā ceva dhammā saṃyojanasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃyojanasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca saṃyojanā.
rys_davids: States that are both fetters and associated with fetters; that are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) saṃyojanā ceva dhammā saṃyojanasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃyojanasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca saṃyojanā.
ai: Phenomena that are both fetters and conjoined with fetters; ⤵ phenomena that are conjoined with fetters but are not fetters.

text: 25. (Ka) saṃyojanavippayuttā kho pana dhammā saṃyojaniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃyojaniyāpi.
rys_davids: States that are dissociated from fetters, but may be favourable to fetters or unfavourable.
original: (Ka) saṃyojanavippayuttā kho pana dhammā saṃyojaniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃyojaniyāpi.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena dissociated from fetters are also conducive to fetters. ⤵ (Kha) Also not conducive to fetters.

text: Saṃyojanagocchakaṃ.
original: Saṃyojanagocchakaṃ.
ai: Group on Fetters.

text: Ganthagocchakaṃ
original: Ganthagocchakaṃ
ai: Group on Knots

text: 26. (Ka) ganthā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no ganthā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are ties; are not ties.
original: (Ka) ganthā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no ganthā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are not knots.

text: 27. (Ka) ganthaniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) aganthaniyā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are favourable to ties; are not so.
original: (Ka) ganthaniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) aganthaniyā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena conducive to knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena not conducive to knots.

text: 28. (Ka) ganthasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) ganthavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with ties; dissociated from ties.
original: (Ka) ganthasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) ganthavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena associated with knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena dissociated from knots.

text: 29. (Ka) ganthā ceva dhammā ganthaniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) ganthaniyā ceva dhammā no ca ganthā.
rys_davids: States that are both ties and favourable to ties; that are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) ganthā ceva dhammā ganthaniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) ganthaniyā ceva dhammā no ca ganthā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are knots and conducive to knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are conducive to knots but are not knots.

text: 30. (Ka) ganthā ceva dhammā ganthasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) ganthasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca ganthā.
rys_davids: States that are both ties and associated with ties; are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) ganthā ceva dhammā ganthasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) ganthasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca ganthā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are knots and associated with knots. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are associated with knots but are not knots.

text: 31. (Ka) ganthavippayuttā kho pana dhammā ganthaniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) aganthaniyāpi.
rys_davids: States that are dissociated from ties; but may or may not be favourable to ties.
original: (Ka) ganthavippayuttā kho pana dhammā ganthaniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) aganthaniyāpi.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena dissociated from knots are also conducive to knots. ⤵ (Kha) Also not conducive to knots.

text: Ganthagocchakaṃ.
original: Ganthagocchakaṃ.
ai: Group on Knots.

text: Oghagocchakaṃ
original: Oghagocchakaṃ
ai: Section on Floods

text: 32. (Ka) oghā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no oghā dhammā.
original: (Ka) oghā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no oghā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are not floods.

text: 33. (Ka) oghaniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anoghaniyā dhammā.
original: (Ka) oghaniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anoghaniyā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that lead to floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that do not lead to floods.

text: 34. (Ka) oghasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) oghavippayuttā dhammā.
original: (Ka) oghasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) oghavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena associated with floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena dissociated from floods.

text: 35. (Ka) oghā ceva dhammā oghaniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) oghaniyā ceva dhammā no ca oghā.
original: (Ka) oghā ceva dhammā oghaniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) oghaniyā ceva dhammā no ca oghā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are both floods and lead to floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that lead to floods but are not floods.

text: 36. (Ka) oghā ceva dhammā oghasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) oghasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca oghā.
original: (Ka) oghā ceva dhammā oghasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) oghasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca oghā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are both floods and associated with floods. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are associated with floods but are not floods.

text: 37. (Ka) oghavippayuttā kho pana dhammā oghaniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anoghaniyāpi.
original: (Ka) oghavippayuttā kho pana dhammā oghaniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anoghaniyāpi.
ai: (Ka) Indeed, phenomena dissociated from floods also lead to floods. ⤵ (Kha) And also do not lead to floods.

text: Oghagocchakaṃ.
original: Oghagocchakaṃ.
ai: Section on Floods.

text: Yogagocchakaṃ
original: Yogagocchakaṃ
ai: Section on Yokes

text: 38. (Ka) yogā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no yogā dhammā.
original: (Ka) yogā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no yogā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) Phenomena that are yokes. ⤵ (Kha) Phenomena that are not yokes.

text: 39. (Ka) yoganiyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) ayoganiyā dhammā.
original: (Ka) yoganiyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) ayoganiyā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena pertaining to yokes. ⤵ Phenomena not pertaining to yokes.

text: 40. (Ka) yogasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) yogavippayuttā dhammā.
original: (Ka) yogasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) yogavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with yokes. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from yokes.

text: 41. (Ka) yogā ceva dhammā yoganiyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) yoganiyā ceva dhammā no ca yogā.
original: (Ka) yogā ceva dhammā yoganiyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) yoganiyā ceva dhammā no ca yogā.
ai: Phenomena that are yokes and pertain to yokes. ⤵ Phenomena that pertain to yokes but are not yokes.

text: 42. (Ka) yogā ceva dhammā yogasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) yogasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca yogā.
original: (Ka) yogā ceva dhammā yogasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) yogasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca yogā.
ai: Phenomena that are yokes and are associated with yokes. ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with yokes but are not yokes.

text: 43. (Ka) yogavippayuttā kho pana dhammā yoganiyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) ayoganiyāpi.
original: (Ka) yogavippayuttā kho pana dhammā yoganiyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) ayoganiyāpi.
ai: Phenomena dissociated from yokes, which also pertain to yokes. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from yokes, which also do not pertain to yokes.

text: Yogagocchakaṃ.
original: Yogagocchakaṃ.
ai: Group on Yokes.

text: Nīvaraṇagocchakaṃ
original: Nīvaraṇagocchakaṃ
ai: Group on Hindrances.

text: 44. (Ka) nīvaraṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no nīvaraṇā dhammā.
original: (Ka) nīvaraṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no nīvaraṇā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are hindrances. ⤵ Phenomena that are not hindrances.

text: 45. (Ka) nīvaraṇiyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anīvaraṇiyā dhammā.
original: (Ka) nīvaraṇiyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anīvaraṇiyā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena pertaining to hindrances. ⤵ Phenomena not pertaining to hindrances.

text: 46. (Ka) nīvaraṇasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) nīvaraṇavippayuttā dhammā.
original: (Ka) nīvaraṇasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) nīvaraṇavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with hindrances. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from hindrances.

text: 47. (Ka) nīvaraṇā ceva dhammā nīvaraṇiyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) nīvaraṇiyā ceva dhammā no ca nīvaraṇā.
original: (Ka) nīvaraṇā ceva dhammā nīvaraṇiyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) nīvaraṇiyā ceva dhammā no ca nīvaraṇā.
ai: (Ka) States that are hindrances and are of the nature of hindrances. ⤵ (Kha) States that are of the nature of hindrances but are not hindrances.

text: 48. (Ka) nīvaraṇā ceva dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca nīvaraṇā.
original: (Ka) nīvaraṇā ceva dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca nīvaraṇā.
ai: (Ka) States that are hindrances and are associated with hindrances. ⤵ (Kha) States that are associated with hindrances but are not hindrances.

text: 49. (Ka) nīvaraṇavippayuttā kho pana dhammā nīvaraṇiyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anīvaraṇiyāpi .
original: (Ka) nīvaraṇavippayuttā kho pana dhammā nīvaraṇiyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anīvaraṇiyāpi .
ai: (Ka) States that are dissociated from hindrances, but are of the nature of hindrances. ⤵ (Kha) States that are dissociated from hindrances and are not of the nature of hindrances.

text: Nīvaraṇagocchakaṃ.
original: Nīvaraṇagocchakaṃ.
ai: The Hindrance Group.

text: Parāmāsagocchakaṃ
original: Parāmāsagocchakaṃ
ai: The Misapprehension Group.

text: 50. (Ka) parāmāsā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no parāmāsā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are perversions; are not perversions.
original: (Ka) parāmāsā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no parāmāsā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) States that are misapprehensions. ⤵ (Kha) States that are not misapprehensions.

text: 51. (Ka) parāmaṭṭhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) aparāmaṭṭhā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are perverted; unperverted.
original: (Ka) parāmaṭṭhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) aparāmaṭṭhā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) States that are misapprehended. ⤵ (Kha) States that are unmisapprehended.

text: 52. (Ka) parāmāsasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) parāmāsavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with perversion; dissociated from perversion.
original: (Ka) parāmāsasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) parāmāsavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: (Ka) States that are associated with misapprehension. ⤵ (Kha) States that are dissociated from misapprehension.

text: 53. (Ka) parāmāsā ceva dhammā parāmaṭṭhā ca. ⤵ (Kha) parāmaṭṭhā ceva dhammā no ca parāmāsā.
rys_davids: States that are both perversions and perverted; are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) parāmāsā ceva dhammā parāmaṭṭhā ca. ⤵ (Kha) parāmaṭṭhā ceva dhammā no ca parāmāsā.
ai: (Ka) States that are both misapprehensions and misapprehended. ⤵ (Kha) States that are misapprehended but are not misapprehensions.

text: 54. (Ka) parāmāsavippayuttā kho pana dhammā parāmaṭṭhāpi. ⤵ (Kha) aparāmaṭṭhāpi.
rys_davids: States that are dissociated from perversion, but are either perverted or unperverted.
original: (Ka) parāmāsavippayuttā kho pana dhammā parāmaṭṭhāpi. ⤵ (Kha) aparāmaṭṭhāpi.
ai: (Ka) States that are dissociated from misapprehension, but are misapprehended. ⤵ (Kha) States that are dissociated from misapprehension and are unmisapprehended.

text: Parāmāsagocchakaṃ.
original: Parāmāsagocchakaṃ.
ai: Cluster of Grasping

text: Mahantaradukaṃ
original: Mahantaradukaṃ
ai: The Great Pairs

text: 55. (Ka) sārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anārammaṇā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have objects of thought; have not such.
original: (Ka) sārammaṇā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anārammaṇā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena with objects ⤵ Phenomena without objects

text: 56. (Ka) cittā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that have thought; have not thought.
original: (Ka) cittā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are consciousness ⤵ Phenomena that are not consciousness

text: 57. (Ka) cetasikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) acetasikā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are mental properties; are not such.
original: (Ka) cetasikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) acetasikā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are mental factors ⤵ Phenomena that are not mental factors

text: 58. (Ka) cittasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) cittavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with thought; dissociated from thought.
original: (Ka) cittasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) cittavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with consciousness ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from consciousness

text: 59. (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) cittavisaṃsaṭṭhā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are conjoined with thought; detached from thought.
original: (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) cittavisaṃsaṭṭhā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena conjoined with consciousness ⤵ Phenomena unconjoined with consciousness

text: 60. (Ka) cittasamuṭṭhānā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasamuṭṭhānā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are sprung from thought; are not so.
original: (Ka) cittasamuṭṭhānā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasamuṭṭhānā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena originated by consciousness ⤵ Phenomena not originated by consciousness

text: 61. (Ka) cittasahabhuno dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasahabhuno dhammā.
rys_davids: States that come into being together with thought; do not so come into being.
original: (Ka) cittasahabhuno dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasahabhuno dhammā.
ai: Phenomena co-arising with consciousness ⤵ Phenomena not co-arising with consciousness

text: 62. (Ka) cittānuparivattino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittānuparivattino dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are consecutive to thought; are not so.
original: (Ka) cittānuparivattino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittānuparivattino dhammā.
ai: Phenomena following consciousness ⤵ Phenomena not following consciousness

text: 63. (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are conjoined with and sprung from thought; are not so.
original: (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that arise from and are associated with consciousness. ⤵ Phenomena that do not arise from and are not associated with consciousness.

text: 64. (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are conjoined with, sprung from, come into being together with thought; are not so.
original: (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are co-existent with those arising from and associated with consciousness. ⤵ Phenomena that are not co-existent with those arising from and associated with consciousness.

text: 65. (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are conjoined with, sprung from, consecutive to thought; are not so.
original: (Ka) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that accompany or are dependent on those arising from and associated with consciousness. ⤵ Phenomena that do not accompany or are not dependent on those arising from and associated with consciousness.

text: 66. (Ka) ajjhattikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bāhirā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are one's own; are external.
original: (Ka) ajjhattikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) bāhirā dhammā.
ai: Internal phenomena. ⤵ External phenomena.

text: 67. (Ka) upādā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no upādā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are derived; are not derived.
original: (Ka) upādā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no upādā dhammā.
ai: Derived phenomena. ⤵ Non-derived phenomena.

text: 68. (Ka) upādiṇṇā [upādinnā (sī. syā.)] dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anupādiṇṇā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are grasped at; are not grasped at.
original: (Ka) upādiṇṇā [upādinnā (sī. syā.)] dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anupādiṇṇā dhammā.
ai: Karmically conditioned or grasped phenomena. ⤵ Non-karmically conditioned or not grasped phenomena.

text: Mahantaradukaṃ.
original: Mahantaradukaṃ.
ai: The Great Intermediate Pair.

text: Upādānagocchakaṃ
original: Upādānagocchakaṃ
ai: The Group on Clinging/Grasping.

text: 69. (Ka) upādānā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no upādānā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are graspings; are not graspings.
original: (Ka) upādānā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no upādānā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are clinging itself. ⤵ Phenomena that are not clinging itself.

text: 70. (Ka) upādāniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anupādāniyā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are favourable to grasping; not favourable.
original: (Ka) upādāniyā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) anupādāniyā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are objects of clinging. ⤵ Phenomena that are not objects of clinging.

text: 71. (Ka) upādānasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) upādānavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with grasping; dissociated from grasping.
original: (Ka) upādānasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) upādānavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with clinging. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from clinging.

text: 72. (Ka) upādānā ceva dhammā upādāniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) upādāniyā ceva dhammā no ca upādānā.
rys_davids: States that are both graspings and favourable to grasping; are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) upādānā ceva dhammā upādāniyā ca. ⤵ (Kha) upādāniyā ceva dhammā no ca upādānā.
ai: Phenomena that are clinging itself and are also objects of clinging. ⤵ Phenomena that are objects of clinging but are not clinging itself.

text: 73. (Ka) upādānā ceva dhammā upādānasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) upādānasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca upādānā.
rys_davids: States that are both graspings and associated with grasping; are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) upādānā ceva dhammā upādānasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) upādānasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca upādānā.
ai: Phenomena that are clinging itself and are associated with clinging. ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with clinging but are not clinging itself.

text: 74. (Ka) upādānavippayuttā kho pana dhammā upādāniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anupādāniyāpi.
rys_davids: States that are dissociated from grasping, but may be either favourable or unfavourable to grasping.
original: (Ka) upādānavippayuttā kho pana dhammā upādāniyāpi. ⤵ (Kha) anupādāniyāpi.
ai: Phenomena dissociated from clinging that are also objects of clinging. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from clinging and not objects of clinging.

text: Upādānagocchakaṃ.
original: Upādānagocchakaṃ.
ai: The Clinging Group.

text: Kilesagocchakaṃ
original: Kilesagocchakaṃ
ai: The Defilement Group.

text: 75. (Ka) kilesā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no kilesā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are vices; are not vices.
original: (Ka) kilesā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) no kilesā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are defilements. ⤵ Phenomena that are not defilements.

text: 76. (Ka) saṃkilesikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkilesikā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are vicious; are not vicious.
original: (Ka) saṃkilesikā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkilesikā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are defiling. ⤵ Phenomena that are not defiling.

text: 77. (Ka) saṃkiliṭṭhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkiliṭṭhā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are vitiated; are not vitiated.
original: (Ka) saṃkiliṭṭhā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkiliṭṭhā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena that are defiled. ⤵ Phenomena that are undefiled.

text: 78. (Ka) kilesasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) kilesavippayuttā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that are associated with vice; are dissociated from vice.
original: (Ka) kilesasampayuttā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) kilesavippayuttā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena associated with defilements. ⤵ Phenomena dissociated from defilements.

text: 79. (Ka) kilesā ceva dhammā saṃkilesikā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃkilesikā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā.
rys_davids: States that are both vices and vicious; are vicious but not vices.
original: (Ka) kilesā ceva dhammā saṃkilesikā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃkilesikā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā.
ai: Phenomena that are both defilements and defiling ⤵ Phenomena that are defiling but not defilements.

text: 80. (Ka) kilesā ceva dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā.
rys_davids: States that are both vices and vitiated; are vitiated but not vices.
original: (Ka) kilesā ceva dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā ca. ⤵ (Kha) saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā.
ai: Phenomena that are both defilements and defiled ⤵ Phenomena that are defiled but not defilements.

text: 81. (Ka) kilesā ceva dhammā kilesasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) kilesasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā.
rys_davids: States that are both vices and associated with vice; are the latter but not the former.
original: (Ka) kilesā ceva dhammā kilesasampayuttā ca. ⤵ (Kha) kilesasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā.
ai: Phenomena that are both defilements and associated with defilements ⤵ Phenomena that are associated with defilements but not defilements.

text: 82. (Ka) kilesavippayuttā kho pana dhammā saṃkilesikāpi. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkilesikāpi.
rys_davids: States that are dissociated from vice, but may be either vicious or not.
original: (Ka) kilesavippayuttā kho pana dhammā saṃkilesikāpi. ⤵ (Kha) asaṃkilesikāpi.
ai: Phenomena dissociated from defilements, but also defiling ⤵ And also non-defiling.

text: Kilesagocchakaṃ.
original: Kilesagocchakaṃ.
ai: Cluster of Defilements.

text: Piṭṭhidukaṃ
original: Piṭṭhidukaṃ
ai: Pairs of Backs/Foundations.

text: 83. (Ka) dassanena pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na dassanena pahātabbā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that may be put away by vision; not so put away.
original: (Ka) dassanena pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na dassanena pahātabbā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena to be abandoned by insight ⤵ Phenomena not to be abandoned by insight.

text: 84. (Ka) bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā.
rys_davids: States that may be put away by culture; not so put away.
original: (Ka) bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na bhāvanāya pahātabbā dhammā.
ai: Phenomena to be abandoned by development ⤵ Phenomena not to be abandoned by development.

text: 85. (Ka) dassanena pahātabbahetukā dhammā. ⤵ (Kha) na dassanena pahātabbahetukā dhammā.

text: 1. Katame dhammā kusalā? Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇasampayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, vedanā hoti, saññā hoti, cetanā hoti, cittaṃ hoti, vitakko hoti, vicāro hoti, pīti hoti, sukhaṃ hoti, cittassekaggatā hoti, saddhindriyaṃ hoti, vīriyindriyaṃ [viriyindriyaṃ (sī. syā.)] hoti, satindriyaṃ hoti, samādhindriyaṃ hoti, paññindriyaṃ hoti, manindriyaṃ hoti, somanassindriyaṃ hoti, jīvitindriyaṃ hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, sammāsaṅkappo hoti, sammāvāyāmo hoti, sammāsati hoti, sammāsamādhi hoti, saddhābalaṃ hoti, vīriyabalaṃ [viriyabalaṃ (sī. syā.)] hoti, satibalaṃ hoti, samādhibalaṃ hoti, paññābalaṃ hoti, hiribalaṃ hoti, ottappabalaṃ hoti, alobho hoti, adoso hoti, amoho hoti, anabhijjhā hoti, abyāpādo hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, hirī hoti, ottappaṃ hoti, kāyapassaddhi [kāyappassaddhi (syā.)] hoti, cittapassaddhi [cittappassaddhi (syā.)] hoti, kāyalahutā hoti, cittalahutā hoti, kāyamudutā hoti, cittamudutā hoti, kāyakammaññatā hoti, cittakammaññatā hoti, kāyapāguññatā hoti, cittapāguññatā hoti, kāyujukatā [kāyujjukatā (sī. ka.)] hoti, cittujukatā [cittujjukatā (sī. ka.)] hoti, sati hoti, sampajaññaṃ hoti, samatho hoti, vipassanā hoti, paggāho hoti, avikkhepo hoti; ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññepi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā – ime dhammā kusalā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that are good?⤵When a good thought concerning the sensuous universe has risen, which is accompanied by gladness and associated with knowledge, and has as its object a sight, a sound, a smell, a taste, a touch, a [mental] state, or what not, then there is:⤵contact ( § 2 )⤵feeling ( § 3 )⤵perception ( § 4 )⤵volition ( § 5 )⤵thought ( § 6 )⤵application ( § 7 )⤵sustained thinking ( § 8 )⤵zest ( § 9 )⤵ease ( § 10 )⤵self-collectedness ( § 11 )⤵the faculty of faith ( § 12 )⤵the faculty of energy ( § 13 )⤵the faculty of mindfulness ( § 14 )⤵the faculty of concentration ( § 15 )⤵the faculty of insight ( § 16 )⤵the faculty of ideation ( § 17 )⤵the faculty of gladness ( § 18 )⤵the faculty of life ( § 19 )⤵right views ( § 20 )⤵right intention ( § 21 )⤵right endeavour ( § 22 )⤵right mindfulness ( § 23 )⤵right concentration ( § 24 )⤵the power of faith ( § 25 )⤵the power of energy ( § 26 )⤵the power of mindfulness ( § 27 )⤵the power of concentration ( § 28 )⤵the power of insight ( § 29 )⤵the power of conscientiousness ( § 30 )⤵the power of the fear of blame ( § 31 )⤵absence of greed ( § 32 )⤵absence of hate ( § 33 )⤵absence of dullness ( § 34 )⤵absence of covetousness ( § 35 )⤵absence of malice ( § 36 )⤵right views ( § 37 )⤵conscientiousness ( § 38 )⤵fear of blame ( § 39 )⤵serenity in mind and mental factors ( §§ 40 , 41 )⤵lightness in mind and mental factors ( §§ 42 , 43 )⤵plasticity in mind and mental factors ( §§ 44 , 45 )⤵facility in mind and mental factors ( §§ 46 , 47 )⤵fitness in mind and mental factors ( §§ 48 , 49 )⤵directness in mind and mental factors ( §§ 50 , 51 )⤵mindfulness ( § 52 )⤵intelligence ( § 53 )⤵quiet ( § 54 )⤵intuition ( § 55 )⤵grasp ( § 56 )⤵balance ( § 57 ).⤵Now these—or whatever other incorporeal, causally induced states there are on that occasion—these are states that are good.
original: Katame dhammā kusalā? Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti somanassasahagataṃ ñāṇasampayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, vedanā hoti, saññā hoti, cetanā hoti, cittaṃ hoti, vitakko hoti, vicāro hoti, pīti hoti, sukhaṃ hoti, cittassekaggatā hoti, saddhindriyaṃ hoti, vīriyindriyaṃ [viriyindriyaṃ (sī. syā.)] hoti, satindriyaṃ hoti, samādhindriyaṃ hoti, paññindriyaṃ hoti, manindriyaṃ hoti, somanassindriyaṃ hoti, jīvitindriyaṃ hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, sammāsaṅkappo hoti, sammāvāyāmo hoti, sammāsati hoti, sammāsamādhi hoti, saddhābalaṃ hoti, vīriyabalaṃ [viriyabalaṃ (sī. syā.)] hoti, satibalaṃ hoti, samādhibalaṃ hoti, paññābalaṃ hoti, hiribalaṃ hoti, ottappabalaṃ hoti, alobho hoti, adoso hoti, amoho hoti, anabhijjhā hoti, abyāpādo hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, hirī hoti, ottappaṃ hoti, kāyapassaddhi [kāyappassaddhi (syā.)] hoti, cittapassaddhi [cittappassaddhi (syā.)] hoti, kāyalahutā hoti, cittalahutā hoti, kāyamudutā hoti, cittamudutā hoti, kāyakammaññatā hoti, cittakammaññatā hoti, kāyapāguññatā hoti, cittapāguññatā hoti, kāyujukatā [kāyujjukatā (sī. ka.)] hoti, cittujukatā [cittujjukatā (sī. ka.)] hoti, sati hoti, sampajaññaṃ hoti, samatho hoti, vipassanā hoti, paggāho hoti, avikkhepo hoti; ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññepi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā – ime dhammā kusalā.
ai: Which states are wholesome?⤵When a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness, accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge, has arisen, taking as its object a visible form, or a sound, or an odor, or a taste, or a tangible, or a mental object, or whatever else it may take as object, then there is:⤵contact⤵feeling⤵perception⤵volition⤵consciousness⤵initial application⤵sustained application⤵zest⤵happiness⤵one-pointedness of consciousness⤵faculty of faith⤵faculty of energy⤵faculty of mindfulness⤵faculty of concentration⤵faculty of wisdom⤵faculty of mind⤵faculty of joy⤵life faculty⤵right view⤵right intention⤵right effort⤵right mindfulness⤵right concentration⤵power of faith⤵power of energy⤵power of mindfulness⤵power of concentration⤵power of wisdom⤵power of shame⤵power of fear of wrongdoing⤵non-greed⤵non-hatred⤵non-delusion⤵non-covetousness⤵non-ill-will⤵right view⤵shame⤵fear of wrongdoing⤵tranquillity of mental body⤵tranquillity of consciousness⤵lightness of mental body⤵lightness of consciousness⤵malleability of mental body⤵malleability of consciousness⤵wieldiness of mental body⤵wieldiness of consciousness⤵proficiency of mental body⤵proficiency of consciousness⤵rectitude of mental body⤵rectitude of consciousness⤵mindfulness⤵clear comprehension⤵calm⤵insight⤵exertion⤵non-distraction.⤵And whatever other formless states there are that have arisen dependently at that moment – these states are wholesome.

text: 2. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye phasso phusanā saṃphusanā saṃphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is contact ( phasso )?⤵The contact which on that occasion is touching, the being brought into contact, the state of having been brought into touch with—this is the contact that there then is.
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye phasso phusanā saṃphusanā saṃphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is contact? The contact which on that occasion is touching, complete touching, the state of having completely touched – this is the contact that there then is.

text: 3. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye vedanā hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vedanā hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is feeling ( vedana )?⤵The mental pleasure, the mental ease, which, on that occasion, is born of contact with the appropriate element of representative intellection; the pleasurable, easeful sensation which is born of contact with thought; the pleasurable, easeful feeling which is born of contact with thought—this is the feeling that there then is.
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye vedanā hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vedanā hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is feeling? The mental pleasantness, the mental happiness, which on that occasion is born of contact with the mind-consciousness element; the pleasant, happy sensation born of contact with consciousness; the pleasant, happy feeling born of contact with consciousness – this is the feeling that there then is.

text: 4. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye saññā hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajā saññā sañjānanā sañjānitattaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saññā hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is perception ( saññā )?⤵The perception, the perceiving, the state of having perceived which on that occasion is born of contact with the appropriate element of representative intellection—this is the perception that there then is.
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye saññā hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajā saññā sañjānanā sañjānitattaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saññā hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is perception? The perception, the perceiving, the state of having perceived which on that occasion is born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is the perception that there then is.

text: 5. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajā cetanā sañcetanā cetayitattaṃ [sañcetayitattaṃ (syā.)] – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is volition ( cetanā )?⤵The volition, purpose, purposefulness, which is born of contact with the appropriate element of representative intellection—this is the volition that there then is.
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajā cetanā sañcetanā cetayitattaṃ [sañcetayitattaṃ (syā.)] – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is volition? The volition, intending, the state of having intended which on that occasion is born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – this is the volition that there then is.

text: 6. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is thought ( cittaṃ )?⤵The thought which on that occasion is ideation, mind, heart, that which is clear, ideation as the sphere of mind, the faculty of mind, intellection, the skandha of intellection, the appropriate element of representative intellection—this is the thought that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is consciousness? The consciousness which on that occasion is mind, mentality, heart, the pure, mind-base, mind-faculty, consciousness, aggregate of consciousness, the mind-consciousness element – this is the consciousness that there then is.

text: 7. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye vitakko hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vitakko hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is application of mind ( vitakko )?⤵The discrimination, the application, which on that occasion is the disposing, the fixing, the focussing, the superposing of the mind, right disposing—this is the application that there then is.
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye vitakko hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vitakko hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is initial application?⤵The reasoning, initial application, intention, placing, applying, placing the mind on, right intention, which on that occasion is —this is the initial application that there then is.

text: 8. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye vicāro hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cāro vicāro anuvicāro upavicāro cittassa anusandhānatā anupekkhanatā – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vicāro hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is sustained thought ( vicāro )?⤵The process, the sustained procedure ( vicāro ), the progress and access [of the mind] which on that occasion is the [continuous] adjusting and focussing of thought—this is the sustained thought that there then is.
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye vicāro hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cāro vicāro anuvicāro upavicāro cittassa anusandhānatā anupekkhanatā – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vicāro hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is sustained application?⤵The sustained application, pondering, examining, the mind's continual application, sustained examination, which on that occasion is —this is the sustained application that there then is.

text: 9. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye pīti hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye pīti pāmojjaṃ āmodanā pamodanā hāso pahāso vitti odagyaṃ attamanatā cittassa – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye pīti hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is zest ( pīti )?⤵The zest which on that occasion is joy, rejoicing at, rejoicing over, mirth and merriment, felicity, exultation, transport of mind—this is the zest that there then is.
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye pīti hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye pīti pāmojjaṃ āmodanā pamodanā hāso pahāso vitti odagyaṃ attamanatā cittassa – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye pīti hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is rapture?⤵The rapture, joy, delight, gladness, mirth, great mirth, thrill, elation, mental satisfaction, which on that occasion is —this is the rapture that there then is.

text: 10. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sukhaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sukhaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is ease ( sukhaṃ )?⤵The mental pleasure, the mental ease, which on that occasion is the pleasant, easeful experience born of contact with thought—this is the ease that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sukhaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sukhaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is happiness?⤵The mental pleasantness, mental happiness, pleasant happy experience born of mental contact, pleasant happy feeling born of mental contact, which on that occasion is —this is the happiness that there then is.

text: 11. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye cittassekaggatā hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittassekaggatā hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is self-collectedness ( cittass’ ekaggatā )?⤵The stability, solidity, absorbed steadfastness of thought which on that occasion is the absence of distraction, balance, unperturbed mental procedure, quiet, the faculty and the power of concentration, right concentration—this is the self-collectedness that there then is.
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye cittassekaggatā hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittassekaggatā hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is one-pointedness of mind?⤵The mind's stability, firm stability, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scattering, undistractedness of mind, calm, faculty of concentration, power of concentration, right concentration, which on that occasion is —this is the one-pointedness of mind that there then is.

text: 12. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo saddhā saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalaṃ – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of faith ( saddhindriyaṃ )?⤵The faith which on that occasion is a trusting in, the professing confidence in, the sense of assurance, faith, faith as a faculty and as a power—this is the faith that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo saddhā saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalaṃ – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the faculty of faith?⤵The faith, trusting, confidence, serene confidence, faith as a faculty, power of faith, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of faith that there then is.

text: 13. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyindriyaṃ hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko vīriyārambho [viriyārambho (sī. syā.)] nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī [ussoḷhi (sī.)] thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of energy ( viriyindriyaṃ )?⤵The mental inception of energy which there is on that occasion, the striving and the onward effort, the exertion and endeavour, the zeal and ardour, the vigour and fortitude, the state of unfaltering effort, the state of sustained desire, the state of unflinching endurance and solid grip of the burden, energy, energy as faculty and as power, right endeavour—this is the energy that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyindriyaṃ hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko vīriyārambho [viriyārambho (sī. syā.)] nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī [ussoḷhi (sī.)] thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the faculty of energy?⤵The mental inception of energy, striving, effort, exertion, endeavor, zeal, ardor, vigor, fortitude, unfaltering effort, sustained desire, unflinching endurance, solid grip of the burden, energy, faculty of energy, power of energy, right effort, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of energy that there then is.

text: 14. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of mindfulness ( satindriyaṃ )?⤵The mindfulness which on that occasion is recollecting, calling back to mind; the mindfulness which is remembering, bearing in mind, the opposite of superficiality and of obliviousness; mindfulness as faculty, mindfulness as power, right mindfulness—this is the faculty of mindfulness that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the faculty of mindfulness?⤵The mindfulness, recollection, remembering, bearing in mind, non-superficiality, non-forgetfulness, mindfulness as a faculty, power of mindfulness, right mindfulness, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of mindfulness that there then is.

text: 15. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of concentration ( samādhindriyaṃ )?⤵Answer as for “self-collectedness”, § 11 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the faculty of concentration?⤵The mind's stability, firm stability, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scattering, undistractedness of mind, calm, faculty of concentration, power of concentration, right concentration, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of concentration that there then is.

text: 16. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of insight ( paññindriyaṃ )?⤵The insight which there is on that occasion is understanding, search, research, searching the Doctrine, discernment, discrimination, differentiation, erudition, proficiency, subtlety, criticism, reflection, analysis, breadth, sagacity, a “guide”, intuition, intelligence, a “goad”; wisdom as faculty, wisdom as power, wisdom as a sword, wisdom as a height, wisdom as light, wisdom as glory, wisdom as splendour, wisdom as a precious stone; the absence of dullness, searching the Truth, right views—this is the wisdom that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññindriyaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the faculty of wisdom?⤵The wisdom, understanding, search, research, investigation of phenomena, discernment, discrimination, differentiation, erudition, proficiency, subtlety, criticism, reflection, analysis, breadth, sagacity, a guide, insight, clear comprehension, goad, wisdom as a faculty, power of wisdom, wisdom as a sword, wisdom as a height, wisdom as light, wisdom as glory, wisdom as splendor, wisdom as a precious stone, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, which on that occasion is —this is the faculty of wisdom that there then is.

text: 17. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye manindriyaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye manindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of mind (representative imagination, manindriyaṃ )?⤵Answer as for “thought” ( cittaṃ ), § 6 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye manindriyaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye manindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the mind faculty?⤵That which on that occasion is consciousness, mind, mentality, intellect, mind base, mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, the mind-consciousness element—this is the mind faculty on that occasion.

text: 18. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye somanassindriyaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye somanassindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of pleasure ( somanassin-driyaṃ )?⤵Answer as for “ease” ( sukhaṃ ), § 10 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye somanassindriyaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye somanassindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the faculty of mental pleasure?⤵That which on that occasion is mental pleasantness, mental happiness, a pleasant and happy feeling born of mental contact—this is the faculty of mental pleasure on that occasion.

text: 19. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye jīvitindriyaṃ hoti? Yo tesaṃ arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā [irīyanā (sī.)] vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye jīvitindriyaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the faculty of life ( jīvitindriyaṃ )?⤵The persistence of these incorporeal states, their subsistence, going on, their being kept going on, their progress, continuance, preservation, life, life as faculty—this is the faculty of life that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye jīvitindriyaṃ hoti? Yo tesaṃ arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā [irīyanā (sī.)] vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye jīvitindriyaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the life faculty?⤵That which on that occasion is the life, persistence, maintenance, sustenance, going on, continuance, preservation, life, life faculty of those immaterial phenomena—this is the life faculty on that occasion.

text: 20. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye sammādiṭṭhi hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion are right views ( sammā-diṭṭhi )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of insight”, § 16 .
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye sammādiṭṭhi hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is right view?⤵That which on that occasion is wisdom, understanding, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, observation, close observation, sagacity, skill, proficiency, analysis, thought, examination, wisdom, intelligence, guidance, insight, clear comprehension, goad, wisdom, wisdom faculty, power of wisdom, wisdom's weapon, wisdom's palace, wisdom's light, wisdom's radiance, wisdom's illumination, wisdom's gem, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view—this is right view on that occasion.

text: 21. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye sammāsaṅkappo hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāsaṅkappo hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is right intention ( sammā-sankappo )?⤵Answer as for “application of mind”, § 7 .
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye sammāsaṅkappo hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāsaṅkappo hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is right intention?⤵That which on that occasion is thought, initial application, intention, application, thorough application, directing of mind, right intention—this is right intention on that occasion.

text: 22. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye sammāvāyāmo hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko vīriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāvāyāmo hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is right endeavour ( sammā-vāyāmo )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of energy”, § 13 .
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye sammāvāyāmo hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko vīriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāvāyāmo hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is right effort?⤵That which on that occasion is mental energy, exertion, effort, striving, endeavor, enthusiasm, perseverance, strength, firmness, unflagging effort, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden, undertaking the burden, energy, energy faculty, power of energy, right effort—this is right effort on that occasion.

text: 23. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye sammāsati hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāsati hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is right mindfulness ( sammāsati )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of mindfulness”, § 14 .
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye sammāsati hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāsati hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is right mindfulness?⤵That which on that occasion is mindfulness, recollection, repeated recollection, remembering, holding in mind, non-forgetfulness, non-confusion, mindfulness, mindfulness faculty, power of mindfulness, right mindfulness—this is right mindfulness on that occasion.

text: 24. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye sammāsamādhi hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāsamādhi hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is right concentration ( sammā-samādhi )?⤵Answer as for “self-collectedness”, § 11 .
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye sammāsamādhi hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammāsamādhi hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is right concentration?⤵That which on that occasion is the mind's stability, steadfastness, immobility, non-distraction, non-scattering, undistracted mentality, calm, concentration faculty, power of concentration, right concentration—this is right concentration on that occasion.

text: 25. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhābalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo saddhā saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalaṃ – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhābalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of faith ( saddhābalaṃ )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of faith”, § 12 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhābalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo saddhā saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalaṃ – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saddhābalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of faith?⤵That which on that occasion is faith, confidence, conviction, serene trust, faith, faith faculty, power of faith—this is the power of faith on that occasion.

text: 26. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyabalaṃ hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko vīriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyabalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of energy ( viriyabalaṃ )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of energy”, § 13 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyabalaṃ hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko vīriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vīriyabalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of energy?⤵That which on that occasion is mental energy, exertion, effort, striving, endeavor, enthusiasm, perseverance, strength, firmness, unflagging effort, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden, undertaking the burden, energy, energy faculty, power of energy, right effort—this is the power of energy on that occasion.

text: 27. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satibalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satibalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of mindfulness ( sati-balaṃ )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of mindfulness”, § 14 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satibalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye satibalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of mindfulness?⤵That mindfulness, recollection, remembrance, holding in mind, not floating away, not forgetting; the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, right mindfulness, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of mindfulness on that occasion.

text: 28. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhibalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhibalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of concentration ( samādhi-balaṃ )?⤵Answer as for “self-collectedness”, § 11 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhibalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye samādhibalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of concentration?⤵That mental stability, firmness, non-wavering, non-distraction, non-scatteredness of mind, tranquility; the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, right concentration, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of concentration on that occasion.

text: 29. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññābalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññābalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of insight ( paññābalaṃ )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of wisdom”, § 16 .
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññābalaṃ hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paññābalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of wisdom?⤵That wisdom, knowing thoroughly, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, sagacity, skill, analysis, reflection, understanding, intelligence, insight, comprehension, goad, wisdom; the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the weapon of wisdom, the palace of wisdom, the light of wisdom, the radiance of wisdom, the lamp of wisdom, the gem of wisdom, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of wisdom on that occasion.

text: 30. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hiribalaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hirīyati hiriyitabbena hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hiribalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of conscientiousness ( hiribalaṃ )?⤵The feeling of conscientious scruple which there is on that occasion when scruples ought to be felt, conscientious scruple at attaining to bad and evil states—this is the power of conscientiousness that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hiribalaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hirīyati hiriyitabbena hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hiribalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of moral shame?⤵That moral shame, being ashamed of what one should be ashamed of, being ashamed of engaging in evil, unwholesome states, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of moral shame on that occasion.

text: 31. Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappabalaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappati ottappitabbena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappabalaṃ hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the power of the fear of blame ( ottappabalaṃ )?⤵The sense of guilt which there is on that occasion, where a sense of guilt ought to be felt, a sense of guilt at attaining to bad and evil states—this is the fear of blame that there then is.
original: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappabalaṃ hoti? Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappati ottappitabbena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappabalaṃ hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is the power of moral dread?⤵That moral dread, fearing what one should fear, fearing engaging in evil, unwholesome states, which there is on that occasion—this is the power of moral dread on that occasion.

text: 32. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye alobho hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ asārāgo asārajjanā asārajjitattaṃ anabhijjhā alobho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye alobho hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is disinterestedness ( alobho )?⤵The absence of greed, of being greedy, of greediness, which there is on that occasion, the absence of infatuation, the feeling and being infatuated, the absence of covetousness, that absence of greed which is the root of good—this is the absence of greed that there then is.
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye alobho hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ asārāgo asārajjanā asārajjitattaṃ anabhijjhā alobho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye alobho hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is non-greed?⤵That non-greed, not being greedy, the state of not being greedy, non-attachment, not being attached, the state of not being attached, non-covetousness, non-greed, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-greed on that occasion.

text: 33. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye adoso hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ [adūsanā adūsitattaṃ (syā.)] abyāpādo abyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye adoso hoti?
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the absence of hate ( adoso )?⤵The absence of hate, of hating, of hatred, which there is on that occasion, the absence of malice, of spleen, the absence of hate, which is the root of good—this is the absence of hate that there then is.
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye adoso hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ [adūsanā adūsitattaṃ (syā.)] abyāpādo abyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye adoso hoti?
ai: What on that occasion is non-hatred?⤵That non-hatred, not being hateful, the state of not being hateful, non-ill-will, not being malicious, non-hatred, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-hatred on that occasion.

text: 34. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye amoho hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi amoho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye amoho hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the absence of dullness ( amoho )?⤵Answer as for the “faculty of insight”, § 16 .
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye amoho hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi amoho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye amoho hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is non-delusion?⤵That wisdom, knowing thoroughly, investigation, thorough investigation, investigation of phenomena, discernment, sagacity, skill, analysis, reflection, understanding, intelligence, insight, comprehension, goad, wisdom; the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the weapon of wisdom, the palace of wisdom, the light of wisdom, the radiance of wisdom, the lamp of wisdom, the gem of wisdom, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, non-delusion, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-delusion on that occasion.

text: 35. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye anabhijjhā hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ asārāgo asārajjanā asārajjitattaṃ anabhijjhā alobho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye anabhijjhā hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the absence of covetousness ( anabh-ijjhā )?⤵Answer as for “disinterestedness”, § 32 .
original: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye anabhijjhā hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ asārāgo asārajjanā asārajjitattaṃ anabhijjhā alobho kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye anabhijjhā hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is non-covetousness?⤵That non-greed, not being greedy, the state of not being greedy, non-attachment, not being attached, the state of not being attached, non-covetousness, non-greed, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-covetousness on that occasion.

text: 36. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye abyāpādo hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ abyāpādo abyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye abyāpādo hoti.
rys_davids: What on that occasion is the absence of malice ( avyāpādo )?⤵Answer as for the “absence of hate”, § 33 .
original: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye abyāpādo hoti? Yo tasmiṃ samaye adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ abyāpādo abyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye abyāpādo hoti.
ai: What on that occasion is non-ill-will?⤵That non-hatred, not being hateful, the state of not being hateful, non-ill-will, not being malicious, non-hatred, a root of wholesome action, which there is on that occasion—this is non-ill-will on that occasion.

text: 37. Katamā tasmiṃ samaye sammādiṭṭhi hoti? Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
