This odor is the odor base, this is the odor element – this is that matter, the odor base.

text: 628. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ [lapilakaṃ (sī.)] kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yaṃ rasaṃ anidassanaṃ sappaṭighaṃ jivhāya anidassanāya sappaṭighāya sāyi vā sāyati vā sāyissati vā sāye vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: … in consequence of which odour and depending on the nose, there has arisen, arises, will, or may arise⤵olfactory contact …⤵and … born of that olfactory contact,⤵a feeling …⤵[or] a perception …⤵[or] volition …⤵[or] olfactory cognition;⤵… [further] having an odour as its object and depending on the nose, there has arisen, arises, will, or may arise⤵olfactory contact …⤵… and … born of that olfactory contact,⤵a feeling …⤵[or] a perception …⤵[or] volition …⤵[or] olfactory cognition;⤵this that is odour, the sphere and constituent element of odour—this is that [material] form which is the sphere of odours.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ [lapilakaṃ (sī.)] kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yaṃ rasaṃ anidassanaṃ sappaṭighaṃ jivhāya anidassanāya sappaṭighāya sāyi vā sāyati vā sāyissati vā sāye vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the taste-base?⤵That taste, derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, such as root taste, trunk taste, bark taste, leaf taste, flower taste, fruit taste, sour, sweet, bitter, pungent, salty, alkaline, acrid, astringent, agreeable, disagreeable, or any other taste derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, which taste, invisible and impinging, one has tasted, tastes, will taste, or may taste with the invisible and impinging tongue—this is taste, this is the taste-base, this is the taste-element. This is that material phenomenon which is the taste-base.

text: 629. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yamhi rasamhi anidassanamhi sappaṭighamhi jivhā anidassanā sappaṭighā paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the sphere of taste?⤵That taste which is derived from the four Great Phenomena, is invisible and reacting, such as the taste of roots, stems, bark, leaves, flowers, fruits, of sour, sweet, bitter, pungent, saline, alkaline, acrid, astringent, nice and nauseous sapids, or whatever other taste there is, derived from the four Great Phenomena, invisible and reacting—such tastes, invisible and reacting, as with the tongue, invisible and reacting, one has tasted, tastes, will, or may taste …
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yamhi rasamhi anidassanamhi sappaṭighamhi jivhā anidassanā sappaṭighā paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the taste-base?⤵That taste, derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, such as root taste, trunk taste, bark taste, leaf taste, flower taste, fruit taste, sour, sweet, bitter, pungent, salty, alkaline, acrid, astringent, agreeable, disagreeable, or any other taste derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, against which taste, invisible and impinging, the invisible and impinging tongue has impinged, impinges, will impinge, or may impinge—this is taste, this is the taste-base, this is the taste-element. This is that material phenomenon which is the taste-base.

text: 630. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yo raso anidassano sappaṭigho jivhāya anidassanāya sappaṭighāya paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: … against which taste, invisible and reacting, the tongue, invisible and impingeing, has impinged, impinges, will, or may impinge …
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yo raso anidassano sappaṭigho jivhāya anidassanāya sappaṭighāya paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the taste-base?⤵That taste, derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, such as root taste, trunk taste, bark taste, leaf taste, flower taste, fruit taste, sour, sweet, bitter, pungent, salty, alkaline, acrid, astringent, agreeable, disagreeable, or any other taste derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, which taste, invisible and impinging, has impinged, impinges, will impinge, or may impinge on the invisible and impinging tongue—this is taste, this is the taste-base, this is the taste-element. This is that material phenomenon which is the taste-base.

text: 631. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yaṃ rasaṃ ārabbha jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ rasaṃ ārabbha jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ rasārammaṇo jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ rasārammaṇā jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: … a taste which, invisible and reacting, has impinged, impinges, will, or may impinge on the tongue, invisible and reacting …
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ? Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādu, yo vā panaññopi atthi raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho, yaṃ rasaṃ ārabbha jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ rasaṃ ārabbha jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ rasārammaṇo jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ rasārammaṇā jivhaṃ nissāya jivhāsamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā, raso peso rasāyatanaṃ petaṃ rasadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rasāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the taste-base?⤵That taste, derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, such as root taste, trunk taste, bark taste, leaf taste, flower taste, fruit taste, sour, sweet, bitter, pungent, salty, alkaline, acrid, astringent, agreeable, disagreeable, or any other taste derived from the four great primaries, invisible and impinging, in consequence of which taste and depending on the tongue, gustatory contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵and, born of that gustatory contact, a feeling has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵[or] a perception⤵[or] volition⤵[or] gustatory consciousness;⤵further, having taste as its object and depending on the tongue, gustatory contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵and, born of that gustatory contact, a feeling has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵[or] a perception⤵[or] volition⤵[or] gustatory consciousness;⤵this is taste, this is the taste-base, this is the taste-element. This is that material phenomenon which is the taste-base.

text: 632. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ? Yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo [itthittaṃ itthībhāvo (syā.)] – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: … in consequence of which taste and depending on the tongue, there has arisen, arises, will, or may arise⤵gustatory contact …⤵… and, … born of that gustatory contact,⤵a feeling …⤵[or] a perception …⤵[or] volition …⤵[or] gustatory cognition,⤵[further] having a taste as its object and depending on the tongue, there has arisen, arises, will, or may arise⤵gustatory contact …⤵… and … born of that gustatory contact,⤵a feeling …⤵[or] a perception …⤵[or] volition …⤵[or] gustatory cognition,⤵this that is taste, the sphere and constituent element of taste—this is that form which is the sphere of taste.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ? Yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo [itthittaṃ itthībhāvo (syā.)] – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the faculty of femininity?⤵That which is of the female, the female sign, female mark, female characteristic, female deportment, femininity, female state—this is that material phenomenon which is the faculty of femininity.

text: 633. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ? Yaṃ purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is woman-faculty ( itthindriyaṃ )?⤵That which is of the female, feminine in appearance, feminine in characteristics, in occupation, in deportment, feminine in condition and being—this is that [material] form which constitutes woman-faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ? Yaṃ purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the faculty of masculinity?⤵That which is of the male, the male sign, male mark, male characteristic, male deportment, masculinity, male state—this is that material phenomenon which is the faculty of masculinity.

text: 634. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is man-faculty ( purisindriyaṃ )?⤵That which is of the male, masculine in appearance, masculine in characteristics, in occupation, in deportment, masculine in condition and being—this is that form which constitutes man-faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the life faculty?⤵That which is the duration, subsistence, maintenance, sustenance, activity, continuance, preservation, life, life faculty of these material phenomena—this is that material phenomenon which is the life faculty.

text: 635. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā abhikkamantassa vā paṭikkamantassa vā ālokentassa vā vilokentassa vā samiñjentassa vā pasārentassa vā kāyassa thambhanā santhambhanā santhambhitattaṃ viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is life-faculty ( jīvitindriyaṃ )?⤵The persistence of these corporeal states, their subsistence, their going on, their being kept going on, their progress, continuance, preservation, life, life as faculty—this is that [material] form which is life-faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā abhikkamantassa vā paṭikkamantassa vā ālokentassa vā vilokentassa vā samiñjentassa vā pasārentassa vā kāyassa thambhanā santhambhanā santhambhitattaṃ viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is bodily intimation?⤵That tension, intentness, stiffening of the body, in one who is advancing or retreating, looking or glancing around, bending or stretching, due to a wholesome mind or unwholesome mind or indeterminate mind; the intimation, the making known, the state of having made known—this is that material phenomenon which is bodily intimation.

text: 636. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā vācā girā byappatho udīraṇaṃ ghoso ghosakammaṃ vācā vacībhedo – ayaṃ vuccati vācā. Yā tāya vācāya viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is bodily intimation ( kāyaviññatti )?⤵That tension, that intentness, that state of making the body tense, in response to a thought, whether good, bad, or indeterminate, on the part of one who advances, or recedes, or fixes the gaze, or glances around, or retracts an arm, or stretches it forth—the intimation, the making known, the state of having made known—this is that [material] form which constitutes bodily intimation.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā vācā girā byappatho udīraṇaṃ ghoso ghosakammaṃ vācā vacībhedo – ayaṃ vuccati vācā. Yā tāya vācāya viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is vocal intimation?⤵That speech, voice, enunciation, utterance, noise, making noises, language as articulate speech, which is of a wholesome mind or unwholesome mind or indeterminate mind—this is called speech. And that intimation, making known, state of having made known by that speech—this is that material phenomenon which is vocal intimation.

text: 637. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu? Yo ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is intimation by language ( vaciviññatti )?⤵That speech, voice, enunciation, utterance, noise, making noises, language as articulate speech, which expresses a thought whether good, bad, or indeterminate—this is called language. And that intimation, that making known, the state of having made known by language—this is that [material] form which constitutes intimation by language.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu? Yo ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu.
ai: What is the material phenomenon that is the space element?⤵That which is space, spatiality, non-obstruction, aperture, uncontacted by the four great primaries—this is that material phenomenon which is the space element.

text: 638. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā? Yā rūpassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the element of space ( ākāsa-dhātu )?⤵That which is space and belongs to space, is sky and belongs to sky, is vacuum and belongs to vacuum, and is not in contact with the four Great Phenomena—this is that form which is the element of space.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā? Yā rūpassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā.
ai: What is that matter which is the lightness of matter?⤵That lightness of matter which is quick changeability, non-sluggishness, non-stiffness—this is that matter which is the lightness of matter.

text: 639. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā? Yā rūpassa mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā.
rys_davids: What is lightness of [material] form ( rūpassa lahutā )?⤵That lightness of form which is its capacity for changing easily, its freedom from sluggishness and inertia—this is lightness of [material] form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā? Yā rūpassa mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā.
ai: What is that matter which is the pliancy of matter?⤵That pliancy of matter which is softness, non-harshness, non-rigidity—this is that matter which is the pliancy of matter.

text: 640. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā? Yā rūpassa kammaññatā kammaññattaṃ kammaññabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā.
rys_davids: What is plasticity of [material] form?⤵That plasticity of form which is softness, smoothness, non-rigidity—this is plasticity of [material] form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā? Yā rūpassa kammaññatā kammaññattaṃ kammaññabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā.
ai: What is that matter which is the wieldiness of matter?⤵That wieldiness of matter which is fitness for work, suitability—this is that matter which is the wieldiness of matter.

text: 641. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo? Yo āyatanānaṃ ācayo, so rūpassa upacayo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo.
rys_davids: What is wieldiness of [material] form?⤵That which is its serviceableness, its workable condition—this is wieldiness of [material] form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo? Yo āyatanānaṃ ācayo, so rūpassa upacayo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo.
ai: What is that matter which is the growth of matter?⤵That which is the accumulation of the sense bases, that is the growth of matter—this is that matter which is the growth of matter.

text: 642. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati? Yo rūpassa upacayo, sā rūpassa santati – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati.
rys_davids: What is integration ( upacayo ) of [material] form?⤵That which is accumulation of form is [also] integration of [material] form—this is integration of [material] form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati? Yo rūpassa upacayo, sā rūpassa santati – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati.
ai: What is that matter which is the continuity of matter?⤵That which is the growth of matter, that is the continuity of matter—this is that matter which is the continuity of matter.

text: 643. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā? Yā rūpassa jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā.
rys_davids: What is subsistence of [material] form ( rūpassa santati )?⤵That which is integration of form is the subsistence of form. This is subsistence of [material] form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā? Yā rūpassa jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā.
ai: What is that matter which is the decay of matter?⤵That decay of matter which is old age, decay, brokenness, greyness, wrinkling of skin, decline of life, ripening of the faculties—this is that matter which is the decay of matter.

text: 644. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā? Yo rūpassa khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā.
rys_davids: What is decay of [material] form ( rūpassa jaratā )?⤵That decay of form which is ageing, decrepitude, hoariness, wrinkles, the shrinkage in length of days, the hypermaturity of faculties—this is decay of [material] form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā? Yo rūpassa khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā.
ai: What is that matter which is the impermanence of matter?⤵That impermanence of matter which is destruction, passing away, breaking up, complete breaking up, impermanence, disappearance—this is that matter which is the impermanence of matter.

text: 645. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ yamhi yamhi janapade tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ mukhāsiyaṃ dantavikhādanaṃ galajjhoharaṇīyaṃ kucchivitthambhanaṃ, yāya ojāya sattā yāpenti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
rys_davids: What is impermanence of [material] form ( rūpassa aniccatā )?⤵The destruction, disease, breaking-up, dissolution of form, the impermanence which is decline—this is impermanence of form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ yamhi yamhi janapade tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ mukhāsiyaṃ dantavikhādanaṃ galajjhoharaṇīyaṃ kucchivitthambhanaṃ, yāya ojāya sattā yāpenti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
ai: What is that matter which is edible food?⤵Rice, gruel, flour, fish, meat, milk, curds, ghee, fresh butter, oil, honey, molasses, or any other matter which in any country serves as food for beings, to be put into the mouth, chewed by the teeth, swallowed down the throat, filling the stomach, by the nutrient essence of which beings subsist—this is that matter which is edible food.

text: Idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā.
original: Idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā.
ai: This is that matter which is derived.

text: Upādābhājanīyaṃ.
original: Upādābhājanīyaṃ.
ai: The section on derived matter.

text: Rūpakaṇḍe paṭhamabhāṇavāro.
original: Rūpakaṇḍe paṭhamabhāṇavāro.
ai: First section for recitation in the Chapter on Materiality.

text: 646. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, āpodhātu.
rys_davids: What is bodily (solid) nutriment ( kabaḷinkāro āhāro )?⤵Boiled rice, sour gruel, flour, fish, flesh, milk, curds, butter, cheese, tila-oil, cane-syrup, or whatever else there is in whatever region that by living beings may be eaten, chewed, swallowed, digested into the juice, by which living beings are kept alive—this is bodily nutriment.⤵[All] this is [material] form which is derived.⤵[End of] the Section on Derivatives. First Portion for Recitation in the Division on [material] Form.⤵There is [material] form which is not derived” ( no upāda )
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, āpodhātu.
ai: What is that materiality not clung to? The tangible base, the water element.

text: 647. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ anidassanaṃ sappaṭighaṃ kāyena anidassanena sappaṭighena phusi vā phusati vā phusissati vā phuse vā phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not derived?⤵The sphere of the tangible, the fluid element—this is that [material] form which is not derived.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ anidassanaṃ sappaṭighaṃ kāyena anidassanena sappaṭighena phusi vā phusati vā phusissati vā phuse vā phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that materiality, the tangible base? The earth element, fire element, air element; hard, soft, smooth, rough, pleasant to touch, painful to touch, heavy, light; that tangible, non-apparent, impinging, which the non-apparent, impinging body has touched, touches, will touch, or may touch—this is that materiality, the tangible base.

text: 648. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yamhi phoṭṭhabbamhi anidassanamhi sappaṭighamhi kāyo anidassano sappaṭigho paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the sphere of the tangible ( phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ )?⤵The earthy (solid) element, the lambent (calorific) element, the gaseous (aerial) element; the hard and the soft; the smooth and the rough; pleasant (easeful) contact, painful contact; the heavy and the light—such a tangible, invisible and reacting, as, with the body-sensibility, invisible and reacting, one has touched, touches, will, or may touch …
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yamhi phoṭṭhabbamhi anidassanamhi sappaṭighamhi kāyo anidassano sappaṭigho paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that materiality, the tangible base? The earth element, fire element, air element; hard, soft, smooth, rough, pleasant to touch, painful to touch, heavy, light; that tangible, non-apparent, impinging, against which the non-apparent, impinging body has impinged, impinges, will impinge, or may impinge—this is that materiality, the tangible base.

text: 649. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yo phoṭṭhabbo anidassano sappaṭigho kāyamhi anidassanamhi sappaṭighamhi paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: … against which tangible, invisible, and reacting, the body-sensibility, invisible and reacting, has impinged, impinges, will, or may impinge …
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yo phoṭṭhabbo anidassano sappaṭigho kāyamhi anidassanamhi sappaṭighamhi paṭihaññi vā paṭihaññati vā paṭihaññissati vā paṭihaññe vā, phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that materiality, the tangible base? The earth element, fire element, air element; hard, soft, smooth, rough, pleasant to touch, painful to touch, heavy, light; that tangible, non-apparent, impinging, which has impinged, impinges, will impinge, or may impinge on the non-apparent, impinging body—this is that materiality, the tangible base.

text: 650. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ ārabbha kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ ārabbha kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ phoṭṭhabbārammaṇo kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ phoṭṭhabbārammaṇā kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā, phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: … such a tangible, invisible and reacting, as has impinged, impinges, will, or may impinge against the body-sensibility, invisible and reacting …
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukaṃ, yaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ ārabbha kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ ārabbha kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ phoṭṭhabbārammaṇo kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphasso uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā…pe… yaṃ phoṭṭhabbārammaṇā kāyaṃ nissāya kāyasamphassajā vedanā…pe… saññā…pe… cetanā…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajji vā uppajjati vā uppajjissati vā uppajje vā, phoṭṭhabbo peso phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ petaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that materiality, the tangible base? The earth element, fire element, air element; hard, soft, smooth, rough, pleasant to touch, painful to touch, heavy, light; that tangible, concerning which, depending on the body, bodily contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵and, born of that bodily contact, feeling has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵perception has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵volition has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵body-consciousness has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵further, that which has the tangible as its object, depending on the body, bodily contact has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵and, born of that bodily contact, feeling has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵perception has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵volition has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise⤵body-consciousness has arisen, arises, will arise, or may arise—this is that materiality, the tangible base.

text: 651. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu.
rys_davids: … in consequence of which tangible and depending on the body-sensibility, there has arisen, arises, will, or may arise⤵bodily contact …⤵and … born of that bodily contact,⤵a feeling …⤵[or] a perception …⤵[or] volition …⤵[or] cognition of body …⤵[further,] having a tangible as its object and depending on the body(-sensibility), there has arisen, arises, will or may arise⤵bodily contact …⤵and … born of that bodily contact,⤵a feeling …⤵[or] a perception …⤵[or] volition …⤵[or] cognition of body …⤵this that is the tangible, the sphere and element of the tangible—this is that form which is the sphere of the tangible.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu.
ai: What is that materiality, the water element? That which is water, watery, cohesion, cohesive, the binding quality of materiality—this is that materiality, the water element.

text: Idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā.
original: Idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā.
ai: This is that materiality not clung to.

text: 652. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ sotāyatanaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ jivhāyatanaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the fluid (aqueous) element ( āpodhātu )?⤵That which is fluid and belongs to fluid, that which is viscid and belongs to viscous, the cohesiveness of form—this is that [material] form which is the fluid element.⤵[All] this is that form which is not derived.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ sotāyatanaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ jivhāyatanaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: What is that materiality clung to? The eye base, ear base, nose base, tongue base, body base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty; or whatever other materiality there is produced by kamma, visible object base, smell base, taste base, tangible base, space element, water element, growth of materiality, continuity of materiality, bodily nutriment—this is that materiality clung to.

text: 653. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is grasped at ( upādiṇṇaṃ )?⤵The spheres of sight, hearing, smell, taste, body-sensibility, femininity, masculinity, life, or whatever form there exists through karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of visible forms, odours, tastes, or the tangible; the element of space, the fluid element, the integration or the subsistence of [material] form, or bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is grasped at.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: What is that materiality not clung to? The sound base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of materiality, malleability of materiality, wieldiness of materiality, decay of materiality, impermanence of materiality; or whatever other materiality there is not produced by kamma, visible object base, smell base, taste base, tangible base, space element, water element, growth of materiality, continuity of materiality, bodily nutriment—this is that materiality not clung to.

text: 654. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not grasped at?⤵The sphere of sound, bodily and vocal intimation, lightness, plasticity and wieldiness of [material] form, its decay and impermanence, of whatever other [material] form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought, whether it be in the sphere of visible forms, smells, tastes, or the tangible; the element of space or that of fluidity; the integration or the subsistence of [material] form, or bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not grasped at.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is grasped and graspable?⤵The eye base...pe...body base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty; or whatever other matter exists due to kamma, including visible form base, smell base, taste base, tangible base, space element, water element, production of matter, continuity of matter, and edible food—this is that matter which is grasped and graspable.

text: 655. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā, rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is both grasped at and favourable to grasping ( upādiṇṇ' upādāniyaṃ )?⤵The spheres of the five senses, femininity, masculinity and life, or whatever other form exists through karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of visible forms, odours, tastes or the tangible, in the elements of space or fluidity, in the integration or the subsistence of form, or in bodily nutriment—this is that form which is both grasped at and favourable to grasping.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā, rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ungrasped but graspable?⤵Sound base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, decay of matter, impermanence of matter; or whatever other matter exists not due to kamma, including visible form base, smell base, taste base, tangible base, space element, water element, production of matter, continuity of matter, and edible food—this is that matter which is ungrasped but graspable.

text: 656. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sanidassanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not grasped at, but is favourable to grasping ( anupādiṇṇ' upādāniyaṃ )?⤵The sphere of sounds, bodily and vocal intimation, the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, decay and impermanence of form, or whatever other form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought, whether it be in the sphere of visible shapes, smells, tastes, the tangible, in the element of space or of fluidity, in the integration, or the subsistence of form, or in bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not grasped at but is favourable to grasping.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sanidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is visible?⤵The visible form base—this is that matter which is visible.

text: 657. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is visible?⤵The sphere of visible shapes—this is that [material] form which is visible.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is invisible?⤵The eye base...pe...edible food—this is that matter which is invisible.

text: 658. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ sotāyatanaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ jivhāyatanaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is invisible?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is invisible.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ sotāyatanaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ jivhāyatanaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter with impingement?⤵The eye base, ear base, nose base, tongue base, body base, visible form base, sound base, smell base, taste base, tangible base—this is that matter with impingement.

text: 659. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ appaṭighaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which reacts-and-impinges ( sappaṭighaṃ )?⤵The spheres of vision, hearing, smell, taste, body-sensibility; the spheres of visible shapes, sounds, smells, tastes, tangibles—this is that [material] form which reacts-and-impinges.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ appaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter without impingement?⤵The femininity faculty...pe...edible food—this is that matter without impingement.

text: 660. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ indriyaṃ? Cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyaṃ kāyindriyaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ indriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which does not react-or-impinge?⤵Femininity … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which does not react-or-impinge.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ indriyaṃ? Cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyaṃ kāyindriyaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ indriyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is a faculty?⤵The eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty—this is that matter which is a faculty.

text: 661. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is faculty ( indriyaṃ )?⤵The faculties (or personal potentialities) of vision, hearing, smell, taste, body-sensibility, woman, man, life—this is that form which is faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is not a faculty?⤵The visible form base...pe...edible food—this is that matter which is not a faculty.

text: 662. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is not faculty?⤵The spheres of visible form … and bodily nutriment—this is that form which is not faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is a great element?⤵The tangible base and the water element—this is that matter which is a great element.

text: 663. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is Great Phenomenon ( mahābhūtaṃ )?⤵The sphere of the tangible and the element of fluidity—this is that [material] form which is Great Phenomenon.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is not a great element?⤵The eye base...pe...edible food—this is that matter which is not a great element.

text: 664. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ viññatti? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ viññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not Great Phenomenon?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not Great Phenomenon.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ viññatti? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ viññatti.
ai: What is that material form which is intimation?⤵Bodily intimation, vocal intimation—this is that material form which is intimation.

text: 665. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na viññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na viññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is intimation, ( viññatti )?⤵Bodily and vocal intimation—this is that [material] form which is intimation.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na viññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na viññatti.
ai: What is that material form which is not intimation?⤵The eye-base...edible food—this is that material form which is not intimation.

text: 666. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not intimation?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not intimation.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is mind-originated?⤵Bodily intimation, vocal intimation, or whatever other material form exists that is born of mind, caused by mind, has its source in mind: visible form, sound, smell, taste, tangible object, space element, water element, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, production of matter, continuity of matter, edible food—this is that material form which is mind-originated.

text: 667. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na cittajaṃ na cittahetukaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is sprung from thought ( citta-samuṭṭhānaṃ )?⤵Bodily and vocal intimation, or whatever other [material] form exists that is born of mind, caused by mind, has its source in mind, whether it be in the sphere of visible shapes, sounds, odours, tastes or tangibles, in the spatial, or the fluid element, in the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, integration or subsistence of form, or in bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is sprung from mind.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na cittajaṃ na cittahetukaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not mind-originated?⤵The eye-base...body-base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, decay of matter, impermanence of matter, or whatever other material form exists that is not born of mind, not caused by mind, does not have its source in mind: visible form, sound, smell, taste, tangible object, space element, water element, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, production of matter, continuity of matter, edible food—this is that material form which is not mind-originated.

text: 668. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasahabhu? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasahabhu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not sprung from mind?⤵The sphere of the five senses, femininity, masculinity and life, the decay and the impermanence of [material] form, or whatever other [material] form exists that is not born of mind, not caused by mind, does not have its source in mind, whether it be in the sphere of visible forms, sounds, odours, tastes, or tangibles, in the spatial or fluid element, in the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, integration or subsistence of [material] form, or in bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not sprung from mind.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasahabhu? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittasahabhu.
ai: What is that material form which is co-arising with mind?⤵Bodily intimation, vocal intimation—this is that material form which is co-arising with mind.

text: 669. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasahabhu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasahabhu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which comes into being together with mind ( citta-saha-bhū )?
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasahabhu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittasahabhu.
ai: What is that material form which is not co-arising with mind?⤵The eye-base...edible food—this is that material form which is not co-arising with mind.

text: 670. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittānuparivatti? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittānuparivatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which does not come into being together with mind?⤵Answers as in the preceding pair of relatives.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittānuparivatti? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cittānuparivatti.
ai: What is that material form which is following the mind?⤵Bodily intimation, vocal intimation—this is that material form which is following the mind.

text: 671. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittānuparivatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittānuparivatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is consecutive to mind ( citt' ānuparivatti )?
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittānuparivatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cittānuparivatti.
ai: What is that material form which is not following the mind?⤵The eye-base...edible food—this is that material form which is not following the mind.

text: 672. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not consecutive to mind?⤵Answers as in the preceding pair of relatives.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal?⤵The eye-base...body-base—this is that material form which is internal.

text: 673. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which belongs to the self ( ajjhattikaṃ )?⤵The spheres of the five senses—this is that [material] form which belongs to the self.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is external?⤵Visible form...edible food—this is that material form which is external.

text: 674. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ oḷārikaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is external (to the self— bāhiraṃ )?⤵The sphere of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is external (to the self).
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ oḷārikaṃ.
ai: What is that gross material form? The eye-base... and so on... the tangible-base—this is that gross material form.

text: 675. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sukhumaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sukhumaṃ.
rys_davids: Which is that [material] form which is gross ( oḷārikaṃ )?⤵The spheres of the five senses and of the five kinds of sense-objects—this is that [material] form which is gross.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sukhumaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sukhumaṃ.
ai: What is that subtle material form? The femininity faculty... and so on... nutriment—this is that subtle material form.

text: 676. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ dūre? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ dūre.
rys_davids: Which is that [material] form which is subtle ( sukhumaṃ )?⤵Woman-faculty … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is subtle.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ dūre? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ dūre.
ai: What is that distant material form? The femininity faculty... and so on... nutriment—this is that distant material form.

text: 677. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ santike? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ santike.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is remote ( dūre )?⤵Woman-faculty … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is remote.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ santike? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ santike.
ai: What is that near material form? The eye-base... and so on... the tangible-base—this is that near material form.

text: 678. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is near ( santike )?⤵The spheres of the five senses and of the five kinds of sense-objects—this is that [material] form which is near.⤵Basis ( vatthu )
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is the basis of eye-contact? The eye-base—this is that material form which is the basis of eye-contact.

text: 679. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa na vatthu? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa na vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the basis of visual contact ( cakkhusamphassassa vatthu )?⤵The sphere of vision—this is that [material] form which is the basis of visual contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa na vatthu? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa na vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the basis of eye-contact? The ear-base... and so on... nutriment—this is that material form which is not the basis of eye-contact.

text: 680. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya…pe… saññāya…pe… cetanāya …pe… cakkhuviññāṇassa vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the basis of visual contact?⤵The sphere of hearing … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not, etc.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya…pe… saññāya…pe… cetanāya …pe… cakkhuviññāṇassa vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is the basis of the feeling... and so on... the perception... and so on... the volition... and so on... the eye-consciousness born of eye-contact? The eye-base—this is that material form which is the basis of eye-consciousness.

text: 681. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa na vatthu? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa na vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the basis of⤵the feeling …⤵the perception …⤵the volition …⤵the visual cognition⤵which is born of visual contact?⤵The sphere of vision—this is that [material] form which is the basis of the … visual cognition which is born of visual contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa na vatthu? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa na vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the basis of eye-consciousness? The ear-base... and so on... nutriment—this is that material form which is not the basis of eye-consciousness.

text: 682. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotasamphassassa…pe… ghānasamphassassa…pe… jivhāsamphassassa…pe… kāyasamphassassa vatthu? Kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the basis of the … visual cognition born of visual contact?⤵The sphere of hearing … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not the basis of the … visual cognition born of visual contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotasamphassassa…pe… ghānasamphassassa…pe… jivhāsamphassassa…pe… kāyasamphassassa vatthu? Kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is the basis of ear-contact... and so on... nose-contact... and so on... tongue-contact... and so on... body-contact? The body-base—this is that material form which is the basis of body-contact.

text: 683. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa na vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa na vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that form which is the basis of⤵auditory …⤵olfactory …⤵gustatory …⤵bodily⤵contact?⤵The sphere of … body-sensibility—this is that [material] form which is the basis of … bodily contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa na vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa na vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the basis of body-contact? The eye-base... and so on... nutriment—this is that material form which is not the basis of body-contact.

text: 684. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassajāya vedanāya…pe… saññāya…pe… cetanāya…pe… kāyaviññāṇassa vatthu? Kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the basis of … bodily contact?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not the basis of … bodily contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassajāya vedanāya…pe… saññāya…pe… cetanāya…pe… kāyaviññāṇassa vatthu? Kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is the basis of⤵the feeling…⤵the perception…⤵the volition…⤵the body-consciousness⤵that is born of bodily contact?⤵The body-base—this is that material form which is the basis for body-consciousness.

text: 685. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa na vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa na vatthu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the basis of⤵the feeling …⤵the perception …⤵the volition …⤵the … cognition of body⤵that is born of … bodily contact?⤵The sphere … of body-sensibility—this is that [material] form which is the basis of the … cognition of body that is born of … bodily contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa na vatthu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa na vatthu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the basis for body-consciousness?⤵The eye-base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the basis for body-consciousness.

text: 686. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa ārammaṇaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa ārammaṇaṃ.

ai: What is that material form which is the object in visual contact?⤵The visible form-base—this is that material form which is the object in visual contact.

text: 687. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa na ārammaṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhusamphassassa na ārammaṇaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the object in visual contact?⤵The sphere of visible forms—this is that [material] form which is the object in visual contact.

ai: What is that material form which is not the object in visual contact?⤵The eye-base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the object in visual contact.

ai: What is that material form which is the object in⤵the feeling…⤵the perception…⤵the volition…⤵the eye-consciousness⤵that is born of visual contact?⤵The visible form-base—this is that material form which is the object for eye-consciousness.

rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the object in⤵the feeling …⤵the perception …⤵the volition …⤵the visual cognition⤵that is born of visual contact?⤵The sphere of visible shapes—this is that [material] form which is the object in … the visual cognition that is born of visual contact.

rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the object in⤵auditory …⤵olfactory …⤵gustatory …⤵bodily⤵contact?⤵The sphere of … the tangible—this is that [material] form which is the object in … bodily contact.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa na ārammaṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassassa na ārammaṇaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the object in bodily contact?⤵The eye-base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the object in bodily contact.

text: 692. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyasamphassajāya vedanāya…pe… saññāya…pe… cetanāya…pe… kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇaṃ.

rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the object in⤵the feeling …⤵the perception …⤵the volition …⤵the … cognition of body⤵that is born of … bodily contact?⤵The sphere of the tangible—this is that [material] form which is the object in the … cognition of body that is born of … bodily contact.

text: 694. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the object in the … cognition of body that is born of bodily contact?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not the object, etc.⤵Sphere of sense ( āyatanaṃ )
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the eye sense base? That eye, which is sensitive matter derived from the four great primaries… like an empty village—this is that material form which is the eye sense base.

text: 695. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhāyatanaṃ? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the sphere of vision?⤵The eye, that is to say, the sentient organ which is derived from the four Great Phenomena … this that is “an empty village”—this is that [material] form which is the sphere of vision.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhāyatanaṃ? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the eye sense base? The ear sense base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the eye sense base.

text: 696. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotāyatanaṃ…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ? Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ.

original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotāyatanaṃ…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ? Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the ear sense base… the nose sense base… the tongue sense base… the body sense base? That body, which is sensitive matter derived from the four great primaries… like an empty village—this is that material form which is the body sense base.

text: 697. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyāyatanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the sphere of⤵hearing …⤵smell …⤵taste …⤵body-sensibility?⤵The body, that is to say, the sentient organ which is derived from the four Great Phenomena … this that is “an empty village”—this is that [material] form which is the sphere of … body-sensibility.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyāyatanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the body sense base? The eye sense base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the body sense base.

text: 698. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ rūpaṃ catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya vaṇṇanibhā…pe… rūpadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ.

ai: What is that material form which is the visible form sense base? That visible form, which is color and appearance derived from the four great primaries… visible form element—this is that material form which is the visible form sense base.

text: 699. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpāyatanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the sphere of visible shapes?⤵That form which, derived from the four Great Phenomena, is visible under the appearance of colour … this … which is the constituent element of visible form—this is that [material] form which is the sphere of visible forms.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpāyatanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the visible form sense base? The eye sense base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the visible form sense base.

rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the sphere of visible shapes?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is that [material] form which is not, etc.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ …pe… rasāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ? Pathavīdhātu…pe… phoṭṭhabbadhātu pesā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the sound sense base… the smell sense base… the taste sense base… the tangible sense base? The earth element… tangible element—this is that material form which is the tangible sense base.

text: 701. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the sphere of⤵sound,⤵odour,⤵taste,⤵the tangible?⤵The earthy (solid) element … this that is the … element of the tangible—this is that [material] form which is the sphere of the tangible.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the tangible sense base? The eye sense base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the tangible sense base.

text: 702. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhudhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhudhātu.

original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhudhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhudhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is the eye element? The eye sense base—this is that material form which is the eye element.

text: 703. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhudhātu? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhudhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the element of vision?⤵The sphere of vision—this is that [material] form which is the element of vision.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhudhātu? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhudhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the eye element? The ear sense base… and edible food—this is that material form which is not the eye element.

text: 704. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotadhātu…pe… ghānadhātu…pe… jivhādhātu…pe… kāyadhātu? Kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyadhātu.

ai: What is that material form which is the ear-element ⤵ the nose-element ⤵ the tongue-element ⤵ the body-element? The body-base—this material form is the body-element.

text: 705. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the element of visible shape?⤵The sphere of visible shape—this is … the element of visible shape.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyadhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the body-element? The eye-base ⤵ and edible food—this material form is not the body-element.

text: 706. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpadhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the element of visible shape?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is … not, etc.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpadhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpadhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is the visible-form-element? The visible-form-base—this material form is the visible-form-element.

text: 707. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the element of sound … of odour … of taste … of the tangible?⤵The sphere of … the tangible—this is … the element of the tangible.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na rūpadhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the visible-form-element? The eye-base ⤵ and edible food—this material form is not the visible-form-element.

text: 708. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ saddadhātu…pe… gandhadhātu…pe… rasadhātu…pe… phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the element of the tangible?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is … not the element of the tangible.⤵Faculty ( indriyaṃ )
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ saddadhātu…pe… gandhadhātu…pe… rasadhātu…pe… phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is the sound-element ⤵ the smell-element ⤵ the taste-element ⤵ the tangible-element? The tangible-base—this material form is the tangible-element.

text: 709. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the faculty of vision?⤵The eye, that is to say, the sentient organ which is derived from the four Great Phenomena … this that is “an empty village”—this is … the faculty of vision.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
ai: What is that material form which is not the tangible-element? The eye-base ⤵ and edible food—this material form is not the tangible-element.

text: 710. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the faculty of vision?⤵The sphere of hearing … and bodily nutriment—this is … not, etc.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the eye-faculty? That eye, which is the sensitive matter derived from the four great primaries ⤵ like an empty village—this material form is the eye-faculty.

text: 711. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the faculty of hearing … smell … taste … body-sensibility?⤵The … body, that is to say, the sentient principle, which is derived from the four Great Phenomena … this that is “an empty village”—this is … the faculty of … body sensibility.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the eye-faculty? The ear-base ⤵ and edible food—this material form is not the eye-faculty.

text: 712. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotindriyaṃ…pe… ghānindriyaṃ…pe… jivhindriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ? Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyindriyaṃ.
