original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotindriyaṃ…pe… ghānindriyaṃ…pe… jivhindriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ? Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the ear-faculty ⤵ the nose-faculty ⤵ the tongue-faculty ⤵ the body-faculty? That body, which is the sensitive matter derived from the four great primaries ⤵ like an empty village—this material form is the body-faculty.

text: 713. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is woman-faculty?⤵That which is of the female, feminine in appearance, characteristics, occupation, and deportment, feminine in condition and being—this is that form which is woman-faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not the body-faculty? The eye-base ⤵ and edible food—this material form is not the body-faculty.

text: 714. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ? Yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is man-faculty?⤵That which is of the male, masculine in appearance, characteristics, occupation, and deportment, masculine in condition and being—this is that form which is man-faculty.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ? Yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ itthindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material phenomenon, the female faculty?⤵That which is a woman's female sign, female mark, female characteristic, female appearance, femaleness, female state—this is that material phenomenon, the female faculty.

text: 715. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na itthindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na itthindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not man-faculty?⤵Answer as in § 713a .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na itthindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na itthindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not the female faculty?⤵The eye-base...pe...edible food—this is that material phenomenon which is not the female faculty.

text: 716. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ? Yaṃ purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is (the faculty of) life?⤵The persistence of these corporeal states, their subsistence, their going on, their being kept going on, their progress, continuance, preservation, life, life as faculty—this is … (the faculty of) life.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ? Yaṃ purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ purisindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material phenomenon, the male faculty?⤵That which is a man's male sign, male mark, male characteristic, male appearance, maleness, male state—this is that material phenomenon, the male faculty.

text: 717. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na purisindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na purisindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not (the faculty of) life?⤵Answer as in § 713a .⤵Intimation ( viññatti )
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na purisindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na purisindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not the male faculty?⤵The eye-base...pe...edible food—this is that material phenomenon which is not the male faculty.

text: 718. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is bodily intimation?⤵Answer as in § 636 .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material phenomenon, the life faculty?⤵That which is the life, duration, maintenance, sustenance, carrying on, continuance, preservation, life, life faculty of those material phenomena—this is that material phenomenon, the life faculty.

text: 719. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not bodily intimation?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is … bodily intimation.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not the life faculty?⤵The eye-base...pe...edible food—this is that material phenomenon which is not the life faculty.

text: 720. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā abhikkamantassa vā paṭikkamantassa vā ālokentassa vā vilokentassa vā samiñjentassa vā pasārentassa vā kāyassa thambhanā santhambhanā santhambhitattaṃ viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is vocal intimation?⤵Answer as in § 637 .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā abhikkamantassa vā paṭikkamantassa vā ālokentassa vā vilokentassa vā samiñjentassa vā pasārentassa vā kāyassa thambhanā santhambhanā santhambhitattaṃ viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kāyaviññatti.
ai: What is that material phenomenon, bodily intimation?⤵That which, when a wholesome mind, or an unwholesome mind, or an indeterminate mind is advancing or retreating, looking forward or around, bending or stretching, is the body's stiffening, making stiff, state of being stiffened, intimation, making known, state of being made known—this is that material phenomenon, bodily intimation.

text: 721. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyaviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyaviññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not vocal intimation?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is … not, etc.⤵Space and fluid
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyaviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kāyaviññatti.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not bodily intimation?⤵The eye-base...pe...edible food—this is that material phenomenon which is not bodily intimation.

text: 722. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā vācā girā byappatho udīraṇaṃ ghoso ghosakammaṃ vācā vacībhedo, ayaṃ vuccati vācā. Yā tāya vācāya viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the element of space?⤵That which is space and belongs to space, is sky, belongs to sky, is vacuum, belongs to vacuum, and is not in contact with the four Great Phenomena—this is … the element of space.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā vācā girā byappatho udīraṇaṃ ghoso ghosakammaṃ vācā vacībhedo, ayaṃ vuccati vācā. Yā tāya vācāya viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vacīviññatti.
ai: What is that material phenomenon, vocal intimation?⤵That which, when a wholesome mind, or an unwholesome mind, or an indeterminate mind, is speech, utterance, declaration, articulation, sound, act of sounding, speech, differentiation of speech—this is called speech. That which is the intimation, making known, state of being made known by that speech—this is that material phenomenon, vocal intimation.

text: 723. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na vacīviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na vacīviññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the element of space?⤵Answer as § 721 .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na vacīviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na vacīviññatti.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not vocal intimation?⤵The eye-base...pe...edible food—this is that material phenomenon which is not vocal intimation.

text: 724. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu? Yo ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the element of fluidity?⤵That which is fluid and belongs to fluid, that which is viscid and belongs to viscid, the cohesiveness of form—this is … the element of fluidity.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu? Yo ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ākāsadhātu.
ai: What is that matter, the space element?⤵That space, spatial, gap, characterized by gap, opening, characterized by opening, uncontacted by the four great elements – this is that matter, the space element.

text: 725. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na ākāsadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ …pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na ākāsadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the element of fluidity?⤵Answer as in § 721 .⤵Modes of form
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na ākāsadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ …pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na ākāsadhātu.
ai: What is that matter which is not the space element?⤵The eye-base… up to edible food – this is that matter which is not the space element.

text: 726. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is lightness of form?⤵That lightness of form which is its capacity for changing easily, its freedom from sluggishness and inertia—this is … lightness of form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu.
ai: What is that matter, the water element?⤵That water, watery, cohesion, characterized by cohesion, the binding nature of matter – this is that matter, the water element.

text: 727. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na āpodhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na āpodhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not lightness of form?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is … not lightness of form.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na āpodhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na āpodhātu.
ai: What is that matter which is not the water element?⤵The eye-base… up to edible food – this is that matter which is not the water element.

text: 728. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā? Yā rūpassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā .
rys_davids: Questions on the other two modes of form “plasticity” and “wieldiness” are answered by the descriptions given in §§ 640 , 641 . The corresponding contradictory terms are described in the same terms as in § 727 , viz.: as in § 596 , with the omissions and insertion as indicated.⤵Evolution of (material) form
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā? Yā rūpassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa lahutā .
ai: What is that matter, the lightness of matter?⤵That lightness of matter, quick changeability, non-sluggishness, non-expansiveness – this is that matter, the lightness of matter.

text: 729. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na lahutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na lahutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na lahutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na lahutā.
ai: What is that matter which is not the lightness of matter?⤵The eye-base… up to edible food – this is that matter which is not the lightness of matter.

text: 730. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā? Yā rūpassa mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā? Yā rūpassa mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa mudutā.
ai: What is that matter, the malleability of matter?⤵That malleability of matter, softness, non-harshness, non-stiffness – this is that matter, the malleability of matter.

text: 731. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na mudutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na mudutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na mudutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na mudutā.
ai: What is that matter which is not the malleability of matter?⤵The eye-base… up to edible food – this is that matter which is not the malleability of matter.

text: 732. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā? Yā rūpassa kammaññatā kammaññattaṃ kammaññabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is the integration of form?⤵That which is accumulation of [material] form is the integration of form—this is, etc.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā? Yā rūpassa kammaññatā kammaññattaṃ kammaññabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa kammaññatā.
ai: What is that matter, the workability of matter?⤵That workability of matter, suitability for action, state of being workable – this is that matter, the workability of matter.

text: 733. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not the integration of form?⤵The sphere of vision … and bodily nutriment—this is … not, etc.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā.
ai: What is that matter which is not the workability of matter?⤵The eye-base… up to edible food – this is that matter which is not the workability of matter.

text: 734. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo? Yo āyatanānaṃ ācayo, so rūpassa upacayo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo.
rys_davids: Question on the “subsistence”, “decay”, and “impermanence” of form and their contradictories are answered analogously with those in the group on “Modes of form”, the three positives being described as in §§ 642 – 645 .⤵Nutrition
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo? Yo āyatanānaṃ ācayo, so rūpassa upacayo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa upacayo.
ai: What is the growth of matter? That which is the accumulation of the bases is the growth of matter. This is the growth of matter.

text: 735. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na upacayo? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na upacayo.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na upacayo? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na upacayo.
ai: What is not the growth of matter? The eye-base…etc.…edible food—this is not the growth of matter.

text: 736. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati? Yo rūpassa upacayo, sā rūpassa santati – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati? Yo rūpassa upacayo, sā rūpassa santati – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa santati.
ai: What is the continuity of matter? That which is the growth of matter is the continuity of matter. This is the continuity of matter.

text: 737. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na santati? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na santati.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na santati? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na santati.
ai: What is not the continuity of matter? The eye-base…etc.…edible food—this is not the continuity of matter.

text: 738. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā? Yā rūpassa jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā? Yā rūpassa jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa jaratā.
ai: What is the aging of matter? That which is the decay of matter, its wearing out, breaking up, greying, wrinkling, decline of life-span, and ripening of the faculties—this is the aging of matter.

text: 739. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na jaratā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na jaratā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na jaratā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na jaratā.
ai: What is not the aging of matter? The eye-base…etc.…edible food—this is not the aging of matter.

text: 740. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā? Yo rūpassa khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is bodily nutriment?⤵This is answered as in § 646 .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā? Yo rūpassa khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa aniccatā.
ai: What is the impermanence of matter? That which is the wearing away of matter, its dissolution, breaking up, complete breaking up, impermanence, and disappearance—this is the impermanence of matter.

text: 741. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is not bodily nutriment?⤵The sphere of vision … and the impermanence of form—this is … is not bodily nutriment.⤵Such are the Categories of [material] Form under Dual Aspects.⤵[End of] the Exposition of the Pairs.⤵[Material] Form under a Triple Aspect⤵Exposition of the Triplets
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā.
ai: What is not the impermanence of matter? The eye-base…etc.…edible food—this is not the impermanence of matter.

text: 742. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ yamhi yamhi janapade tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ mukhāsiyaṃ dantavikhādanaṃ galajjhoharaṇīyaṃ kucchivitthambhanaṃ, yāya ojāya sattā yāpenti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and derived?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and derived?⤵The sphere of visible shapes … and bodily nutriment.⤵external and not derived?⤵The sphere of the tangible and the fluid element.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ yamhi yamhi janapade tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ mukhāsiyaṃ dantavikhādanaṃ galajjhoharaṇīyaṃ kucchivitthambhanaṃ, yāya ojāya sattā yāpenti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
ai: What is edible food? Rice, gruel, flour, fish, meat, milk, curd, ghee, fresh butter, oil, honey, molasses, or whatever other matter exists in any country, which is put into the mouth, chewed by the teeth, swallowed down the throat, filling the stomach, by the nutrient essence of which beings subsist—this is edible food.

text: 743. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpassa aniccatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpassa aniccatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
ai: What is not edible food? The eye-base…etc.…the impermanence of matter—this is not edible food.

text: Evaṃ duvidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ duvidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus, the compendium of matter by dyads.

text: Dukaniddeso.
original: Dukaniddeso.
ai: Explanation by Dyads.

text: Tikaniddeso
original: Tikaniddeso
ai: Explanation by Triads.

text: 744. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādā.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵internal and derived?⤵The eye base...pe...the body base. This is that matter which is internal and derived.

text: 745. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and grasped at?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and grasped at?⤵Woman-faculty, man-faculty, life, or whatever other [material] form exists through karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of visible shape, odour, taste, or the tangible, in the spatial or the fluid element, in the integration or subsistence of form, or in bodily nutriment.⤵external and not grasped at?⤵The sphere of sound, bodily and vocal intimation, the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, decay, and impermanence of form, or whatever other [material] form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of visible form, odour, taste, or the tangible, in the spatial or the fluid element, etc. [Continue as in (ii)] .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādā.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵external and derived?⤵The visible form base...pe...edible food. This is that matter which is external and derived.

text: 746. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ no upādā? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ no upādā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ no upādā? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ no upādā.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵external and not derived?⤵The tangible object base and the water element. This is that matter which is external and not derived.

text: 747. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵internal and grasped?⤵The eye base...pe...the body base. This is that matter which is internal and grasped.

text: 748. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and both grasped at and favourable to grasping?⤵external and both grasped at and favourable to grasping?⤵external and not grasped at, but favourable to grasping?⤵The answers are identical with those in the preceding triplet, taken in order.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵external and grasped?⤵The femininity faculty, the masculinity faculty, the life faculty, or whatever other matter exists as karmically produced; the visible form base, the smell base, the taste base, the tangible object base, the space element, the water element, the production of matter, the continuity of matter, edible food. This is that matter which is external and grasped.

text: 749. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵external and not grasped?⤵The sound base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, the lightness of matter, the malleability of matter, the wieldiness of matter, the decay of matter, the impermanence of matter, or whatever other matter exists as not karmically produced; the visible form base, the smell base, the taste base, the tangible object base, the space element, the water element, the production of matter, the continuity of matter, edible food. This is that matter which is external and not grasped.

text: 750. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ. Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ. Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is⤵internal, grasped, and graspable?⤵The eye base...pe...the body base. This is that matter which is internal, grasped, and graspable.

text: 751. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is⤵personal and invisible?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and visible?⤵The sphere of visible shape.⤵external and invisible?⤵The sphere of sound … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external, clung-to, and graspable?⤵The femininity faculty, the masculinity faculty, the life faculty; and any other matter produced by kamma: the visible form sphere, the smell sphere, the taste sphere, the tangible sphere, the space element, the water element, the growth of matter, the continuity of matter, edible food—this is that matter which is external, clung-to, and graspable.

text: 752. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external, not clung-to, but graspable?⤵The sound sphere, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, decay of matter, impermanence of matter; and any other matter not produced by kamma: the visible form sphere, the smell sphere, the taste sphere, the tangible sphere, the space element, the water element, the growth of matter, the continuity of matter, edible food—this is that matter which is external, not clung-to, but graspable.

text: 753. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ anidassanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ anidassanaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ anidassanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ anidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is internal and not visible?⤵The five sense bases—this is that matter which is internal and not visible.

text: 754. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sanidassanaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sanidassanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and reacting?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and reacting?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects.⤵external and non-reacting?⤵Sex … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sanidassanaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sanidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external and visible?⤵The visible form sphere—this is that matter which is external and visible.

text: 755. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anidassanaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ …pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anidassanaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anidassanaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ …pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ anidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external and not visible?⤵The sound sphere... and edible food—this is that matter which is external and not visible.

text: 756. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is internal and with impingement?⤵The five sense bases—this is that matter which is internal and with impingement.

text: 757. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and a faculty?⤵The five faculties of sense.⤵external and a faculty?⤵Sex and vitality.⤵external and not a faculty?⤵The sphere of visible shape … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external and with impingement?⤵The five sense objects—this is that matter which is external and with impingement.

text: 758. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ appaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ appaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external and without impingement?⤵The femininity faculty... and edible food—this is that matter which is external and without impingement.

text: 759. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ indriyaṃ? Cakkhundriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ indriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ indriyaṃ? Cakkhundriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ indriyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is internal and a faculty?⤵The five sense faculties—this is that matter which is internal and a faculty.

text: 760. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ indriyaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ indriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and not one of the Great Phenomena?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and belonging to the Great Phenomena?⤵The sphere of the tangible and the fluid element.⤵external and not one of the Great Phenomena?⤵The spheres of the [other four kinds of sense-objects] … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ indriyaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ indriyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is external and a faculty?⤵The femininity faculty, the masculinity faculty, and the life faculty—this is that matter which is external and a faculty.

text: 761. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na indriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na indriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na indriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na indriyaṃ.
ai: What is that rūpa, external, not a faculty? ⤵ Visible form sense base…pe… edible food – This is that rūpa, external, not a faculty.

text: 762. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
ai: What is that rūpa, internal, not a great element? ⤵ Eye sense base…pe… body sense base – This is that rūpa, internal, not a great element.

text: 763. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ mahābhūtaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and not intimation?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and intimation?⤵Bodily and vocal intimation.⤵external and not intimation?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ mahābhūtaṃ.
ai: What is that rūpa, external, a great element? ⤵ Tangible sense base, water element – This is that rūpa, external, a great element.

text: 764. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
ai: What is that rūpa, external, not a great element? ⤵ Visible form sense base…pe… edible food – This is that rūpa, external, not a great element.

text: 765. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na viññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na viññatti?
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na viññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na viññatti?
ai: What is that rūpa, internal, not communication? ⤵ Eye sense base…pe… body sense base – This is that rūpa, internal, not communication.

text: 766. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ viññatti? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ viññatti.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and sprung from mind?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and sprung from mind?⤵Bodily and vocal intimation, or whatever other form exists which is born of mind, caused by mind, etc. [Continue as in § 667 ] .⤵external and not sprung from mind?⤵Sex-faculty, life-faculty, the decay and impermanence of form, or whatever other form exists which is not born of mind, caused by mind, etc. [Continue as in § 668 ] .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ viññatti? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ viññatti.
ai: What is that rūpa, external, communication? ⤵ Bodily intimation, vocal intimation – This is that rūpa, external, communication.

text: 767. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na viññatti? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na viññatti.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na viññatti? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na viññatti.
ai: What is that rūpa, external, not communication? ⤵ Visible form sense base…pe… edible food – This is that rūpa, external, not communication.

text: 768. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
ai: What is that rūpa, internal, not mind-originated? ⤵ Eye sense base…pe… body sense base – This is that rūpa, internal, not mind-originated.

text: 769. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and does not come into being together with mind?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and comes into being together with mind?⤵Bodily and vocal intimation.⤵external and does not come into being, etc.?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
ai: What is that rūpa, external, mind-originated? ⤵ Bodily intimation, vocal intimation, or any other rūpa that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated: visible form sense base, sound sense base, smell sense base, taste sense base, tangible sense base, space element, water element, lightness of rūpa, malleability of rūpa, wieldiness of rūpa, production of rūpa, continuity of rūpa, edible food – This is that rūpa, external, mind-originated.

text: 770. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ? original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na rūpadhātu? Saddāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na rūpadhātu.
ai: What is that external matter that is not the visible-form-element?⤵The sound-base...edible food – this is that external matter that is not the visible-form-element.

text: 828. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na saddadhātu…pe… na gandhadhātu…pe… na rasadhātu …pe… na phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na saddadhātu…pe… na gandhadhātu…pe… na rasadhātu …pe… na phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
ai: What is that internal matter that is not the sound-element...not the tangible-element?⤵The eye-base...body-base – this is that internal matter that is not the tangible-element.

text: 829. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵external and not the faculty of vision?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.⤵personal and the faculty of vision?⤵The sphere of vision.⤵personal and not the faculty of vision?⤵The spheres of the other four senses.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
ai: What is that external matter that is the tangible-element?⤵The tangible-base – this is that external matter that is the tangible-element.

text: 830. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na phoṭṭhabbadhātu.
ai: What is that external matter that is not the tangible-element?⤵The visible-form-base...edible food – this is that external matter that is not the tangible-element.

text: 831. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is external and not the eye-faculty? Visible form…pe… edible food – this is that material form which is external and not the eye-faculty.

text: 832. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵external and not the faculty of hearing, smell, taste, or body-sensibility?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.⤵personal and the faculty of … body-sensibility?⤵The body, that is to say the sentient organ which is derived from the four Great Phenomena … this that is “an empty village”—this, etc.⤵personal and not the faculty of … body-sensibility?⤵The spheres of the other four senses.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal and is the eye-faculty? That eye, which is the sensitive matter derived from the four great primary elements…pe… – this is that material form which is internal and is the eye-faculty.

text: 833. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ? Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na cakkhundriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal and not the eye-faculty? The ear-base…pe… the body-base – this is that material form which is internal and not the eye-faculty.

text: 834. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na sotindriyaṃ…pe… na ghānindriyaṃ…pe… na jivhindriyaṃ…pe… na kāyindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kāyindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na sotindriyaṃ…pe… na ghānindriyaṃ…pe… na jivhindriyaṃ…pe… na kāyindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kāyindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is external and not the ear-faculty…pe… not the nose-faculty…pe… not the tongue-faculty…pe… not the body-faculty? Visible form…pe… edible food – this is that material form which is external and not the body-faculty.

text: 835. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kāyindriyaṃ? Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kāyindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵personal and not the woman-faculty?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and woman-faculty?⤵That which is of the female, female in appearance, etc. [Continue as in § 633 ] .⤵external and not woman-faculty?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kāyindriyaṃ? Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kāyindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal and is the body-faculty? That body, which is the sensitive matter derived from the four great primary elements…pe… – this is that material form which is internal and is the body-faculty.

text: 836. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal and not the body-faculty? The eye-base…pe… the tongue-base – this is that material form which is internal and not the body-faculty.

text: 837. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na itthindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na itthindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na itthindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na itthindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal and not the female-faculty? The eye-base…pe… the body-base – this is that material form which is internal and not the female-faculty.

text: 838. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ itthindriyaṃ? Yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ itthindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is⤵personal and not the man-faculty? etc.⤵The questions and answers in this triplet are exactly analogous with those in the foregoing, § 634 constituting the answer to (ii).
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ itthindriyaṃ? Yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ itthindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is external and is the female-faculty? That which is the woman's female characteristic, female sign, female form, female appearance, femaleness, female state – this is that material form which is external and is the female-faculty.

text: 839. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na itthindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na itthindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na itthindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na itthindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is external and not the female-faculty? Visible form…pe… edible food – this is that material form which is external and not the female-faculty.

text: 840. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na purisindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na purisindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na purisindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na purisindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is internal and not the male-faculty? The eye-base…pe… the body-base – this is that material form which is internal and not the male-faculty.

text: 841. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ purisindriyaṃ? Yaṃ purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ purisindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: This triplet is on “life”, and is also exactly analogous with that on “woman-faculty”, § 635 being substituted in (ii).
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ purisindriyaṃ? Yaṃ purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ purisindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is the masculinity faculty? That which is a man's male characteristic, male sign, male feature, male appearance, masculinity, male nature – this is that external material phenomenon which is the masculinity faculty.

text: 842. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na purisindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na purisindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na purisindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na purisindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is not the masculinity faculty? Visible form…⤵edible food – this is that external material phenomenon which is not the masculinity faculty.

text: 843. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that internal material phenomenon which is not the life faculty? The eye base…⤵the body base – this is that internal material phenomenon which is not the life faculty.

text: 844. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is⤵personal and not bodily intimation?⤵The spheres of the five senses.⤵external and bodily intimation?⤵That tension, intension, tense state of the body, etc. [Continue as in § 636 ] .⤵external and not bodily intimation?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is the life faculty? That which is the life, duration, maintenance, sustenance, activity, functioning, preservation, and vitality of those material phenomena, the life faculty – this is that external material phenomenon which is the life faculty.

text: 845. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is not the life faculty? Visible form…⤵edible food – this is that external material phenomenon which is not the life faculty.

text: 846. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyaviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyaviññatti.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyaviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kāyaviññatti.
ai: What is that internal material phenomenon which is not bodily intimation? The eye base…⤵the body base – this is that internal material phenomenon which is not bodily intimation.

text: 847. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kāyaviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā abhikkamantassa vā paṭikkamantassa vā ālokentassa vā vilokentassa vā samiñjentassa vā pasārentassa vā kāyassa thambhanā santhambhanā santhambhitattaṃ viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kāyaviññatti.
rys_davids: This triplet is on “vocal intimation”, and similar to the foregoing, § 637 being quoted as the answer to the second question.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kāyaviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā abhikkamantassa vā paṭikkamantassa vā ālokentassa vā vilokentassa vā samiñjentassa vā pasārentassa vā kāyassa thambhanā santhambhanā santhambhitattaṃ viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kāyaviññatti.
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is bodily intimation? That which is the body's stiffening, firm stiffening, state of being firmly stiffened, intimation, making known, or state of being made known, arising from a wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate consciousness, when advancing, retreating, looking, observing, bending, or stretching – this is that external material phenomenon which is bodily intimation.

text: 848. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kāyaviññatti? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kāyaviññatti.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kāyaviññatti? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kāyaviññatti.
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is not bodily intimation? Visible form…⤵edible food – this is that external material phenomenon which is not bodily intimation.

text: 849. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na vacīviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na vacīviññatti.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na vacīviññatti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na vacīviññatti.
ai: What is that internal material phenomenon which is not verbal intimation? The eye base…⤵the body base – this is that internal material phenomenon which is not verbal intimation.

text: 850. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ vacīviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā vācā girā byappatho udīraṇaṃ dhoso ghosakammaṃ vācā vacībhedo, ayaṃ vuccati vācā. Yā tāya vācāya viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ vacīviññatti .
rys_davids: Here follow ten triplets on the presence or absence in form that is personal or external, of the ten following attributes—identical with those ending the categories according to Pairs ( §§ 722 – 741 ).⤵the element of space,⤵the element of fluidity,⤵the lightness of [material] form,⤵the plasticity of [material] form,⤵the wieldiness of [material] form,⤵the integration of [material] form,⤵the subsistence of [material] form,⤵the decay of [material] form,⤵the impermanence of [material] form,⤵bodily nutriment.⤵Questions and answers in each of these triplets are identical with those in the triplet last set out on “bodily intimation” ( §§ 844 – 846 ), the only varying elements being the specific kind of form inquired into and its definition in the second answer of each triplet. Thus the schema of the questions is⤵personal and not …⤵external and …⤵external and not …⤵Such are the Categories of Form under Threefold Aspects.⤵[End of] the Exposition of Triplets.⤵[Material] Form under a Fourfold Aspect⤵Derivation—Work of Karma
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ vacīviññatti? Yā kusalacittassa vā akusalacittassa vā abyākatacittassa vā vācā girā byappatho udīraṇaṃ dhoso ghosakammaṃ vācā vacībhedo, ayaṃ vuccati vācā. Yā tāya vācāya viññatti viññāpanā viññāpitattaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ vacīviññatti .
ai: What is that external material phenomenon which is verbal intimation? That which is speech, utterance, declaration, sound, vocal action, speech, or verbal articulation, arising from a wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate consciousness – this is called speech. That which is the intimation, making known, or state of being made known by that speech – this is that external material phenomenon which is verbal intimation.

text: 851. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na vacīviññatti? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na vacīviññatti.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na vacīviññatti? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na vacīviññatti.
ai: What is that external matter that is not verbal intimation? Visible form base...edible food. This is that external matter that is not verbal intimation.

text: 852. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na ākāsadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na ākāsadhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na ākāsadhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na ākāsadhātu.
ai: What is that internal matter that is not the space element? Eye base...body base. This is that internal matter that is not the space element.

text: 853. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ ākāsadhātu? Yo ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ ākāsadhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ ākāsadhātu? Yo ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ ākāsadhātu.
ai: What is that external matter which is the space element? That space, space-related, obstruction, obstruction-related, aperture, aperture-related, not touched by the four great elements. This is that external matter which is the space element.

text: 854. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na ākāsadhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na ākāsadhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na ākāsadhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na ākāsadhātu.
ai: What is that external matter that is not the space element? Visible form base...edible food. This is that external matter that is not the space element.

text: 855. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na āpodhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na āpodhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na āpodhātu? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na āpodhātu.
ai: What is that internal matter that is not the water element? Eye base...body base. This is that internal matter that is not the water element.

text: 856. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ āpodhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ āpodhātu.
ai: What is that external matter which is the water element? That water, water-related, cohesion, cohesion-related, the binding nature of matter. This is that external matter which is the water element.

text: 857. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na āpodhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na āpodhātu.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na āpodhātu? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na āpodhātu.
ai: What is that external matter that is not the water element? Visible form base...edible food. This is that external matter that is not the water element.

text: 858. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na lahutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na lahutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na lahutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na lahutā.
ai: What is that internal matter that is not the lightness of matter? Eye base...body base. This is that internal matter that is not the lightness of matter.

text: 859. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa lahutā? Yā rūpassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa lahutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa lahutā? Yā rūpassa lahutā lahupariṇāmatā adandhanatā avitthanatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa lahutā.
ai: What is that external matter which is the lightness of matter? That lightness of matter, quick changeability, non-sluggishness, non-unwieldiness. This is that external matter which is the lightness of matter.

text: 860. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na lahutā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na lahutā.

ai: What is that external matter that is not the lightness of matter? Visible form base...edible food. This is that external matter that is not the lightness of matter.

text: 861. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na mudutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na mudutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na mudutā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na mudutā.
ai:
What is that internal matter which is not pliability of matter? The eye-base... up to... the body-base 
– this is that internal matter which is not pliability of matter.

text: 862. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa mudutā? Yā rūpassa mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa mudutā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa mudutā? Yā rūpassa mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa mudutā.
ai:
What is that external matter which is pliability of matter? That pliability of matter which is softness, non-harshness, non-stiffness 
– this is that external matter which is pliability of matter.

text: 863. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na mudutā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na mudutā.
