ai:
What is that external matter which is not pliability of matter? The visible-form-base... up to... nutritive essence 
– this is that external matter which is not pliability of matter.

text: 864. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā.
ai:
What is that internal matter which is not workability of matter? The eye-base... up to... the body-base 
– this is that internal matter which is not workability of matter.

text: 865. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa kammaññatā? Yā rūpassa kammaññatā kammaññattaṃ kammaññabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa kammaññatā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa kammaññatā? Yā rūpassa kammaññatā kammaññattaṃ kammaññabhāvo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa kammaññatā.
ai:
What is that external matter which is workability of matter? That workability of matter which is adaptability, fitness for action 
– this is that external matter which is workability of matter.

text: 866. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na kammaññatā.
ai:
What is that external matter which is not workability of matter? The visible-form-base... up to... nutritive essence 
– this is that external matter which is not workability of matter.

text: 867. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na upacayo? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na upacayo.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na upacayo? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na upacayo.
ai:
What is that internal matter which is not growth of matter? The eye-base... up to... the body-base 
– this is that internal matter which is not growth of matter.

text: 868. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa upacayo? Yo āyatanānaṃ ācayo, so rūpassa upacayo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa upacayo.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa upacayo? Yo āyatanānaṃ ācayo, so rūpassa upacayo – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa upacayo.
ai:
What is that external matter which is growth of matter? That which is the accumulation of bases, that is the growth of matter 
– this is that external matter which is growth of matter.

text: 869. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na upacayo? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na upacayo.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na upacayo? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na upacayo.
ai:
What is that external matter which is not growth of matter? The visible-form-base... up to... nutritive essence 
– this is that external matter which is not growth of matter.

text: 870. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na santati? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na santati.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na santati? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na santati.
ai:
What is that internal matter which is not continuity of matter? The eye-base... up to... the body-base 
– this is that internal matter which is not continuity of matter.

text: 871. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa santati? Yo rūpassa upacayo, sā rūpassa santati – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa santati.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa santati? Yo rūpassa upacayo, sā rūpassa santati – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa santati.
ai: What is that external matter which is the continuity of matter? That which is the production of matter, that is the continuity of matter – this is that external matter which is the continuity of matter.

text: 872. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na santati? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na santati.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na santati? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na santati.
ai: What is that external matter which is not the continuity of matter? Visible form...⤵edible food – this is that external matter which is not the continuity of matter.

text: 873. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na jaratā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na jaratā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na jaratā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na jaratā.
ai: What is that internal matter which is not the aging of matter? Eye-base...⤵body-base – this is that internal matter which is not the aging of matter.

text: 874. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa jaratā? Yā rūpassa jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa jaratā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa jaratā? Yā rūpassa jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa jaratā.
ai: What is that external matter which is the aging of matter? That which is the decay of matter, its wearing out, brokenness, graying, wrinkling of skin, decline of life, ripening of faculties – this is that external matter which is the aging of matter.

text: 875. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na jaratā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na jaratā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na jaratā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na jaratā.
ai: What is that external matter which is not the aging of matter? Visible form...⤵edible food – this is that external matter which is not the aging of matter.

text: 876. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ rūpassa na aniccatā.
ai: What is that internal matter which is not the impermanence of matter? Eye-base...⤵body-base – this is that internal matter which is not the impermanence of matter.

text: 877. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa aniccatā? Yo rūpassa khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa aniccatā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵derived and grasped at?⤵The spheres of the five senses; the faculties of sex and life, or whatever other form exists through karma having been wrought, whether it be in the sphere of visible forms, odours, or tastes, the element of space, the integration or subsistence of [material] form, or bodily nutriment.⤵derived and not grasped at?⤵The sphere of sounds, bodily and vocal intimation, the lightness, plasticity, and wieldiness of [material] form, or whatever other [material] form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of visible shapes, odours, or tastes, the element of space, the integration or subsistence of form, or bodily nutriment.⤵underived and grasped at?⤵[Material form] due to karma having been wrought, which is in the sphere of the tangible and the fluid element.⤵underived and not grasped at?⤵[Material form] not due to karma having been wrought, which is in the sphere of the tangible and the fluid element.⤵Derivation—Production of Karma
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa aniccatā? Yo rūpassa khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa aniccatā.
ai: What is that external matter which is the impermanence of matter? That which is the wasting away of matter, its dissolution, breaking up, complete breaking up, impermanence, disappearance – this is that external matter which is the impermanence of matter.

text: 878. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na aniccatā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na aniccatā.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na aniccatā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ rūpassa na aniccatā.
ai: What is that external matter which is not the impermanence of matter? Visible form...⤵edible food – this is that external matter which is not the impermanence of matter.

text: 879. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ajjhattikaṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro .
ai: What is that internal matter which is not edible food? Eye-base...⤵body-base – this is that internal matter which is not edible food.

text: 880. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ yamhi yamhi janapade tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ mukhāsiyaṃ dantavikhādanaṃ galajjhoharaṇīyaṃ kucchivitthambhanaṃ yāya ojāya sattā yāpenti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ yamhi yamhi janapade tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ mukhāsiyaṃ dantavikhādanaṃ galajjhoharaṇīyaṃ kucchivitthambhanaṃ yāya ojāya sattā yāpenti – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
ai: What is that external matter which is edible food? Cooked rice, gruel, flour, fish, meat, milk, curd, ghee, fresh butter, oil, honey, treacle, or whatever other matter exists which, in various countries, is taken into the mouth by various beings, chewed by the teeth, swallowed down the throat, filling the stomach, by the nutrient essence of which beings subsist – this is that external matter which is edible food.

text: 881. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpassa aniccatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵derived and both grasped at and favourable to grasping?⤵derived and not grasped at but favourable to grasping?⤵underived and both grasped at and favourable, etc.?⤵underived and not grasped at but favourable, etc.?⤵The four answers are respectively identical with those in the preceding group.⤵Derivation—Reaction
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpassa aniccatā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ bāhiraṃ na kabaḷīkāro āhāro.
ai: Which matter is external and not physical nutriment? Visible form... up to... the impermanence of matter – this is that matter which is external and not physical nutriment.

text: Evaṃ tividhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ tividhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus, the compendium of matter is in three ways.

text: Tikaniddeso.
original: Tikaniddeso.
ai: Explanation of the Triads.

text: Catukkaṃ
original: Catukkaṃ
ai: Tetrads.

text: 882. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: Which matter is sustained by clinging and grasped by kamma? Eye-base... up to... body-base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, or whatever other matter there is that is kamma-produced: visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, physical nutriment – this is that matter sustained by clinging and grasped by kamma.

text: 883. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: Which matter is sustained by clinging but not grasped by kamma? Sound base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, decay of matter, impermanence of matter, or whatever other matter there is that is not kamma-produced: visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, physical nutriment – this is that matter sustained by clinging but not grasped by kamma.

text: 884. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇaṃ? Kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇaṃ? Kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: Which matter is not sustained by clinging but grasped by kamma? The tangible base and water element that are kamma-produced – this is that matter not sustained by clinging but grasped by kamma.

text: 885. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ? Na kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵derived and reacting?⤵The spheres of the five senses, and of visible shape, sound, odour and taste.⤵derived and non-reacting?⤵Sex … and bodily nutriment.⤵underived and reacting?⤵The sphere of the tangible.⤵underived and non-reacting?⤵The fluid element.⤵Derivation—Bulk
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ? Na kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇaṃ.
ai: Which matter is neither sustained by clinging nor grasped by kamma? The tangible base and water element that are not kamma-produced – this is that matter neither sustained by clinging nor grasped by kamma.

text: 886. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: Which matter is sustained by clinging, grasped by kamma, and an object of clinging? Eye-base... up to... body-base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, or whatever other matter there is that is kamma-produced: visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, physical nutriment – this is that matter sustained by clinging, grasped by kamma, and an object of clinging.

text: 887. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: Which matter is sustained by clinging, not grasped by kamma, and an object of clinging? Sound base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, decay of matter, impermanence of matter, or whatever other matter there is that is not kamma-produced: visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, physical nutriment – this is that matter sustained by clinging, not grasped by kamma, and an object of clinging.

text: 888. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā upādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not derived, ⤵ grasped and graspable? The tangible sphere and the water element, due to being produced by kamma – this is that matter which is not derived, grasped and graspable.

text: 889. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Na kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵derived and gross?⤵derived and subtle?⤵underived and gross?⤵underived and subtle?⤵Answers respectively identical with those in the preceding group.⤵Derivation—Proximity
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ? Na kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not derived, ⤵ not grasped and graspable? The tangible sphere and the water element, not due to being produced by kamma – this is that matter which is not derived, not grasped and graspable.

text: 890. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sappaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ derived, ⤵ with impingement? The eye-base... the taste-base – this is that matter which is derived, with impingement.

text: 891. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā appaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā appaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ derived, ⤵ without impingement? The female faculty... nutritive essence – this is that matter which is derived, without impingement.

text: 892. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sappaṭighaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sappaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sappaṭighaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not derived, ⤵ with impingement? The tangible sphere – this is that matter which is not derived, with impingement.

text: 893. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā appaṭighaṃ? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā appaṭighaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵derived and remote?⤵Sex … and bodily nutriment.⤵derived and near?⤵The spheres of the five senses, and those of visible shape, sound, odour and taste.⤵underived and remote?⤵The fluid element.⤵underived and near?⤵The sphere of the tangible.⤵Work of Karma—Visibility
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā appaṭighaṃ? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā appaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not derived, ⤵ without impingement? The water element – this is that matter which is not derived, without impingement.

text: 894. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā oḷārikaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā oḷārikaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ derived, ⤵ gross? The eye-base... the taste-base – this is that matter which is derived, gross.

text: 895. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sukhumaṃ itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sukhumaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sukhumaṃ itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā sukhumaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ derived, ⤵ subtle? The female faculty... nutritive essence – this is that matter which is derived, subtle.

text: 896. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā oḷārikaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā oḷārikaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā oḷārikaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā oḷārikaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not derived, ⤵ gross? The tangible sphere – this is that matter which is not derived, gross.

text: 897. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sukhumaṃ? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sukhumaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵grasped at and visible?⤵The sphere of visible shape which is due to karma having been wrought.⤵grasped at and invisible?⤵The spheres of the five senses; sex and life, or whatever other [material] form exists through karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of odour, taste, or the tangible, the elements of space or fluidity, the integration or subsistence of [material] form, or bodily nutriment.⤵not grasped at and visible?⤵The sphere of visible shape which is not due to karma having been wrought.⤵not grasped at and invisible?⤵The sphere of sound, bodily and vocal intimation, the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, the decay, or the impermanence of [material] form, or whatever other [material] form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of odour, or of taste, or of the tangible, the elements of space, or of fluidity, the integration or subsistence of [material] form, or bodily nutriment.⤵Work of Karma—Impact
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sukhumaṃ? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā sukhumaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not derived, ⤵ subtle? The water element – this is that matter which is not derived, subtle.

text: 898. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā dūre? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā dūre.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā dūre? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā dūre.
ai: What is that material form derived and far? ⤵Femininity faculty...pe... nutritive essence. This is that material form derived and far.

text: 899. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā santike? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā santike.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā santike? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā santike.
ai: What is that material form derived and near? ⤵Eye-base...pe... taste-base. This is that material form derived and near.

text: 900. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā dūre? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā dūre.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā dūre? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā dūre.
ai: What is that material form not derived and far? ⤵Water element. This is that material form not derived and far.

text: 901. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā santike? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā santike.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵grasped at and reacting?⤵The spheres of the five senses, or whatever other [material] form exists through karma having been wrought in the spheres of visible shape, odour, taste, or the tangible.⤵grasped at and non-reacting?⤵Sex or life, or whatever other [material] form exists through karma having been wrought in the elements of space or fluidity, in the integration, or subsistence of [material] form, or in bodily nutriment.⤵not grasped at and reacting?⤵The sphere of sound, or whatever other [material] form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought in the spheres of the other four kinds of sense-objects.⤵not grasped at and non-reacting?⤵Bodily and vocal intimation, the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, decay, or impermanence of [material] form, or whatever other [material] form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought in the elements of space or fluidity, in the integration or subsistence of [material] form, or in bodily nutriment.⤵Work of Karma—Great Phenomena
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā santike? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ no upādā santike.
ai: What is that material form not derived and near? ⤵Tangible object. This is that material form not derived and near.

text: 902. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form grasped and visible? ⤵Visible form due to kamma. This is that material form grasped and visible.

text: 903. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form grasped and invisible? ⤵Eye-base...pe... body-base, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, or whatever other material form exists due to kamma: smell-base, taste-base, tangible object, space element, water element, growth of matter, continuity of matter, nutritive essence. This is that material form grasped and invisible.

text: 904. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sanidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form not grasped and visible? ⤵Visible form not due to kamma. This is that material form not grasped and visible.

text: 905. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā , yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵grasped at and great phenomenon?⤵The sphere of the tangible and the fluid element which are due to karma having been wrought.⤵grasped at and not great phenomenon?⤵The spheres of the five senses, sex, life, or whatever other [material] form exists through karma having been wrought, in the element of space, in the integration or subsistence of [material] form, or in bodily nutriment.⤵not grasped at, but great phenomenon?⤵The sphere of the tangible and the fluid element which are not due to karma having been wrought.⤵not grasped at nor great phenomenon?⤵The sphere of sound, bodily and vocal intimation, the lightness, plasticity, wieldiness, decay, and impermanence of form, or whatever other form exists which is not due to karma having been wrought, whether it be in the spheres of visible form, odour, or taste, in the element of space, in the integration or subsistence of form, or in bodily nutriment.⤵Work of Karma—Bulk
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā , yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ anidassanaṃ.
ai: What is that material form not grasped and invisible? ⤵Sound-base, bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, pliancy of matter, wieldiness of matter, aging of matter, impermanence of matter, or whatever other material form exists not due to kamma: smell-base, taste-base, tangible object, space element, water element, growth of matter, continuity of matter, nutritive essence. This is that material form not grasped and invisible.

text: 906. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that material form grasped and with impingement? ⤵Eye-base...pe... body-base, or whatever other material form exists due to kamma: visible form, smell-base, taste-base, tangible object. This is that material form grasped and with impingement.

text: 907. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that material form grasped and without impingement? ⤵Femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, or whatever other material form exists due to kamma: space element, water element, growth of matter, continuity of matter, nutritive essence. This is that material form grasped and without impingement.

text: 908. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not grasped and with impingement? ⤵ The sound base, or any other matter not produced by kamma, such as the visible form base, smell base, taste base, and tangible base. This is that matter which is not grasped and with impingement.

text: 909. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is⤵grasped at and gross?⤵grasped at and subtle?⤵not grasped at and gross?⤵not grasped at and subtle?⤵Answers respectively identical with the four in the next preceding group but one ( §§ 901 – 904 ).⤵Work of Karma—Proximity
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ appaṭighaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not grasped and without impingement? ⤵ Bodily intimation, vocal intimation, lightness of matter, malleability of matter, wieldiness of matter, decay of matter, impermanence of matter, or any other matter not produced by kamma, such as the space element, water element, production of matter, continuity of matter, and edible food. This is that matter which is not grasped and without impingement.

text: 910. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ grasped and a great element? ⤵ The tangible base and water element produced by kamma. This is that matter which is grasped and a great element.

text: 911. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.

ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ grasped and not a great element? ⤵ The eye base, ... the body base, the femininity faculty, the masculinity faculty, the life faculty, or any other matter produced by kamma, such as the visible form base, smell base, taste base, space element, production of matter, continuity of matter, and edible food. This is that matter which is grasped and not a great element.

text: 912. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtaṃ? Na kammassa katattā phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtaṃ.

ai: What is that matter which is ⤵ not grasped and a great element? ⤵ The tangible base and water element not produced by kamma. This is that matter which is not grasped and a great element.

text: 913. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that form which is⤵grasped at and remote?⤵grasped at and near?⤵not grasped at and remote?⤵not grasped at and near?⤵Answers identical with those in the preceding group (i.e. with those in §§ 901 – 904 ), but having the order of the first and second answers inverted, as well as that of the third and fourth.

This is that matter which is not grasped and not a great element.

text: 914. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ oḷārikaṃ.

text: 915. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sukhumaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ sukhumaṃ.

text: 916. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Saddāyatanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ oḷārikaṃ.

text: 917. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sukhumaṃ? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa jaratā rūpassa aniccatā, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇaṃ sukhumaṃ.
rys_davids: In the next five groups of four, form is considered as a combination of (a) “grasped at and favourable to grasping”, and either “visible”, “reacting”, “a great phenomenon”, “gross” or “remote”, or the opposites of these five taken successively; (b) “not grasped at, but favourable to grasping”, and the five above-named attributes and their opposites taken successively. Thus the questions are analogous to, and the answers identical with, those in the preceding five groups ( §§ 897 – 916 ).⤵Impact—Faculty

text: 918. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ dūre? Itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ kammassa katattā ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ dūre.

ai: What is that matter that is grasped and near? The eye-base, ear-base, nose-base, tongue-base, body-base, or any other matter produced by kamma: visible form, smell, taste, tangible object. This is that matter that is grasped and near.

ai: What is that matter that is grasped, graspable, and visible? Visible form produced by kamma. This is that matter that is grasped, graspable, and visible.

text: 924. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ sanidassanaṃ? Na kammassa katattā rūpāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ anupādiṇṇupādāniyaṃ sanidassanaṃ.

text: 956. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ dūre? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ dūre.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ dūre? Kāyaviññatti vacīviññatti…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ dūre.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and remote?⤵Bodily intimation, verbal intimation…pe… nutriment taken in morsels. This is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and remote.

text: 957. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ santike? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ santike.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵a great phenomenon and remote?⤵The fluid element.⤵a great phenomenon and near?⤵The sphere of the tangible.⤵not a great phenomenon and remote?⤵Sex and life.⤵not a great phenomenon and near?⤵The spheres of the five senses and of visible form, sound, odour and taste.⤵Form as Seen, Heard, Imagined, Understood
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ santike? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ santike.
ai: What is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and proximate?⤵The visible object…pe… the tangible object. This is that material phenomenon which is not a faculty and proximate.

text: 958. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is a great element and is gross? The tangible sense base. This is that matter which is a great element and is gross.

text: 959. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is a great element and is subtle? The water element. This is that matter which is a great element and is subtle.

text: 960. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ oḷārikaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is not a great element but is gross? The eye sense base... the taste sense base. This is that matter which is not a great element but is gross.

text: 961. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ.
rys_davids: The sphere of visible shape is Form Seen,⤵The sphere of sound is Form Heard,⤵The sphere of odour, taste and the tangible is [Material] Form Imagined,⤵All [material] form is Form Cognized by the mind.⤵Such are the Categories of [Material] Form under Fourfold Aspects.⤵[End of] the Groups of Four.⤵[Material] Form under a Fivefold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ sukhumaṃ.
ai: What is that matter which is not a great element and is subtle? The female faculty... nutritive essence. This is that matter which is not a great element and is subtle.

text: 962. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dūre? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dūre.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵earth-element ( paṭhavī-dhātu )?⤵That which is hard, rough, hardness, rigidity, whether it be of the self, or external, or grasped at, or not grasped at.⤵fluid-element ( apodhātu )?⤵That which is fluid, belonging to fluid, viscid, belonging to what is viscid, the cohesiveness of form, whether it be of the self, or external, or grasped at, or not grasped at.⤵heat-element ( tejodhātu )?⤵That which is flame, belonging to flame, heat, belonging to heat, hot, belonging to what is hot, whether it be of the self, or, etc. [Continue as in preceding] .⤵air-element ( vāyodhātu )?⤵That which is air, belongs to air [the fluctuation], the inflation, of form, whether it be of the self, or, etc.⤵derived?⤵The spheres of the five senses … and solid nutriment.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under a Fivefold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Five.⤵[Material] Form under a Sixfold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dūre? Āpodhātu – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dūre.
ai: What is that matter which is a great element and is remote? The water element. This is that matter which is a great element and is remote.

text: 963. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ santike? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ santike.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ santike? Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ mahābhūtaṃ santike.
ai: What is that matter which is a great element and is proximate? The tangible sense base. This is that matter which is a great element and is proximate.

text: 964. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ dūre? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ dūre.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ dūre? Itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ dūre.
ai: What is that matter which is not a great element and is remote? The female faculty... nutritive essence. This is that matter which is not a great element and is remote.

text: 965. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ santike? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ santike.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ santike? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na mahābhūtaṃ santike.
ai: What is that matter which is not a great element and is proximate? The eye sense base... the taste sense base. This is that matter which is not a great element and is proximate.

text: 966. Rūpāyatanaṃ diṭṭhaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sutaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ mutaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manasā viññātaṃ rūpaṃ.
original: Rūpāyatanaṃ diṭṭhaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sutaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ mutaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manasā viññātaṃ rūpaṃ.
ai: Visible form is seen,⤵sound is heard,⤵smell, taste, and tangible objects are sensed,⤵all matter is matter cognized by the mind.

text: Evaṃ catubbidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ catubbidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus, the compilation of matter is fourfold.

text: Catukkaṃ.
original: Catukkaṃ.
ai: The Tetrad.

text: Pañcakaṃ
original: Pañcakaṃ
ai: The Pentad

text: 967. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ pathavīdhātu? Yaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharagataṃ [kharigataṃ (ka.)] kakkhaḷattaṃ kakkhaḷabhāvo ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ pathavīdhātu.
rys_davids: The sphere of visible shapes is [material] form cognizable by sight.⤵The sphere of sounds is [material] form cognizable by hearing.⤵The sphere of odours is [material] form cognizable by smell.⤵The sphere of tastes is [material] form cognizable by taste.⤵The sphere of the tangible is [material] form cognizable by body-sensibility.⤵All [material] form is form cognizable by the mind.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under a Sixfold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Six.⤵[Material] Form under a Sevenfold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ pathavīdhātu? Yaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharagataṃ [kharigataṃ (ka.)] kakkhaḷattaṃ kakkhaḷabhāvo ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ pathavīdhātu.
ai: What is the matter that is the earth element? That which is hardness, hard, the state of hardness, the nature of hardness, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the earth element.

text: 968. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu.
rys_davids: The sphere of visible shapes is [material] form cognizable by sight.⤵The sphere of sound is [material] form cognizable by hearing.⤵The sphere of odour is [material] form cognizable by smell.⤵The sphere of taste is [material] form cognizable by taste.⤵The sphere of the tangible is [material] form cognizable by body-sensibility.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu? Yaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sineho sinehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ āpodhātu.
ai: What is the matter that is the water element? That which is water, watery, cohesion, cohesive, the binding of matter, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the water element.

text: 969. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ tejodhātu? Yaṃ tejo tejogataṃ usmā usmāgataṃ usumaṃ usumagataṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ tejodhātu.
rys_davids: The spheres of visible shapes, sound, odour, taste, and the tangible are [material] form cognizable by the element of ideation.⤵All [material] form is form comprehensible by the element of representative intellection.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under a Sevenfold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Seven.⤵[Material] Form under an Eightfold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ tejodhātu? Yaṃ tejo tejogataṃ usmā usmāgataṃ usumaṃ usumagataṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ tejodhātu.
ai: What is the matter that is the fire element? That which is fire, fiery, heat, hot, warmth, warm, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the fire element.

text: 970. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vāyodhātu? Yaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vāyodhātu.
rys_davids: The sphere of visible shapes is [material] form cognizable by the eye.⤵The sphere of sound is [material] form cognizable by the ear.⤵The sphere of odour is [material] form cognizable by the nose.⤵The sphere of taste is [material] form cognizable by the tongue.⤵Pleasurable agreeable contact obtainable by touch is [material] form cognizable by the body.⤵Unpleasant disagreeable contact obtainable by touch is [material] form cognizable by the body.⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects are [material] form cognizable by ideation.⤵All [material] form is form comprehensible by representative intellection.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under an Eightfold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Eight.⤵[Material] Form under a Ninefold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vāyodhātu? Yaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā upādiṇṇaṃ vā anupādiṇṇaṃ vā – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ vāyodhātu.
ai: What is the matter that is the air element? That which is air, airy, the quality of support of matter, whether internal or external, grasped or not grasped – this is that matter, the air element.

text: 971. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵vision-faculty?⤵hearing-faculty?⤵smell-faculty?⤵taste-faculty?⤵body-faculty?⤵woman-faculty?⤵man-faculty?⤵life-faculty?⤵The eight answers are those given in the original descriptions of the eight faculties or potentialities enumerated ( §§ 597 , 601 , 605 , 609 , 613 , 633–635 ).⤵What is that [material] form which is not faculty?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects … and bodily nutriment.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under a Ninefold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Nine.⤵[Material] Form under a Tenfold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ upādā.
ai: What is the derived matter? The eye-base… (and so on)… edible food – this is that derived matter.

text: Evaṃ pañcavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ pañcavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus, the compilation of matter is fivefold.

text: Pañcakaṃ.
original: Pañcakaṃ.
ai: The Pentad.

text: Chakkaṃ
original: Chakkaṃ
ai: The Hexad

text: 972. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manoviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ.
original: Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manoviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ.
ai: Visual form is form cognizable by eye-consciousness; sound form is form cognizable by ear-consciousness; odour form is form cognizable by nose-consciousness; taste form is form cognizable by tongue-consciousness; tangible form is form cognizable by body-consciousness; all form is form cognizable by mind-consciousness.

text: Evaṃ chabbidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ chabbidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus is the compendium of matter in six ways.

text: Chakkaṃ.
original: Chakkaṃ.
ai: The Sixfold Way

text: Sattakaṃ
original: Sattakaṃ
ai: The Sevenfold Way

text: 973. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ manodhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manoviññāṇadhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ.
original: Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ manodhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manoviññāṇadhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ.
ai: Visual form is form cognizable by eye-consciousness; sound form is form cognizable by ear-consciousness; odour form is form cognizable by nose-consciousness; taste form is form cognizable by tongue-consciousness; tangible form is form cognizable by body-consciousness; visual, sound, odour, taste, and tangible forms are forms cognizable by the mind-element consciousness; all form is form cognizable by the mind-consciousness-element consciousness.

text: Evaṃ sattavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ sattavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus is the compendium of matter in seven ways.

text: Sattakaṃ.
original: Sattakaṃ.
ai: The Sevenfold Way

text: Aṭṭhakaṃ
original: Aṭṭhakaṃ
ai: The Eightfold Way

text: 974. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, manāpiyo phoṭṭhabbo sukhasamphasso kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, amanāpiyo phoṭṭhabbo dukkhasamphasso kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ manodhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manoviññāṇadhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ.
rys_davids: The first eight questions and answers are identical with the first eight in the preceding group.
original: Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, manāpiyo phoṭṭhabbo sukhasamphasso kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, amanāpiyo phoṭṭhabbo dukkhasamphasso kāyaviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ manodhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ manoviññāṇadhātuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ.
ai: Visual form is form cognizable by eye-consciousness; sound form is form cognizable by ear-consciousness; odour form is form cognizable by nose-consciousness; taste form is form cognizable by tongue-consciousness; agreeable tangible form, pleasant contact, is form cognizable by body-consciousness; disagreeable tangible form, painful contact, is form cognizable by body-consciousness; visual, sound, odour, taste, and tangible forms are forms cognizable by the mind-element consciousness; all form is form cognizable by the mind-consciousness-element consciousness.

text: Evaṃ aṭṭhavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ aṭṭhavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus is the compendium of matter in eight ways.

text: Aṭṭhakaṃ.
original: Aṭṭhakaṃ.
ai: The Eightfold Group.

text: Navakaṃ
original: Navakaṃ
ai: The Ninefold Group

text: 975. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ .
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ .
ai: What is that material form which is the eye-faculty? That eye, which is sensitive matter derived from the four great elements…pe… this is that material form which is the eye-faculty.

text: 976. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotindriyaṃ…pe… ghānindriyaṃ…pe… jivhindriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ …pe… itthindriyaṃ…pe… purisindriyaṃ…pe… jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵not faculty but reacting?⤵The spheres of the five kinds of sense-objects.⤵not faculty and non-reacting?⤵Intimation … and bodily nutriment.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under a Tenfold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Ten.⤵[Material] Form under an Elevenfold Aspect
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotindriyaṃ…pe… ghānindriyaṃ…pe… jivhindriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ …pe… itthindriyaṃ…pe… purisindriyaṃ…pe… jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the ear-faculty…pe… the nose-faculty…pe… the tongue-faculty…pe… the body-faculty…pe… the female-faculty…pe… the male-faculty…pe… the life-faculty? That which is the life, standing, maintaining, sustaining, carrying on, continuing, protecting, the life of those material phenomena, the life-faculty – this is that material form which is the life-faculty.

text: 977. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is not a faculty? Visual form…pe… edible food – this is that material form which is not a faculty.

text: Evaṃ navavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
original: Evaṃ navavidhena rūpasaṅgaho.
ai: Thus, the collection of material forms is in nine ways.

text: Navakaṃ.
original: Navakaṃ.
ai: The Ninefold Group.

text: Dasakaṃ
original: Dasakaṃ
ai: The Tenfold Group

text: 978. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is⤵the vision-sphere?⤵the hearing-sphere?⤵the smell-sphere?⤵the taste-sphere?⤵the body-sphere?⤵the visible shape-sphere?⤵the sound-sphere?⤵the odour-sphere?⤵the sapid-sphere?⤵the tangible-sphere?⤵Answers as in §§ 597 , 601 , 605 , 609 , 613 , 617 , 621 , 625 , 629 , 649 respectively.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ? Yaṃ cakkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo…pe… suñño gāmo peso – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the eye-faculty? That eye, which is sensitive matter derived from the four great elements…pe… this is that material form which is the eye-faculty.

text: 979. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotindriyaṃ…pe… ghānindriyaṃ…pe… jivhindriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ…pe… itthindriyaṃ…pe… purisindriyaṃ…pe… jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
original: Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ sotindriyaṃ…pe… ghānindriyaṃ…pe… jivhindriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ…pe… itthindriyaṃ…pe… purisindriyaṃ…pe… jīvitindriyaṃ? Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
ai: What is that material form which is the ear-faculty…pe… the nose-faculty…pe… the tongue-faculty…pe… the body-faculty…pe… the female-faculty…pe… the male-faculty…pe… the life-faculty? That which is the life, standing, maintaining, sustaining, carrying on, continuing, protecting, the life of those material phenomena, the life-faculty – this is that material form which is the life-faculty.

text: 980. Katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ sappaṭighaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ – idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ na indriyaṃ sappaṭighaṃ.
rys_davids: What is that [material] form which is invisible, non-reacting, and included in the sphere of [mental] states?⤵Sex … and bodily nutriment.⤵Such is the Category of [Material] Form under an Elevenfold Aspect.⤵[End of] the Group of Eleven.⤵[End of] The Divisions of Form.⤵[End of] the Eighth Portion for Recitation.⤵A Buddhist Manual of Psychological Ethics , a rys_davids of the Dhammasaṅgaṇī, Compendium of States or Phenomena, by Caroline A.F.
