original: Katame dhammā apariyāpannā? Maggā ca, maggaphalāni ca, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā apariyāpannā.
ai: Which phenomena are not included?⤵The paths, the path fruits, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena are not included.

text: 1295. Katame dhammā niyyānikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyyānikā.
original: Katame dhammā niyyānikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyyānikā.
ai: Which phenomena lead to liberation?⤵The four not-included paths—these phenomena lead to liberation.

text: 1296. Katame dhammā aniyyānikā? Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā; vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, sabbañca rūpaṃ, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā aniyyānikā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that⤵partake of wisdom?⤵States which are the associates of wisdom.⤵partake of ignorance?⤵States which are the associates of ignorance.
original: Katame dhammā aniyyānikā? Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā; vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, sabbañca rūpaṃ, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā aniyyānikā.
ai: Which phenomena do not lead to liberation?⤵Apart from those phenomena, the remaining wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena in the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and the not-included; the feeling aggregate... up to... the consciousness aggregate, all matter, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena do not lead to liberation.

text: 1297. Katame dhammā niyatā? Pañca kammāni ānantarikāni, yā ca micchādiṭṭhi niyatā, cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyatā.
original: Katame dhammā niyatā? Pañca kammāni ānantarikāni, yā ca micchādiṭṭhi niyatā, cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyatā.
ai: Which phenomena are fixed?⤵The five heinous actions, fixed wrong view, and the four not-included paths—these phenomena are fixed.

text: 1298. Katame dhammā aniyatā? Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā; vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, sabbañca rūpaṃ, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā aniyatā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that have⤵the likeness of lightning?⤵Insight into the three lowest of the Noble Paths.⤵the likeness of the thunderbolt?⤵The science of the topmost Path, the Path of Arahantship.
original: Katame dhammā aniyatā? Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā; vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, sabbañca rūpaṃ, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā aniyatā.
ai: Which phenomena are not fixed?⤵Apart from those phenomena, the remaining wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena in the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and the not-included; the feeling aggregate... up to... the consciousness aggregate, all matter, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena are not fixed.

text: 1299. Katame dhammā sauttarā? Sāsavā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā; rūpakkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho – ime dhammā sauttarā.
original: Katame dhammā sauttarā? Sāsavā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā; rūpakkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho – ime dhammā sauttarā.
ai: Which phenomena have a superior?⤵Phenomena subject to taints, wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate, in the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere; the form aggregate... up to... the consciousness aggregate—these phenomena have a superior.

text: 1300. Katame dhammā anuttarā? Apariyāpannā maggā ca, maggaphalāni ca, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā anuttarā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that are⤵foolish?⤵Unconscientiousness and disregard of blame. Besides, all bad states are foolish.⤵discreet?⤵Conscientiousness and fear of blame. Besides, all good states are discreet.
original: Katame dhammā anuttarā? Apariyāpannā maggā ca, maggaphalāni ca, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā anuttarā.
ai: Which phenomena have no superior?⤵The not-included paths, the path fruits, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena have no superior.

text: 1301. Katame dhammā saraṇā? Tīṇi akusalamūlāni lobho, doso, moho; tadekaṭṭhā ca kilesā, taṃsampayutto vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, taṃsamuṭṭhānaṃ kāyakammaṃ, vacīkammaṃ, manokammaṃ – ime dhammā saraṇā.
original: Katame dhammā saraṇā? Tīṇi akusalamūlāni lobho, doso, moho; tadekaṭṭhā ca kilesā, taṃsampayutto vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, taṃsamuṭṭhānaṃ kāyakammaṃ, vacīkammaṃ, manokammaṃ – ime dhammā saraṇā.
ai: Which phenomena are with danger?⤵The three unwholesome roots: greed, hatred, delusion; and defilements associated with them; the feeling aggregate... up to... the consciousness aggregate associated with them; bodily action, verbal action, and mental action arising from them—these phenomena are with danger.

text: 1302. Katame dhammā araṇā? Kusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā; vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, sabbañca rūpaṃ, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā araṇā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that are⤵dark?⤵Unconscientiousness and disregard of blame. Besides, all bad states are dark.⤵bright?⤵Conscientiousness and fear of blame. Besides, all good states are bright.
original: Katame dhammā araṇā? Kusalābyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā; vedanākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho, sabbañca rūpaṃ, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā araṇā.
ai: Which phenomena are without danger?⤵Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena in the sense sphere, fine-material sphere, immaterial sphere, and the not-included; the feeling aggregate... up to... the consciousness aggregate, all matter, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena are without danger.

text: Abhidhammadukaṃ.
original: Abhidhammadukaṃ.
ai: Abhidhamma Dyads.

text: Suttantikadukanikkhepaṃ
original: Suttantikadukanikkhepaṃ
ai: Exposition of Suttanta Dyads

text: 1303. Katame dhammā vijjābhāgino? Vijjāya sampayuttakā dhammā – ime dhammā vijjābhāgino.
original: Katame dhammā vijjābhāgino? Vijjāya sampayuttakā dhammā – ime dhammā vijjābhāgino.
ai: Which are the states partaking of knowledge? States associated with knowledge – these states partake of knowledge.

text: 1304. Katame dhammā avijjābhāgino? Avijjāya sampayuttakā dhammā – ime dhammā avijjābhāgino.
rys_davids: Which are the states that⤵conduce to remorse?⤵Misconduct in act, word and thought. Besides, all bad states conduce to remorse.⤵do not conduce to remorse?⤵Good conduct in act, word and thought. Besides, no good states conduce to remorse.
original: Katame dhammā avijjābhāgino? Avijjāya sampayuttakā dhammā – ime dhammā avijjābhāgino.
ai: Which are the states partaking of ignorance? States associated with ignorance – these states partake of ignorance.

text: 1305. Katame dhammā vijjūpamā? Heṭṭhimesu tīsu ariyamaggesu paññā – ime dhammā vijjūpamā.
original: Katame dhammā vijjūpamā? Heṭṭhimesu tīsu ariyamaggesu paññā – ime dhammā vijjūpamā.
ai: Which are the states like lightning? Wisdom in the three lower noble paths – these states are like lightning.

text: 1306. Katame dhammā vajirūpamā? Upariṭṭhime arahattamagge paññā – ime dhammā vajirūpamā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that are equivalent terms?⤵That which is an enumeration, that which is a designation, an expression, a current term, a name, a denomination, the assigning of a name, an interpretation, a distinctive mark of discourse on this or that state.
original: Katame dhammā vajirūpamā? Upariṭṭhime arahattamagge paññā – ime dhammā vajirūpamā.
ai: Which are the states like a diamond? Wisdom in the Arahant path – these states are like a diamond.

text: 1307. Katame dhammā bālā? Ahirīkañca anottappañca – ime dhammā bālā. Sabbepi akusalā dhammā bālā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that are explanations?⤵Answer as in § 1306 .
original: Katame dhammā bālā? Ahirīkañca anottappañca – ime dhammā bālā. Sabbepi akusalā dhammā bālā.
ai: Which are the states that are foolish? Shamelessness and fearlessness of wrongdoing – these states are foolish. All unwholesome states are foolish.

text: 1308. Katame dhammā paṇḍitā? Hirī ca ottappañca – ime dhammā paṇḍitā. Sabbepi kusalā dhammā paṇḍitā.
rys_davids: Which are the states that are expressions?⤵Answer as in § 1306 .
original: Katame dhammā paṇḍitā? Hirī ca ottappañca – ime dhammā paṇḍitā. Sabbepi kusalā dhammā paṇḍitā.
ai: Which are the states that are wise? Shame and fear of wrongdoing – these states are wise. All wholesome states are wise.

text: 1309. Katame dhammā kaṇhā? Ahirīkañca anottappañca – ime dhammā kaṇhā. Sabbepi akusalā dhammā kaṇhā.
rys_davids: What is name?⤵The four skandhas and unconditioned element.
original: Katame dhammā kaṇhā? Ahirīkañca anottappañca – ime dhammā kaṇhā. Sabbepi akusalā dhammā kaṇhā.
ai: Which are the states that are dark? Shamelessness and fearlessness of wrongdoing – these states are dark. All unwholesome states are dark.

text: 1310. Katame dhammā sukkā? Hirī ca ottappañca – ime dhammā sukkā? Sabbepi kusalā dhammā sukkā.
rys_davids: What is [material] form?⤵The four great phenomena and the [material] form which is derived from them.
original: Katame dhammā sukkā? Hirī ca ottappañca – ime dhammā sukkā? Sabbepi kusalā dhammā sukkā.
ai: Which are the states that are bright? Shame and fear of wrongdoing – these states are bright. All wholesome states are bright.

text: 1311. Katame dhammā tapanīyā? Kāyaduccaritaṃ, vacīduccaritaṃ, manoduccaritaṃ – ime dhammā tapanīyā. Sabbepi akusalā dhammā tapanīyā.
rys_davids: What is ignorance?⤵Answer as for “dullness”, § 390 (omitting “on that occasion”).
original: Katame dhammā tapanīyā? Kāyaduccaritaṃ, vacīduccaritaṃ, manoduccaritaṃ – ime dhammā tapanīyā. Sabbepi akusalā dhammā tapanīyā.
ai: What are the states that are to be tormented? Bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, mental misconduct – these states are to be tormented. All unwholesome states are to be tormented.

text: 1312. Katame dhammā atapanīyā? Kāyasucaritaṃ, vacīsucaritaṃ, manosucaritaṃ – ime dhammā atapanīyā. Sabbepi kusalā dhammā atapanīyā.
rys_davids: What is the craving for rebirth?⤵Answer as for the “Fetter of the passion for rebirth”, § 1120 .
original: Katame dhammā atapanīyā? Kāyasucaritaṃ, vacīsucaritaṃ, manosucaritaṃ – ime dhammā atapanīyā. Sabbepi kusalā dhammā atapanīyā.
ai: What are the states that are not to be tormented? Bodily good conduct, verbal good conduct, mental good conduct – these states are not to be tormented. All wholesome states are not to be tormented.

text: 1313. Katame dhammā adhivacanā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo – ime dhammā adhivacanā. Sabbeva dhammā adhivacanapathā.
rys_davids: What is speculative opinion about rebirth?⤵Theories that both soul and world will come to be, etc.
original: Katame dhammā adhivacanā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo – ime dhammā adhivacanā. Sabbeva dhammā adhivacanapathā.
ai: What are the states that are designations? The reckoning, appellation, concept, usage, name, naming, nomenclature, expression, indication, and utterance of those various states – these states are designations. All states are paths of designation.

text: 1314. Katame dhammā nirutti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo – ime dhammā nirutti. Sabbeva dhammā niruttipathā.
rys_davids: What is speculative opinion about non-rebirth?⤵Theories that both soul and world will not come to be, etc.
original: Katame dhammā nirutti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo – ime dhammā nirutti. Sabbeva dhammā niruttipathā.
ai: What are the states that are expressions? The reckoning, appellation, concept, usage, name, naming, nomenclature, expression, indication, and utterance of those various states – these states are expressions. All states are paths of expression.

text: 1315. Katame dhammā paññatti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo – ime dhammā paññatti. Sabbeva dhammā paññattipathā.
rys_davids: What is the sort of speculation known as Eternalism?⤵That both soul and world are eternal, etc.
original: Katame dhammā paññatti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo – ime dhammā paññatti. Sabbeva dhammā paññattipathā.
ai: What are the states that are concepts? The reckoning, appellation, concept, usage, name, naming, nomenclature, expression, indication, and utterance of those various states – these states are concepts. All states are paths of concepts.

text: 1316. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – idaṃ vuccati nāmaṃ.
rys_davids: What is the sort of speculation known as Annihilation?⤵That both soul and world will be dissolved, etc.
original: Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – idaṃ vuccati nāmaṃ.
ai: Therein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the volitional formations aggregate, the consciousness aggregate, and the unconditioned element – this is called name.

text: 1317. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cattāro ca mahābhūtā, catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ – idaṃ vuccati rūpaṃ.
rys_davids: What is the sort of speculation known as the Finite Theory …
original: Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cattāro ca mahābhūtā, catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ – idaṃ vuccati rūpaṃ.
ai: Therein, what is form? The four great primary elements, and form derived from the four great primary elements – this is called form.

text: 1318. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati avijjā.
rys_davids: the Infinite Theory?⤵That both soul and world are finite … infinite, etc.
original: Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati avijjā.
ai: Therein, what is ignorance? That which is not knowing, not seeing...pe... the fetter of ignorance, delusion, the root of unwholesome states – this is called ignorance.

text: 1319. Tattha katamā bhavataṇhā? Yo bhavesu bhavachando…pe… bhavajjhosānaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati bhavataṇhā.
rys_davids: What is the sort of speculation known as the Theory of Origins …
original: Tattha katamā bhavataṇhā? Yo bhavesu bhavachando…pe… bhavajjhosānaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati bhavataṇhā.
ai: Therein, what is craving for existence? That which is desire for existence in states of being...pe... clinging to existence – this is called craving for existence.

text: 1320. Tattha katamā bhavadiṭṭhi? Bhavissati attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati bhavadiṭṭhi.
rys_davids: the Theory of the Hereafter?⤵Theories concerning the ultimate past … concerning futurity.⤵All this sort of opinion, walking in opinion, jungle of opinion, wilderness of opinion, disorder of opinion, scuffling of opinion, the Fetter of opinion, the grip and tenacity of it, the inclination towards it, the being infected by it, this by-path, wrong road, wrongness, this sectarianism, this shiftiness of grasp—this is what is called speculative opinion about rebirth, and the rest.
original: Tattha katamā bhavadiṭṭhi? Bhavissati attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati bhavadiṭṭhi.
ai: Therein, what is view of existence? The view 'there will be a self and a world,' such a view, a wrong view...pe... a perverted grasp – this is called view of existence.

text: 1321. Tattha katamā vibhavadiṭṭhi? Na bhavissati attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati vibhavadiṭṭhi.
rys_davids: What is unconscientiousness? …
original: Tattha katamā vibhavadiṭṭhi? Na bhavissati attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati vibhavadiṭṭhi.
ai: What is the view of non-existence? The view, 'There will be no self and no world,' such a view, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called the view of non-existence.

text: 1322. Tattha katamā sassatadiṭṭhi? Sassato attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati sassatadiṭṭhi.
rys_davids: disregard of blame?⤵Answers as for the ninth and tenth “bases of vice”, §§ 1238 , 1239 .
original: Tattha katamā sassatadiṭṭhi? Sassato attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati sassatadiṭṭhi.
ai: What is the view of eternalism? The view, 'The self and the world are eternal,' such a view, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called the view of eternalism.

text: 1323. Tattha katamā ucchedadiṭṭhi? Ucchijjissati attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati ucchedadiṭṭhi.
rys_davids: What is conscientiousness?⤵The feeling of conscientious scruple when scruples ought to be felt, conscientious scruple at attaining to bad and evil states.
original: Tattha katamā ucchedadiṭṭhi? Ucchijjissati attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati ucchedadiṭṭhi.
ai: What is the view of annihilationism? The view, 'The self and the world will be annihilated,' such a view, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called the view of annihilationism.

text: 1324. Tattha katamā antavā diṭṭhi? Antavā attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati antavā diṭṭhi.
rys_davids: What is discretion?⤵The sense of guilt where a sense of guilt ought to be felt, a sense of guilt at attaining to bad and evil states.
original: Tattha katamā antavā diṭṭhi? Antavā attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati antavā diṭṭhi.
ai: What is the view of finitude? The view, 'The self and the world are finite,' such a view, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called the view of finitude.

text: 1325. Tattha katamā anantavā diṭṭhi? Anantavā attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati anantavā diṭṭhi.
rys_davids: What is contumacy?⤵The being surly, refractious, contumacious when that which is in accordance with the Norm has been said, contrariness, captiousness, want of regard, of consideration, of reverence, of deference.
original: Tattha katamā anantavā diṭṭhi? Anantavā attā ca loko cāti, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati anantavā diṭṭhi.
ai: What is the view of infinitude? The view, 'The self and the world are infinite,' such a view, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called the view of infinitude.

text: 1326. Tattha katamā pubbantānudiṭṭhi? Pubbantaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati pubbantānudiṭṭhi.
rys_davids: What is friendship with evil?⤵To follow after, to frequent the company of, and associate with such persons as are unbelievers, immoral, uneducated, mean-spirited and witless; to resort to and consort with them, to be devoted to them, enthusiastic about them, and entangled with them.
original: Tattha katamā pubbantānudiṭṭhi? Pubbantaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati pubbantānudiṭṭhi.
ai: What is speculation about the past? The view that arises concerning the past, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called speculation about the past.

text: 1327. Tattha katamā aparantānudiṭṭhi? Aparantaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati aparantānudiṭṭhi.
rys_davids: What is suavity?⤵The being gentle, tractable, amenable when that which is in accordance with the Norm has been said, the refraining from contradiction and from captiousness; the showing regard and consideration, devotion and deference.
original: Tattha katamā aparantānudiṭṭhi? Aparantaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati aparantānudiṭṭhi.
ai: What is speculation about the future? The view that arises concerning the future, wrong view, perverted grasping – this is called speculation about the future.

text: 1328. Tattha katamaṃ ahirikaṃ? Yaṃ na hirīyati hiriyitabbena, na hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ vuccati ahirikaṃ.
rys_davids: What is friendship with good?⤵To follow after, frequent the company of, and associate with, such persons as are believers, virtuous, well educated, generous and wise; to resort to and consort with them, to be devoted to them, enthusiastic about them, mixed up with them.
original: Tattha katamaṃ ahirikaṃ? Yaṃ na hirīyati hiriyitabbena, na hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ vuccati ahirikaṃ.
ai: What is shamelessness? That which is not ashamed of what should be ashamed of, is not ashamed of committing evil, unwholesome states – this is called shamelessness.

text: 1329. Tattha katamaṃ anottappaṃ? Yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbena, na ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ vuccati anottappaṃ.
rys_davids: What is skill in⤵the Offences?⤵restoration from the Offences?⤵the Attainments?⤵recovery from the Attainments?⤵That skill which is insight, understanding, search, research, etc., when applied to⤵the Offences termed the Five Groups of Offences and the Seven Groups of Offences;⤵restoration from [the effects of] those Offences;⤵a case of Attainment with applied and sustained thought, a case of Attainment with only sustained thought, a case of Attainment without either mode of thought;⤵recovery from those Attainments.
original: Tattha katamaṃ anottappaṃ? Yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbena, na ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ vuccati anottappaṃ.
ai: What is fearlessness of wrongdoing? That which is not afraid of what should be feared, is not afraid of committing evil, unwholesome states – this is called fearlessness of wrongdoing.

text: 1330. Tattha katamā hirī? Yaṃ hirīyati hiriyitabbena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – ayaṃ vuccati hirī.
original: Tattha katamā hirī? Yaṃ hirīyati hiriyitabbena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – ayaṃ vuccati hirī.
ai: What is moral shame? That which is ashamed of what should be ashamed of, is ashamed of committing evil, unwholesome states – this is called moral shame.

text: 1331. Tattha katamaṃ ottappaṃ? Yaṃ ottappati ottappitabbena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ vuccati ottappaṃ.
original: Tattha katamaṃ ottappaṃ? Yaṃ ottappati ottappitabbena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā – idaṃ vuccati ottappaṃ.
ai: What is fear of wrongdoing? The fear of what should be feared, the fear of committing evil unwholesome phenomena – this is called fear of wrongdoing.

text: 1332. Tattha katamā dovacassatā? Sahadhammike vuccamāne dovacassāyaṃ dovacassiyaṃ dovacassatā vippaṭikūlaggāhitā vipaccanīkasātatā anādariyaṃ anādaratā agāravatā appaṭissavatā – ayaṃ vuccati dovacassatā.
original: Tattha katamā dovacassatā? Sahadhammike vuccamāne dovacassāyaṃ dovacassiyaṃ dovacassatā vippaṭikūlaggāhitā vipaccanīkasātatā anādariyaṃ anādaratā agāravatā appaṭissavatā – ayaṃ vuccati dovacassatā.
ai: What is unruliness? When spoken to by fellow Dhamma practitioners, unruliness, taking advice adversely, habitual antagonism, disrespect, lack of deference, lack of reverence, not heeding – this is called unruliness.

text: 1333. Tattha katamā pāpamittatā? Ye te puggalā assaddhā dussīlā appassutā maccharino duppaññā, yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti taṃsampavaṅkatā – ayaṃ vuccati pāpamittatā.
rys_davids: What is proficiency in the Elements?⤵That proficiency which is insight, understanding, search, research, etc., when applied to the eighteen elements, viz.: sight, visible shape and visual cognition, hearing, sound and auditory cognition, smell, odour and olfactory cognition, taste, sapid object and gustatory cognition, body-sensibility, the tangible and tactile cognition, mind, mental object and representative cognition.
original: Tattha katamā pāpamittatā? Ye te puggalā assaddhā dussīlā appassutā maccharino duppaññā, yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti taṃsampavaṅkatā – ayaṃ vuccati pāpamittatā.
ai: What is bad friendship? The association, frequent association, close companionship, devotion, or inclination towards those individuals who are faithless, immoral, unlearned, stingy, unwise – this is called bad friendship.

text: 1334. Tattha katamā sovacassatā? Sahadhammike vuccamāne sovacassāyaṃ sovacassiyaṃ sovacassatā appaṭikūlaggāhitā avipaccanīkasātatā sagāravatā sādariyaṃ sādaratā sappaṭissavatā – ayaṃ vuccati sovacassatā.
rys_davids: What is proficiency in attention?⤵That proficiency in attention which is insight, understanding, etc., when applied to those elements.
original: Tattha katamā sovacassatā? Sahadhammike vuccamāne sovacassāyaṃ sovacassiyaṃ sovacassatā appaṭikūlaggāhitā avipaccanīkasātatā sagāravatā sādariyaṃ sādaratā sappaṭissavatā – ayaṃ vuccati sovacassatā.
ai: What is docility? When spoken to by fellow Dhamma practitioners, docility, not taking advice adversely, not habitually antagonistic, respect, deference, reverence, heeding – this is called docility.

text: 1335. Tattha katamā kalyāṇamittatā? Ye te puggalā saddhā sīlavanto bahussutā cāgavanto paññavanto, yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti taṃsampavaṅkatā – ayaṃ vuccati kalyāṇamittatā.
rys_davids: What is skill in the sphere [of sense]?⤵That skill which is insight, understanding, etc., when applied to the twelve spheres, namely, sight and visible shape, hearing and sound, smell and odorous object, taste and sapid object, body-sensibility and the tangible, mind and mental object.
original: Tattha katamā kalyāṇamittatā? Ye te puggalā saddhā sīlavanto bahussutā cāgavanto paññavanto, yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti taṃsampavaṅkatā – ayaṃ vuccati kalyāṇamittatā.
ai: What is good friendship? The association, frequent association, close companionship, devotion, or inclination towards those individuals who are faithful, virtuous, learned, generous, wise – this is called good friendship.

text: 1336. Tattha katamā āpattikusalatā? Pañcapi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo, sattapi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo. Yā tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ āpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati āpattikusalatā.
rys_davids: What is skill in the causal law?⤵Insight, understanding, etc., when applied to the formula: “Karma comes to pass because of ignorance; consciousness comes to pass because of karma; name and shape come to pass because of consciousness; the sixfold sphere comes to pass because of name and shape; contact comes to pass because of the sixfold sphere, feeling because of contact, craving because of feeling, grasping because of craving, rebirth because of grasping, birth because of rebirth, old age and death, grief, lamentation, distress, sorrow and despair come to pass because of birth. Such is the uprising of this whole mass of Ill”.
original: Tattha katamā āpattikusalatā? Pañcapi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo, sattapi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo. Yā tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ āpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati āpattikusalatā.
ai: What is skill in offenses? The five categories of offenses, the seven categories of offenses. The wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view concerning those offenses – this is called skill in offenses.

text: 1337. Tattha katamā āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā? Yā tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is skill in affirming … in negating [causal relation]?⤵Insight, understanding, etc., when applied to discerning that, in a given relation, certain states are … are not, the cause, the condition of certain other states.
original: Tattha katamā āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā? Yā tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā.
ai: What is skill in rising from offenses? The wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view concerning rising from those offenses – this is called skill in rising from offenses.

text: 1338. Tattha katamā samāpattikusalatā? Atthi savitakkasavicārā samāpatti, atthi avitakkavicāramattā samāpatti, atthi avitakkaavicārā samāpatti. Yā tāsaṃ samāpattīnaṃ samāpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati samāpattikusalatā.
original: Tattha katamā samāpattikusalatā? Atthi savitakkasavicārā samāpatti, atthi avitakkavicāramattā samāpatti, atthi avitakkaavicārā samāpatti. Yā tāsaṃ samāpattīnaṃ samāpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati samāpattikusalatā.
ai: What is skill in attainments? There is attainment with initial and sustained application, there is attainment with only sustained application, there is attainment without initial and sustained application. The wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view concerning those attainments – this is called skill in attainments.

text: 1339. Tattha katamā samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā? Yā tāhi samāpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is upright?⤵Uprightness, without deflexion, twist, crookedness.
original: Tattha katamā samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā? Yā tāhi samāpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā.
ai: What is skill in rising from attainments? The wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view concerning rising from those attainments – this is called skill in rising from attainments.

text: 1340. Tattha katamā dhātukusalatā? Aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo cakkhudhātu rūpadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu saddadhātu sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu gandhadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu rasadhātu jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu dhammadhātu manoviññāṇadhātu. Yā tāsaṃ dhātūnaṃ dhātukusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati dhātukusalatā.
rys_davids: What is soft?⤵That which is plasticity, gentleness, smoothness, pliancy, lowliness of heart.
original: Tattha katamā dhātukusalatā? Aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo cakkhudhātu rūpadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu saddadhātu sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu gandhadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu rasadhātu jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu dhammadhātu manoviññāṇadhātu. Yā tāsaṃ dhātūnaṃ dhātukusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati dhātukusalatā.
ai: What is skill in elements? The eighteen elements: eye element, form element, eye-consciousness element; ear element, sound element, ear-consciousness element; nose element, smell element, nose-consciousness element; tongue element, taste element, tongue-consciousness element; body element, tangible element, body-consciousness element; mind element, phenomena element, mind-consciousness element. The wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view concerning those elements – this is called skill in elements.

text: 1341. Tattha katamā manasikārakusalatā? Yā tāsaṃ dhātūnaṃ manasikārakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati manasikārakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is patience?⤵That patience which is long-suffering, compliance, absence of rudeness and abruptness, complacency of heart.
original: Tattha katamā manasikārakusalatā? Yā tāsaṃ dhātūnaṃ manasikārakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati manasikārakusalatā.
ai: What is skillfulness in attention?⤵That wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, which is skillfulness in attending to those elements—this is called skillfulness in attention.

text: 1342. Tattha katamā āyatanakusalatā? Dvādasāyatanāni – cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Yā tesaṃ āyatanānaṃ āyatanakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati āyatanakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is loveableness?⤵That which is the absence of excess in deed, in word, and in deed and word together.⤵Besides, all moral self-restraint is lovely.
original: Tattha katamā āyatanakusalatā? Dvādasāyatanāni – cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Yā tesaṃ āyatanānaṃ āyatanakusalatā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati āyatanakusalatā.
ai: What is skillfulness in sense bases?⤵The twelve sense bases: eye base, visible form base, ear base, sound base, nose base, smell base, tongue base, taste base, body base, tangible base, mind base, mental object base. That wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, which is skillfulness in these sense bases—this is called skillfulness in sense bases.

text: 1343. Tattha katamā paṭiccasamuppādakusalatā? Avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti; evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotīti. Yā tattha paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati paṭiccasamuppādakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is amity?⤵When all such speech as is insolent, disagreeable, scabrous, harsh to others, vituperative to others, bordering upon anger, not conducive to concentration, is put away, and when all such speech as is innocuous, pleasant to the ear, affectionate, such as goes to the heart, is urbane, sweet and acceptable to people generally—when speech of this sort is spoken—polished, friendly and gentle language—this is what is called amity.
original: Tattha katamā paṭiccasamuppādakusalatā? Avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti; evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotīti. Yā tattha paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati paṭiccasamuppādakusalatā.
ai: What is skillfulness in dependent origination?⤵Ignorance conditions formations; formations condition consciousness; consciousness conditions mind-and-matter; mind-and-matter conditions the six sense bases; the six sense bases condition contact; contact conditions feeling; feeling conditions craving; craving conditions clinging; clinging conditions existence; existence conditions birth; birth conditions decay-and-death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, displeasure, and despair. Thus arises this entire mass of suffering. That wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, concerning this—this is called skillfulness in dependent origination.

text: 1344. Tattha katamā ṭhānakusalatā? Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ hetū paccayā uppādāya [upādāya (sī. ka.)] taṃ taṃ ṭhānanti, yā tattha paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati ṭhānakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is courtesy?⤵The two forms of courtesy: hospitality towards bodily needs and considerateness in matters of doctrine. When anyone shows courtesy it is in one or other of these two forms.
original: Tattha katamā ṭhānakusalatā? Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ hetū paccayā uppādāya [upādāya (sī. ka.)] taṃ taṃ ṭhānanti, yā tattha paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati ṭhānakusalatā.
ai: What is skillfulness in what is possible?⤵That which is the understanding that whatever phenomena are causes and conditions for the arising of whatever other phenomena, that is the possible. That wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, concerning this—this is called skillfulness in what is possible.

text: 1345. Tattha katamā aṭṭhānakusalatā? Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ na hetū na paccayā uppādāya taṃ taṃ aṭṭhānanti, yā tattha paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati aṭṭhānakusalatā.
rys_davids: What is it to have the door of the faculties unguarded?⤵When a certain individual sees an object with the eye he is entranced with the general appearance, or in the details of it. He does not set himself to restrain that which might give occasion for wicked states, covetous, dejected, to flow in over him, were he to dwell unrestrained as to the sense of sight. He keeps no watch over his faculty of sight, nor does he attain to mastery over it. And so in like manner when he hears a sound with the ear … smells an odour with the nose … tastes a sapid with the tongue … feels a tangible with the body … recognizes a mental object with the mind, he is entranced with the general appearance and in the details of it. He does not set himself to restrain that which might give occasion for wicked states, covetous, dejected, to flow in over him, were he to dwell unrestrained as to the mental faculty. He keeps no watch over the mental faculty, nor does he attain to mastery over it. That these six faculties should be thus unguarded, untended, unwatched over, unrestrained, is what is called having the door of the faculties unguarded.
original: Tattha katamā aṭṭhānakusalatā? Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ na hetū na paccayā uppādāya taṃ taṃ aṭṭhānanti, yā tattha paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati aṭṭhānakusalatā.
ai: What is skillfulness in what is impossible?⤵That which is the understanding that whatever phenomena are not causes and conditions for the arising of whatever other phenomena, that is the impossible. That wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view, concerning this—this is called skillfulness in what is impossible.

text: 1346. Tattha katamo ajjavo? Yā ajjavatā ajimhatā avaṅkatā akuṭilatā – ayaṃ vuccati ajjavo.
rys_davids: What is immoderation in diet?⤵When anyone, through carelessness and without judgment, takes food for purposes of sport, sensual excess, personal charm and adornment, his insatiableness, immoderation, and want of judgment are what is called immoderation in diet.
original: Tattha katamo ajjavo? Yā ajjavatā ajimhatā avaṅkatā akuṭilatā – ayaṃ vuccati ajjavo.
ai: What is uprightness?⤵That which is straightforwardness, not being crooked, not being devious, not being dishonest—this is called uprightness.

text: 1347. Tattha katamo maddavo? Yā mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā nīcacittatā – ayaṃ vuccati maddavo.
rys_davids: What is it to have the doors of the faculties guarded?⤵When a certain individual sees an object with the eye he is not entranced with the general appearance or the details of it. He sets himself to restrain that which might give occasion for wicked states, covetous, dejected, to flow in over him, were he to dwell unrestrained as to the sense of sight. He keeps watch over this faculty of sight, and attains to mastery over it. And so, in like manner, when he hears a sound with the ear … smells an odour with the nose … tastes a sapid with the tongue … feels a tangible with the body … recognizes an idea with the mind, he is not entranced with the general appearance and the details of it. He sets himself to restrain that which might give occasion for wicked states, covetous, dejected, to flow in over him, were he to dwell unrestrained as to the mental faculty. He keeps watch over the mental faculty, and attains to mastery over it. That these six faculties should be thus guarded, tended, watched over, restrained, is what is called having the doors of the faculties guarded.
original: Tattha katamo maddavo? Yā mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā akathinatā nīcacittatā – ayaṃ vuccati maddavo.
ai: What is gentleness?⤵That which is softness, gentleness, not harshness, not rigidity, humble-mindedness—this is called gentleness.

text: 1348. Tattha katamā khanti? Yā khanti khamanatā adhivāsanatā acaṇḍikkaṃ anasuropo attamanatā cittassa – ayaṃ vuccati khanti.
rys_davids: What is moderation in diet?⤵When anyone takes food with reflection and judgment, not for purposes of sport, excess, personal charm and attractions, but so as to suffice for the sustenance and preservation of the body, for allaying the pangs [of hunger] and for aiding the practice of the higher life, and thinking the while, “I shall subdue that which I have been feeling and shall cause no new feeling to arise, and maintenance shall be mine, blamelessness also and comfort”—this content, moderation, judgment in diet is what is called moderation in diet.
original: Tattha katamā khanti? Yā khanti khamanatā adhivāsanatā acaṇḍikkaṃ anasuropo attamanatā cittassa – ayaṃ vuccati khanti.
ai: What is patience?⤵That which is patience, endurance, tolerance, absence of fierceness, absence of resentment, contentment of mind—this is called patience.

text: 1349. Tattha katamaṃ soraccaṃ? Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo – idaṃ vuccati soraccaṃ. Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro soraccaṃ.
rys_davids: What is forgetfulness?⤵Unmindfulness, lapse of memory, non-recollection, non-remembrance, not bearing in mind, superficiality, oblivion.
original: Tattha katamaṃ soraccaṃ? Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo – idaṃ vuccati soraccaṃ. Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro soraccaṃ.
ai: What is temperance in conduct?⤵That which is bodily non-transgression, verbal non-transgression, bodily and verbal non-transgression—this is called temperance in conduct. All moral restraint is temperance in conduct.

text: 1350. Tattha katamaṃ sākhalyaṃ? Yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā parābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ pahāya yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti; yā tattha saṇhavācatā sakhilavācatā apharusavācatā – idaṃ vuccati sākhalyaṃ.
rys_davids: What is lack of intelligence?⤵Answer as for “ignorance” or “dullness”, § 1311 , etc.
original: Tattha katamaṃ sākhalyaṃ? Yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā parābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ pahāya yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti; yā tattha saṇhavācatā sakhilavācatā apharusavācatā – idaṃ vuccati sākhalyaṃ.
ai: What is amiability in speech?⤵That speech which is harsh, rough, hurtful to others, abusive to others, bordering on anger, not conducive to concentration—having abandoned such speech, that speech which is gentle, pleasing to the ear, affectionate, heartwarming, courteous, agreeable to many, pleasant to many, is spoken; that which is polished speech, friendly speech, gentle speech—this is called amiability in speech.

text: 1351. Tattha katamo paṭisanthāro? Dve paṭisanthārā – āmisapaṭisanthāro ca dhammapaṭisanthāro ca. Idhekacco paṭisanthārako hoti āmisapaṭisanthārena vā dhammapaṭisanthārena vā – ayaṃ vuccati paṭisanthāro.
rys_davids: What is mindfulness?⤵Answer as in § 14 , omitting “on that occasion”.
original: Tattha katamo paṭisanthāro? Dve paṭisanthārā – āmisapaṭisanthāro ca dhammapaṭisanthāro ca. Idhekacco paṭisanthārako hoti āmisapaṭisanthārena vā dhammapaṭisanthārena vā – ayaṃ vuccati paṭisanthāro.
ai: What is hospitality?⤵There are two types of hospitality: material hospitality and Dharma hospitality. Here, some person is hospitable with material hospitality or Dharma hospitality—this is called hospitality.

text: 1352. Tattha katamā indriyesu aguttadvāratā? Idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā…pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā…pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ agutti agopanā anārakkho asaṃvaro – ayaṃ vuccati indriyesu aguttadvāratā.
rys_davids: What is intelligence?⤵Answer as for “insight”, § 16 . And see § 53 .
original: Tattha katamā indriyesu aguttadvāratā? Idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā…pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā…pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ agutti agopanā anārakkho asaṃvaro – ayaṃ vuccati indriyesu aguttadvāratā.
ai: What is unguardedness of the sense doors?⤵Here, perceiving forms with the eye, sounds with the ear, odors with the nose, flavors with the tongue, tangible objects with the body, or mental objects with the mind, one grasps at their general appearance and details. Whereby, while the respective faculty dwells unguarded, evil unwholesome states of covetousness and displeasure might flow in; one does not practice for its restraint, does not protect that faculty, does not undertake restraint in that faculty. The unguardedness, non-protection, non-guarding, non-restraint of these six faculties—this is called unguardedness of the sense doors.

text: 1353. Tattha katamā bhojane amattaññutā? Idhekacco appaṭisaṅkhā ayoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti davāya madāya maṇḍanāya vibhūsanāya. Yā tattha asantuṭṭhitā amattaññutā appaṭisaṅkhā bhojane – ayaṃ vuccati bhojane amattaññutā.
rys_davids: What is the power [called] computation?⤵Answer as for “insight”, § 16 .
original: Tattha katamā bhojane amattaññutā? Idhekacco appaṭisaṅkhā ayoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti davāya madāya maṇḍanāya vibhūsanāya. Yā tattha asantuṭṭhitā amattaññutā appaṭisaṅkhā bhojane – ayaṃ vuccati bhojane amattaññutā.
ai: What is immoderation in food?⤵Here, some person, without reflection, unskillfully takes food for sport, for intoxication, for adornment, for beautification. That dissatisfaction, immoderation, lack of reflection in food—this is called immoderation in food.

text: 1354. Tattha katamā indriyesu guttadvāratā? Idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti na anubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā…pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā…pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ gutti gopanā ārakkho saṃvaro – ayaṃ vuccati indriyesu guttadvāratā.
rys_davids: What is the power [called] cultivation?⤵That which is the pursuing, the cultivating, the multiplying of good states.⤵Moreover, the seven factors of Enlightenment are the power of cultivation.
original: Tattha katamā indriyesu guttadvāratā? Idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti na anubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā…pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā…pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ gutti gopanā ārakkho saṃvaro – ayaṃ vuccati indriyesu guttadvāratā.
ai: What is guardedness of the sense doors?⤵Here, perceiving forms with the eye, sounds with the ear, odors with the nose, flavors with the tongue, tangible objects with the body, or mental objects with the mind, one does not grasp at their general appearance nor details. Whereby, while the respective faculty dwells unguarded, evil unwholesome states of covetousness and displeasure might flow in; one practices for its restraint, protects that faculty, undertakes restraint in that faculty. The guarding, protection, restraint of these six faculties—this is called guardedness of the sense doors.

text: 1355. Tattha katamā bhojane mattaññutā? Idhekacco paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti – neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya , iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti. Yā tattha santuṭṭhitā mattaññutā paṭisaṅkhā bhojane – ayaṃ vuccati bhojane mattaññutā.
rys_davids: What is calm?⤵Answer as for “quiet”, §§ 11 , 54 .
original: Tattha katamā bhojane mattaññutā? Idhekacco paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti – neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya , iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti. Yā tattha santuṭṭhitā mattaññutā paṭisaṅkhā bhojane – ayaṃ vuccati bhojane mattaññutā.
ai: What is moderation in food?⤵Here, some person, with reflection, skillfully takes food—not for sport, not for intoxication, not for adornment, not for beautification, but solely for the maintenance and continuance of this body, for the cessation of discomfort, for the support of the holy life. "Thus I will end old feelings and not produce new feelings, and there will be sustenance for me, blamelessness, and comfortable living." That satisfaction, moderation, reflection in food—this is called moderation in food.

text: 1356. Tattha katamaṃ muṭṭhasaccaṃ? Yā asati ananussati appaṭissati asati asaraṇatā adhāraṇatā pilāpanatā sammusanatā – idaṃ vuccati muṭṭhasaccaṃ.
rys_davids: What is intuition?⤵Answer as for “insight”, §§ 55 , 16 .
original: Tattha katamaṃ muṭṭhasaccaṃ? Yā asati ananussati appaṭissati asati asaraṇatā adhāraṇatā pilāpanatā sammusanatā – idaṃ vuccati muṭṭhasaccaṃ.
ai: What is forgetfulness?⤵That which is absence of mindfulness, non-recollection, non-remembrance, inability to hold in mind, non-holding, letting slip, forgetting—this is called forgetfulness.

text: 1357. Tattha katamaṃ asampajaññaṃ? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – idaṃ vuccati asampajaññaṃ.
rys_davids: What is “the mark of calm”?⤵Answer as for “quiet”, § 1357 .
original: Tattha katamaṃ asampajaññaṃ? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – idaṃ vuccati asampajaññaṃ.
ai: What is lack of clear comprehension?⤵That which is ignorance, non-seeing, delusion, the root of unwholesome states—this is called lack of clear comprehension.

text: 1358. Tattha katamā sati? Yā sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammusanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – ayaṃ vuccati sati.
rys_davids: What is “the mark of grasp”?⤵Answer as for “grasp” and “energy”, §§ 56 , 13 .
original: Tattha katamā sati? Yā sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammusanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati – ayaṃ vuccati sati.
ai: What is mindfulness?⤵That which is mindfulness, recollection, remembrance, calling to mind, holding in mind, not letting slip, not forgetting; mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, right mindfulness—this is called mindfulness.

text: 1359. Tattha katamaṃ sampajaññaṃ? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ vuccati sampajaññaṃ.
rys_davids: What is grasp?⤵Answer as for “the mark of grasp”, § 1358 .
original: Tattha katamaṃ sampajaññaṃ? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ vuccati sampajaññaṃ.
ai: What is clear comprehension?⤵That which is wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view—this is called clear comprehension.

text: 1360. Tattha katamaṃ paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ vuccati paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ.
rys_davids: What is balance?⤵Answer as for “balance”, § 57 .
original: Tattha katamaṃ paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – idaṃ vuccati paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ.
ai: What is the power of reflection?⤵That which is wisdom, understanding, non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view—this is called the power of reflection.

text: 1361. Tattha katamaṃ bhāvanābalaṃ? Yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ – idaṃ vuccati bhāvanābalaṃ. Sattapi bojjhaṅgā bhāvanābalaṃ.
rys_davids: What is moral failure?⤵Excess in deed, excess in word, excess in both together. Moreover, all immorality is moral failure.
original: Tattha katamaṃ bhāvanābalaṃ? Yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ – idaṃ vuccati bhāvanābalaṃ. Sattapi bojjhaṅgā bhāvanābalaṃ.
ai: What is the power of development? The repetition, development, and cultivation of wholesome states. This is called the power of development. The seven factors of enlightenment are also the power of development.

text: 1362. Tattha katamo samatho? Yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati samatho.
rys_davids: What is theoretic fallacy?⤵“There is no such thing as alms, or sacrifice, or offering; there is neither fruit, nor result of good or evil deeds; there is no such thing as this world or the next; there is no such thing as mother, or father, or beings springing into birth without them; there are in the world no recluses or brahmins who have reached the highest point, who have attained the height, who, having understood and realized by themselves alone both this world and the next, make known the same”—all this sort of speculation … this is what is called theoretic fallacy. Moreover, all wrong views are theoretic fallacies.
original: Tattha katamo samatho? Yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati samatho.
ai: What is tranquility? The stability of mind...pe...right concentration. This is called tranquility.

text: 1363. Tattha katamā vipassanā? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati vipassanā.
rys_davids: What is moral achievement?⤵Absence of excess in deed, in word, and in deed and word together.
original: Tattha katamā vipassanā? Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati vipassanā.
ai: What is insight? Wisdom, understanding...pe...non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view. This is called insight.

text: 1364. Tattha katamaṃ samathanimittaṃ? Yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhi – idaṃ vuccati samathanimittaṃ.
rys_davids: What is achievement in view?⤵“There is such a thing as alms, sacrifice, and offering; … fruit, and the result of good and evil deeds; … this world and the next; mother, father, and beings springing into birth without them; … recluses and brahmins who have reached the highest, who have attained the height, who having understood and realized by themselves alone both this world and the other world, make known the same”—all this sort of science, understanding, etc. … this is what is called progress in theory. Moreover, all best views are achievement in view.
original: Tattha katamaṃ samathanimittaṃ? Yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhi – idaṃ vuccati samathanimittaṃ.
ai: What is the sign of tranquility? The stability of mind...pe...right concentration. This is called the sign of tranquility.

text: 1365. Tattha katamaṃ paggāhanimittaṃ? Yo cetasiko vīriyārambho…pe… sammāvāyāmo – idaṃ vuccati paggāhanimittaṃ.
rys_davids: What is purity in morals?⤵Absence of excess in deed, in word, and in deed and word together.
original: Tattha katamaṃ paggāhanimittaṃ? Yo cetasiko vīriyārambho…pe… sammāvāyāmo – idaṃ vuccati paggāhanimittaṃ.
ai: What is the sign of exertion? Mental effort...pe...right effort. This is called the sign of exertion.

text: 1366. Tattha katamo paggāho? Yo cetasiko vīriyārambho…pe… sammāvāyāmo – ayaṃ vuccati paggāho.
rys_davids: What is purity in view?⤵Knowledge of the specific nature of Karma; knowledge of the Truths in their due order; the knowledge of him who holds the Path; the knowledge of him who holds the Fruit of the Path.⤵The phrase “Now purity of view” is equivalent to that insight, understanding … right theory (views) [described above, § 16 ].⤵In the phrase “And as the struggle of him who holds certain views”, “struggle” means that inception of energy etc. [described above, § 13 ].⤵The phrase “agitation” implies dread of birth, dread of old age, dread of sickness, dread of death.⤵The phrase “occasion of agitation” means birth, old age, sickness, death.⤵The phrase “And the earnest struggle of him who is agitated” refers to [the four Right Struggles]: When a bhikkhu brings forth the desire (a) that bad and wicked states which have not arisen should not arise, (b) that bad and wicked states which have arisen should be put away, (c) that good states which have not arisen should arise, (d) that good states which have arisen should stand firm, should not get confused, should be frequently practised, made to abound, cultivated, and perfected—then he uses endeavour, sets energy a-going, reaches forward in thought and struggles.⤵The phrase “And discontent in good states” means the longing for higher achievement in one who is dissatisfied over the cultivation of good states.⤵The phrase “And the not shrinking back in the struggle” means the thorough and persevering and unresting performance, the absence of stagnation, the unfaltering volition, the unflinching endurance, the assiduous pursuit, exercise and repetition which attend the cultivation of good states.⤵The phrase “Wisdom” means the threefold wisdom, namely, (a) reminiscent knowledge of one's former births, (b) knowledge of the decease and renascence of beings, (c) the knowledge that makes an end of the Intoxicants.⤵The phrase “Emancipation” means the twofold emancipation, namely, (a) freedom of thought, and (b) Nirvāna.⤵The phrase “knowledge in making an end” means the knowledge he has who holds the Path.⤵The phrase “knowledge in origins” means the knowledge he has who holds the Fruit of the Path.⤵End of the Division entitled “The Deposition”.⤵A Buddhist Manual of Psychological Ethics , a rys_davids of the Dhammasaṅgaṇī, Compendium of States or Phenomena, by Caroline A.F. original: Tattha katamo paggāho? Yo cetasiko vīriyārambho…pe… sammāvāyāmo – ayaṃ vuccati paggāho.
ai: What is exertion? Mental effort...pe...right effort. This is called exertion.

text: 1367. Tattha katamo avikkhepo? Yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati avikkhepo.
original: Tattha katamo avikkhepo? Yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati avikkhepo.
ai: What is non-distraction? The stability of mind...pe...right concentration. This is called non-distraction.

text: 1368. Tattha katamā sīlavipatti? Yo kāyiko vītikkamo, vācasiko vītikkamo , kāyikavācasiko vītikkamo – ayaṃ vuccati sīlavipatti. Sabbampi dussilyaṃ sīlavipatti.
original: Tattha katamā sīlavipatti? Yo kāyiko vītikkamo, vācasiko vītikkamo , kāyikavācasiko vītikkamo – ayaṃ vuccati sīlavipatti. Sabbampi dussilyaṃ sīlavipatti.
ai: What is moral transgression? Bodily transgression, verbal transgression, or both bodily and verbal transgression. This is called moral transgression. All immorality is moral transgression.

text: 1369. Tattha katamā diṭṭhivipatti? Natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentītiः yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati diṭṭhivipatti. Sabbāpi micchādiṭṭhi diṭṭhivipatti.
original: Tattha katamā diṭṭhivipatti? Natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentītiः yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… vipariyāsaggāho – ayaṃ vuccati diṭṭhivipatti. Sabbāpi micchādiṭṭhi diṭṭhivipatti.
ai: What is wrong view?⤵There is no giving, no sacrifice, no offering; there is no fruit or result of good or evil deeds; there is no this world, nor the next; there is no mother, nor father; there are no spontaneously arisen beings; there are no recluses or brahmins in the world who have gone rightly, practiced rightly, who, having directly known and realized this world and the next by themselves, proclaim it. Such a view, wrong view...pe...perverted grasp. This is called wrong view. All wrong views are wrong view.

text: 1370. Tattha katamā sīlasampadā? Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo – ayaṃ vuccati sīlasampadā. Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro sīlasampadā.
original: Tattha katamā sīlasampadā? Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo – ayaṃ vuccati sīlasampadā. Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro sīlasampadā.
ai: What is moral accomplishment? Bodily non-transgression, verbal non-transgression, or both bodily and verbal non-transgression. This is called moral accomplishment. All restraint in morality is moral accomplishment.

text: 1371. Tattha katamā diṭṭhisampadā? Atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentītiः yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati diṭṭhisampadā. Sabbāpi sammādiṭṭhi diṭṭhisampadā.
original: Tattha katamā diṭṭhisampadā? Atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentītiः yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati diṭṭhisampadā. Sabbāpi sammādiṭṭhi diṭṭhisampadā.
ai:
What is accomplishment in view? There is what is given, offered, sacrificed; there is fruit and result of good and bad actions; there is this world, there is the other world; there is mother, there is father; there are spontaneously arisen beings; there are in the world ascetics and brahmins who are rightly gone and rightly practiced, who proclaim this world and the other world, having directly known and realized them themselves. Such wisdom, knowing... non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view 
– this is called accomplishment in view. All right view is accomplishment in view.

text: 1372. Tattha katamā sīlavisuddhi? Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo – ayaṃ vuccati sīlavisuddhi. Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro sīlavisuddhi.
original: Tattha katamā sīlavisuddhi? Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo – ayaṃ vuccati sīlavisuddhi. Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro sīlavisuddhi.
ai:
What is purity of virtue? Bodily non-transgression, verbal non-transgression, bodily and verbal non-transgression 
– this is called purity of virtue. All virtuous restraint is purity of virtue.

text: 1373. Tattha katamā diṭṭhivisuddhi? Kammassakatañāṇaṃ saccānulomikañāṇaṃ maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ phalasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
original: Tattha katamā diṭṭhivisuddhi? Kammassakatañāṇaṃ saccānulomikañāṇaṃ maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ phalasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
ai: What is purity of view? The knowledge that beings are owners of their actions, knowledge conforming to the Noble Truths, the wisdom of one endowed with the path, the wisdom of one endowed with the fruit.

text: 1374. Diṭṭhivisuddhikho panāti – yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
original: Diṭṭhivisuddhikho panāti – yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
ai: Purity of view is that wisdom, knowing... non-delusion, investigation of phenomena, right view.

text: 1375. Yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhānanti – yo cetasiko vīriyārambho…pe… sammāvāyāmo.
original: Yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhānanti – yo cetasiko vīriyārambho…pe… sammāvāyāmo.
ai: Exertion for one with such a view is mental arousal of energy... right effort.

text: 1376. Saṃvegoti – jātibhayaṃ jarābhayaṃ byādhibhayaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ. Saṃvejaniyaṃ [saṃvejanīyaṃ (sī.)] ṭhānanti – jāti jarā byādhi maraṇaṃ.
original: Saṃvegoti – jātibhayaṃ jarābhayaṃ byādhibhayaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ. Saṃvejaniyaṃ [saṃvejanīyaṃ (sī.)] ṭhānanti – jāti jarā byādhi maraṇaṃ.
ai: Spiritual urgency is the fear of birth, the fear of old age, the fear of sickness, the fear of death. Grounds for spiritual urgency are birth, old age, sickness, death.

text: 1377. Saṃviggassa ca yoniso padhānanti – idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
original: Saṃviggassa ca yoniso padhānanti – idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
ai: Proper exertion for one who has a sense of urgency: Here, a practitioner arouses desire, strives, exerts energy, grasps the mind, and strives for the non-arising of unarisen evil, unwholesome states; for the abandoning of arisen evil, unwholesome states; for the arising of unarisen wholesome states; for the maintenance, non-forgetting, increase, development, cultivation, and perfection of arisen wholesome states.

text: 1378. Asantuṭṭhitā ca kusalesu dhammesūti – yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya asantuṭṭhassa bhiyyokamyatā.
original: Asantuṭṭhitā ca kusalesu dhammesūti – yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya asantuṭṭhassa bhiyyokamyatā.
ai: Non-contentment with wholesome states is the desire for more for one not content with the cultivation of wholesome states.

text: 1379. Appaṭivānitā ca padhānasminti – yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya sakkaccakiriyatā sātaccakiriyatā aṭṭhitakiriyatā anolīnavuttitā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ.
original: Appaṭivānitā ca padhānasminti – yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya sakkaccakiriyatā sātaccakiriyatā aṭṭhitakiriyatā anolīnavuttitā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ.
ai: Non-recoiling from exertion is diligent performance, continuous performance, unwavering performance, unflagging conduct, unabandoned desire, unabandoned burden in the repetition, development, and cultivation of wholesome states.

text: 1380. Vijjāti – tisso vijjā – pubbenivāsānussati ñāṇaṃ vijjā, sattānaṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇaṃ vijjā, āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ vijjā.
original: Vijjāti – tisso vijjā – pubbenivāsānussati ñāṇaṃ vijjā, sattānaṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇaṃ vijjā, āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ vijjā.
ai: True knowledge: The three true knowledges are the knowledge of recollecting past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearing of beings, and the knowledge of the destruction of the taints.

text: 1381. Vimuttīti – dve vimuttiyo – cittassa [cittassa ca (sī. syā.)] adhimutti, nibbānañca.
original: Vimuttīti – dve vimuttiyo – cittassa [cittassa ca (sī. syā.)] adhimutti, nibbānañca.
ai: Liberation means two liberations: the mind's resolution and Nibbāna.

text: 1382. Khaye ñāṇanti – maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
original: Khaye ñāṇanti – maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
ai: Knowledge of destruction means the knowledge of one endowed with the path.

text: 1383. Anuppāde ñāṇanti – phalasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
original: Anuppāde ñāṇanti – phalasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
ai: Knowledge of non-arising means the knowledge of one endowed with fruition.

text: Nikkhepakaṇḍaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
original: Nikkhepakaṇḍaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
ai: The Section on Elucidation is concluded.

text: 4. Aṭṭhakathākaṇḍaṃ
original: 4. Aṭṭhakathākaṇḍaṃ
ai: 4. Commentary Section

text: Tikaatthuddhāro
original: Tikaatthuddhāro
ai: Elucidation of the Tika Meanings

text: 1384. Katame dhammā kusalā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ – ime dhammā kusalā.
original: Katame dhammā kusalā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ – ime dhammā kusalā.
ai: Which phenomena are wholesome? Wholesome phenomena are the wholesome in the four planes.

text: 1385. Katame dhammā akusalā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā akusalā.
original: Katame dhammā akusalā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā akusalā.
ai: Which phenomena are unwholesome? Unwholesome phenomena are the twelve unwholesome states of consciousness.

text: 1386. Katame dhammā abyākatā? Catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā abyākatā.
original: Katame dhammā abyākatā? Catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā abyākatā.
ai: Which phenomena are indeterminate? Indeterminate phenomena are resultant in the four planes, functional indeterminate in the three planes, and matter, and Nibbāna.

text: 1387. Katame dhammā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ca kiriyato ca pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ca kiriyato ca pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with pleasant feeling? These phenomena are the four wholesome sense-sphere consciousnesses accompanied by joy; the four unwholesome (consciousnesses); the five resultant and functional from wholesome sense-sphere; the wholesome, resultant, and functional fine-material sphere 3rd and 4th jhānas; the wholesome and resultant supramundane 3rd and 4th jhānas; excluding the pleasant feeling that arises therein.

text: 1388. Katame dhammā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā? Dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ, etthuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā? Dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ, etthuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
ai:
What phenomena are associated with painful feeling? The two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure, and the body-consciousness accompanied by pain, excluding the painful feeling arising therein 

– these phenomena are associated with painful feeling.

text: 1389. Katame dhammā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro arūpāvacarā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā. Tisso ca vedanā, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na vattabbā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi, ya vedanāya sampayuttātipi.
original: Katame dhammā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro arūpāvacarā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā. Tisso ca vedanā, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na vattabbā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi, ya vedanāya sampayuttātipi.
ai:
What phenomena are associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling? The four wholesome sense-sphere consciousnesses accompanied by equanimity, the six unwholesome, the ten resultant wholesome sense-sphere, the six resultant unwholesome, the six functional, the fine-material sphere fourth jhána (wholesome, resultant, and functional), the four immaterial sphere (wholesome, resultant, and functional), and the supramundane fourth jhána (wholesome and resultant), excluding the neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arising therein 

– these phenomena are associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. The three feelings, and matter, and Nibbána 

– these phenomena are not said to be associated with pleasant feeling, nor with painful feeling, nor with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

text: 1390. Katame dhammā vipākā? Catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko – ime dhammā vipākā.
original: Katame dhammā vipākā? Catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko – ime dhammā vipākā.
ai:
What phenomena are resultants? Resultant phenomena in the four planes 

– these phenomena are resultants.

text: 1391. Katame dhammā vipākadhammadhammā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā vipākadhammadhammā.
original: Katame dhammā vipākadhammadhammā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā vipākadhammadhammā.
ai:
What phenomena are of the nature to produce resultants? Wholesome and unwholesome phenomena in the four planes 

– these phenomena are of the nature to produce resultants.

text: 1392. Katame dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā.
original: Katame dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā.
ai:
What phenomena are neither resultant nor of the nature to produce resultants? Functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, and matter, and Nibbána 

– these phenomena are neither resultant nor of the nature to produce resultants.

text: 1393. Katame dhammā upādiṇṇupādāniyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, yañca rūpaṃ kammassa katattā – ime dhammā upādiṇṇupādāniyā.
original: Katame dhammā upādiṇṇupādāniyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, yañca rūpaṃ kammassa katattā – ime dhammā upādiṇṇupādāniyā.
ai:
What phenomena are clung to and graspable? Resultant phenomena in the three planes, and that matter which is produced by kamma 

– these phenomena are clung to and graspable.

text: 1394. Katame dhammā anupādiṇṇupādāniyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ , yañca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā – ime dhammā anupādiṇṇupādāniyā.
original: Katame dhammā anupādiṇṇupādāniyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ , yañca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā – ime dhammā anupādiṇṇupādāniyā.
ai:
What phenomena are not clung to but graspable? Wholesome phenomena in the three planes, unwholesome phenomena in the three planes, functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, and that matter which is not produced by kamma 

– these phenomena are not clung to but graspable.

text: 1395. Katame dhammā anupādiṇṇaanupādāniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anupādiṇṇaanupādāniyā.
original: Katame dhammā anupādiṇṇaanupādāniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anupādiṇṇaanupādāniyā.
ai:
What phenomena are not clung to and not graspable? The four supramundane paths, the four fruitions of recluseship, and Nibbána 

– these phenomena are not clung to and not graspable.

text: 1396. Katame dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā? Dvādasākusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā.
original: Katame dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā? Dvādasākusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā.
ai:
What phenomena are defiled and defiling? The twelve unwholesome consciousnesses 

– these phenomena are defiled and defiling.

text: 1397. Katame dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā.
original: Katame dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā.
ai:
What phenomena are undefiled but defiling? Wholesome phenomena in the three planes, resultant phenomena in the three planes, functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, and all matter 

– these phenomena are undefiled but defiling.

text: 1398. Katame dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā.
original: Katame dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā.
ai: What phenomena are undefiled and non-defiling? The four supramundane paths, the four fruits of recluseship, and Nibbána – these phenomena are undefiled and non-defiling.

text: 1399. Katame dhammā savitakkasavicārā? Kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato dve, kiriyato ekādasa, rūpāvacaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppanne vitakkavicāre ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā savitakkasavicārā.
original: Katame dhammā savitakkasavicārā?
