Aganthaniyā dhammā na vattabbā – ganthā ceva ganthaniyā cātipi, ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthātipi.
original: Katame dhammā ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthā? Ṭhapetvā ganthe avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthā. Aganthaniyā dhammā na vattabbā – ganthā ceva ganthaniyā cātipi, ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are tied but not ties? The remaining unwholesome states (excluding the ties), wholesome states in the three planes, resultant states in the three planes, functional states in the three planes, and all matter – these phenomena are tied but not ties. Untied phenomena are not to be called "both ties and tied" nor "tied but not ties."

text: 1497. Katame dhammā ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā ca? Yattha diṭṭhi ca lobho ca ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā ca.
original: Katame dhammā ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā ca? Yattha diṭṭhi ca lobho ca ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā ca.
ai: Which phenomena are both ties and associated with ties? Where wrong view and greed arise together – these phenomena are both ties and associated with ties.

text: 1498. Katame dhammā ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthā? Aṭṭha lobhasahagatacittuppādā dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, etthuppanne ganthe ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthā. Ganthavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā cātipi, ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthātipi.
original: Katame dhammā ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthā? Aṭṭha lobhasahagatacittuppādā dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, etthuppanne ganthe ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthā. Ganthavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā cātipi, ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with ties but not ties? The eight greed-rooted consciousnesses and the two displeasure-accompanied consciousnesses, excluding the ties arising therein – these phenomena are associated with ties but not ties. Phenomena dissociated from ties are not to be called "both ties and associated with ties" nor "associated with ties but not ties."

text: 1499. Katame dhammā ganthavippayuttā ganthaniyā? Catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppanno lobho, dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppannaṃ paṭighaṃ, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā ganthavippayuttā ganthaniyā.
original: Katame dhammā ganthavippayuttā ganthaniyā? Catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppanno lobho, dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppannaṃ paṭighaṃ, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā ganthavippayuttā ganthaniyā.
ai: Which phenomena are dissociated from ties and tied? The greed arising in the four greed-rooted consciousnesses dissociated from wrong view, the aversion arising in the two displeasure-accompanied consciousnesses, the consciousness accompanied by doubt, the consciousness accompanied by restlessness, wholesome states in the three planes, resultant states in the three planes, functional states in the three planes, and all matter – these phenomena are dissociated from ties and tied.

text: 1500. Katame dhammā ganthavippayuttā aganthaniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā ganthavippayuttā aganthaniyā. Ganthasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – ganthavippayuttā ganthaniyātipi, ganthavippayuttā aganthaniyātipi.
original: Katame dhammā ganthavippayuttā aganthaniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā ganthavippayuttā aganthaniyā. Ganthasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – ganthavippayuttā ganthaniyātipi, ganthavippayuttā aganthaniyātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are dissociated from ties and untied? The four supramundane paths, the four fruits of recluseship, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are dissociated from ties and untied. Phenomena associated with ties are not to be called "dissociated from ties and tied" nor "dissociated from ties and untied."

text: Nīvaraṇagocchakaṃ
original: Nīvaraṇagocchakaṃ
ai: The Hindrances Group

text: 1503. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā? Cha nīvaraṇā – kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ . Kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ aṭṭhasu lobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ sasaṅkhārikesu akusalesu uppajjati, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, kukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ vicikicchāsahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ sabbākusalesu uppajjati – ime dhammā nīvaraṇā.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā? Cha nīvaraṇā – kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ . Kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ aṭṭhasu lobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ sasaṅkhārikesu akusalesu uppajjati, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, kukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ vicikicchāsahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ sabbākusalesu uppajjati – ime dhammā nīvaraṇā.
ai: What are the phenomena that are hindrances? Six hindrances: sensual desire hindrance, ill will hindrance, sloth and torpor hindrance, restlessness and worry hindrance, skeptical doubt hindrance, ignorance hindrance. Sensual desire hindrance arises in the eight consciousnesses accompanied by greed; ill will hindrance arises in the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure; sloth and torpor hindrance arises in prompted unwholesome states; restlessness hindrance arises in consciousnesses accompanied by restlessness; worry hindrance arises in the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure; skeptical doubt hindrance arises in consciousnesses accompanied by skeptical doubt; ignorance hindrance arises in all unwholesome states. These phenomena are hindrances.

text: 1504. Katame dhammā no nīvaraṇā? Ṭhapetvā nīvaraṇe avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no nīvaraṇā.
original: Katame dhammā no nīvaraṇā? Ṭhapetvā nīvaraṇe avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no nīvaraṇā.
ai: What are the phenomena that are not hindrances? Apart from the hindrances, the remaining unwholesome states, wholesome states in the four planes, resultant states in the four planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, and matter, and Nibbāna. These phenomena are not hindrances.

text: 1505. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇiyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇiyā.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇiyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇiyā.
ai: What are the phenomena that are hindrable? Wholesome states in the three planes, unwholesome states, resultant states in the three planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, and all matter. These phenomena are hindrable.

text: 1506. Katame dhammā anīvaraṇiyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anīvaraṇiyā.
original: Katame dhammā anīvaraṇiyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anīvaraṇiyā.
ai: What are the phenomena that are unhindrable? The four supramundane paths, and the four fruits of recluseship, and Nibbāna. These phenomena are unhindrable.

text: 1507. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā.
ai: What are the phenomena associated with hindrances? The twelve unwholesome consciousnesses. These phenomena are associated with hindrances.

text: 1508. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā.
ai: Which dhammas are dissociated from hindrances? Wholesome consciousness in the four planes, resultant consciousness in the four planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, and matter, and Nibbāna – these dhammas are dissociated from hindrances.

text: 1509. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā ca? Tāneva nīvaraṇāni nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā ca.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā ca? Tāneva nīvaraṇāni nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā ca.
ai: Which dhammas are hindrances and also liable to be hindered? The hindrances themselves are hindrances and also liable to be hindered.

text: 1510. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā? Ṭhapetvā nīvaraṇe, avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā. Anīvaraṇiyā dhammā na vattabbā – nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā cātipi, nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇātipi.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā? Ṭhapetvā nīvaraṇe, avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā. Anīvaraṇiyā dhammā na vattabbā – nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā cātipi, nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are liable to be hindered but are not hindrances themselves? Excluding the hindrances, the remaining unwholesome states, wholesome consciousness in the three planes, resultant consciousness in the three planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, and all matter – these dhammas are liable to be hindered but are not hindrances themselves. Dhammas not liable to be hindered should not be said to be hindrances and also liable to be hindered, or liable to be hindered but not hindrances themselves.

text: 1511. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā ca? Yattha dve tīṇi nīvaraṇāni ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā ca.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā ca? Yattha dve tīṇi nīvaraṇāni ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā ca.
ai: Which dhammas are hindrances and associated with hindrances? Where two or three hindrances arise together – these dhammas are hindrances and associated with hindrances.

text: 1512. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā? Ṭhapetvā nīvaraṇe, avasesaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā. Nīvaraṇavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā cātipi, nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇātipi.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā? Ṭhapetvā nīvaraṇe, avasesaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā. Nīvaraṇavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā cātipi, nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are associated with hindrances but are not hindrances themselves? Excluding the hindrances, the remaining unwholesome states – these dhammas are associated with hindrances but are not hindrances themselves. Dhammas dissociated from hindrances should not be said to be hindrances and associated with hindrances, or associated with hindrances but not hindrances themselves.

text: 1513. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā nīvaraṇiyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā nīvaraṇiyā.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā nīvaraṇiyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā nīvaraṇiyā.
ai: Which dhammas are dissociated from hindrances but liable to be hindered? Wholesome consciousness in the three planes, resultant consciousness in the three planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, and all matter – these dhammas are dissociated from hindrances but liable to be hindered.

text: 1514. Katame dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā anīvaraṇiyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā anīvaraṇiyā. Nīvaraṇasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – nīvaraṇavippayuttā nīvaraṇiyātipi, nīvaraṇavippayuttā anīvaraṇiyātipi.
original: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā anīvaraṇiyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttā anīvaraṇiyā. Nīvaraṇasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – nīvaraṇavippayuttā nīvaraṇiyātipi, nīvaraṇavippayuttā anīvaraṇiyātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are dissociated from hindrances and not liable to be hindered? The four supramundane paths, and the four supramundane fruits, and Nibbāna – these dhammas are dissociated from hindrances and not liable to be hindered. Dhammas associated with hindrances should not be said to be dissociated from hindrances but liable to be hindered, or dissociated from hindrances and not liable to be hindered.

text: Parāmāsagocchakaṃ
original: Parāmāsagocchakaṃ
ai: Group concerning Misapprehension/Clinging

text: 1515. Katame dhammā parāmāsā? Diṭṭhiparāmāso catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu cittuppādesu uppajjati – ime dhammā parāmāsā.
original: Katame dhammā parāmāsā? Diṭṭhiparāmāso catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu cittuppādesu uppajjati – ime dhammā parāmāsā.
ai: Which dhammas are misapprehensions/clinging? Wrong view arises in the four types of consciousness associated with wrong view – these dhammas are misapprehensions/clinging.

text: 1516. Katame dhammā no parāmāsā? Ṭhapetvā parāmāsaṃ avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no parāmāsā.
original: Katame dhammā no parāmāsā? Ṭhapetvā parāmāsaṃ avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no parāmāsā.
ai: Which dhammas are not misapprehensions/clinging? Excluding misapprehension/clinging, the remaining unwholesome states, wholesome consciousness in the four planes, resultant consciousness in the four planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, and matter, and Nibbāna – these dhammas are not misapprehensions/clinging.

text: 1517. Katame dhammā parāmaṭṭhā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā parāmaṭṭhā.
original: Katame dhammā parāmaṭṭhā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā parāmaṭṭhā.
ai: Which phenomena are clung to? Wholesome, unwholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate phenomena in the three realms, and all matter – these phenomena are clung to.

text: 1518. Katame dhammā aparāmaṭṭhā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni nibbānañca – ime dhammā aparāmaṭṭhā.
original: Katame dhammā aparāmaṭṭhā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni nibbānañca – ime dhammā aparāmaṭṭhā.
ai: Which phenomena are not clung to? The four supramundane paths, the four supramundane fruits, and Nibbana – these phenomena are not clung to.

text: 1519. Katame dhammā parāmāsasampayuttā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, etthuppannaṃ parāmāsaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā parāmāsasampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā parāmāsasampayuttā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, etthuppannaṃ parāmāsaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā parāmāsasampayuttā.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with wrong view? The four consciousnesses associated with wrong view, excluding the wrong view arising therein – these phenomena are associated with wrong view.

text: 1520. Katame dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā , dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā. Parāmāso na vattabbo – parāmāsasampayuttotipi, parāmāsavippayuttotipi.
original: Katame dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā , dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā. Parāmāso na vattabbo – parāmāsasampayuttotipi, parāmāsavippayuttotipi.
ai: Which phenomena are disassociated from wrong view? The four consciousnesses rooted in greed and disassociated from wrong view, the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure, the consciousness accompanied by doubt, the consciousness accompanied by restlessness, wholesome and resultant phenomena in the four realms, functional indeterminate phenomena in the three realms, matter, and Nibbana – these phenomena are disassociated from wrong view. Wrong view itself is not to be classified as associated with wrong view, nor as disassociated from wrong view.

text: 1521. Katame dhammā parāmāsā ceva parāmaṭṭhā ca? So eva parāmāso parāmāso ceva parāmaṭṭho ca.
original: Katame dhammā parāmāsā ceva parāmaṭṭhā ca? So eva parāmāso parāmāso ceva parāmaṭṭho ca.
ai: Which phenomena are wrong view and are clung to? Wrong view itself is wrong view and is clung to.

text: 1522. Katame dhammā parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā? Ṭhapetvā parāmāsaṃ avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā. Aparāmaṭṭhā dhammā na vattabbā – parāmāsā ceva parāmaṭṭhā cātipi, parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsātipi.
original: Katame dhammā parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā? Ṭhapetvā parāmāsaṃ avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā. Aparāmaṭṭhā dhammā na vattabbā – parāmāsā ceva parāmaṭṭhā cātipi, parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are clung to but are not wrong view? All unwholesome phenomena except wrong view, wholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate phenomena in the three realms, and all matter – these phenomena are clung to but are not wrong view. Phenomena that are not clung to are not to be classified as wrong view and clung to, nor as clung to but not wrong view.

text: 1523. Katame dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā parāmaṭṭhā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā parāmaṭṭhā.
original: Katame dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā parāmaṭṭhā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā parāmaṭṭhā.
ai: Which phenomena are disassociated from wrong view and are clung to? The four consciousnesses rooted in greed and disassociated from wrong view, the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure, the consciousness accompanied by doubt, the consciousness accompanied by restlessness, wholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate phenomena in the three realms, and all matter – these phenomena are disassociated from wrong view and are clung to.

text: 1524. Katame dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā aparāmaṭṭhā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā aparāmaṭṭhā. Parāmāsā ca parāmāsasampayuttā ca dhammā na vattabbā – parāmāsavippayuttā parāmaṭṭhātipi, parāmāsavippayuttā aparāmaṭṭhātipi.
original: Katame dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā aparāmaṭṭhā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā parāmāsavippayuttā aparāmaṭṭhā. Parāmāsā ca parāmāsasampayuttā ca dhammā na vattabbā – parāmāsavippayuttā parāmaṭṭhātipi, parāmāsavippayuttā aparāmaṭṭhātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are disassociated from wrong view and are not clung to? The four supramundane paths, the four supramundane fruits, and Nibbana – these phenomena are disassociated from wrong view and are not clung to. Wrong view itself and phenomena associated with wrong view are not to be classified as disassociated from wrong view and clung to, nor as disassociated from wrong view and not clung to.

text: Mahantaradukaṃ
original: Mahantaradukaṃ
ai: Mahantaradukaṃ

text: 1525. Katame dhammā sārammaṇā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ – ime dhammā sārammaṇā.
original: Katame dhammā sārammaṇā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ – ime dhammā sārammaṇā.
ai: Which phenomena have an object? Wholesome, unwholesome, and resultant phenomena in the four realms, and functional indeterminate phenomena in the three realms – these phenomena have an object.

text: 1526. Katame dhammā anārammaṇā? Rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anārammaṇā.
original: Katame dhammā anārammaṇā? Rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anārammaṇā.
ai: What phenomena are without object? Matter and Nibbāna – these phenomena are without object.

text: 1527. Katame dhammā cittā? Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manodhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu – ime dhammā cittā.
original: Katame dhammā cittā? Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manodhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu – ime dhammā cittā.
ai: What phenomena are consciousness? Eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, mind-element, mind-consciousness element – these phenomena are consciousness.

text: 1528. Katame dhammā no cittā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittā.
original: Katame dhammā no cittā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittā.
ai: What phenomena are not consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not consciousness.

text: 1529. Katame dhammā cetasikā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cetasikā.
original: Katame dhammā cetasikā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cetasikā.
ai: What phenomena are mental factors? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations – these phenomena are mental factors.

text: 1530. Katame dhammā acetasikā? Cittañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā acetasikā.
original: Katame dhammā acetasikā? Cittañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā acetasikā.
ai: What phenomena are not mental factors? Consciousness, matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not mental factors.

text: 1531. Katame dhammā cittasampayuttā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā cittasampayuttā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasampayuttā.
ai: What phenomena are associated with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations – these phenomena are associated with consciousness.

text: 1532. Katame dhammā cittavippayuttā? Rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā cittavippayuttā. Cittaṃ na vattabbaṃ – cittena sampayuttantipi, cittena vippayuttantipi.
original: Katame dhammā cittavippayuttā? Rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā cittavippayuttā. Cittaṃ na vattabbaṃ – cittena sampayuttantipi, cittena vippayuttantipi.
ai: What phenomena are dissociated from consciousness? Matter and Nibbāna – these phenomena are dissociated from consciousness. Consciousness should not be said to be associated with consciousness, nor dissociated from consciousness.

text: 1533. Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhā.
original: Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhā.
ai: What phenomena are conjoined with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations – these phenomena are conjoined with consciousness.

text: 1534. Katame dhammā cittavisaṃsaṭṭhā? Rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā cittavisaṃsaṭṭhā. Cittaṃ na vattabbaṃ – cittena saṃsaṭṭhantipi, cittena visaṃsaṭṭhantipi.
original: Katame dhammā cittavisaṃsaṭṭhā? Rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā cittavisaṃsaṭṭhā. Cittaṃ na vattabbaṃ – cittena saṃsaṭṭhantipi, cittena visaṃsaṭṭhantipi.
ai: What phenomena are disjoined from consciousness? Matter and Nibbāna – these phenomena are disjoined from consciousness. Consciousness should not be said to be conjoined with consciousness, nor disjoined from consciousness.

text: 1535. Katame dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – ime dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānā.
original: Katame dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānā? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ākāsadhātu āpodhātu rūpassa lahutā rūpassa mudutā rūpassa kammaññatā rūpassa upacayo rūpassa santati kabaḷīkāro āhāro – ime dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānā.
ai: What phenomena are originated by consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, bodily intimation, verbal intimation, and whatever other matter there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated – visual object, sound object, smell object, taste object, tangible object, space element, water element, lightness of matter, pliancy of matter, adaptability of matter, growth of matter, continuity of matter, nutriment – these phenomena are originated by consciousness.

text: 1536. Katame dhammā no cittasamuṭṭhānā? Cittañca, avasesañca rūpaṃ, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasamuṭṭhānā.
original: Katame dhammā no cittasamuṭṭhānā? Cittañca, avasesañca rūpaṃ, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasamuṭṭhānā.
ai: What phenomena are not mind-originated? Consciousness, remaining matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not mind-originated.

text: 1537. Katame dhammā cittasahabhuno? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti – ime dhammā cittasahabhuno.
original: Katame dhammā cittasahabhuno? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti – ime dhammā cittasahabhuno.
ai: What phenomena are co-existent with mind? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate, bodily intimation, and verbal intimation – these phenomena are co-existent with mind.

text: 1538. Katame dhammā no cittasahabhuno? Cittañca, avasesañca rūpaṃ, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasahabhuno.
original: Katame dhammā no cittasahabhuno? Cittañca, avasesañca rūpaṃ, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasahabhuno.
ai: What phenomena are not co-existent with mind? Consciousness, remaining matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not co-existent with mind.

text: 1539. Katame dhammā cittānuparivattino? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti – ime dhammā cittānuparivattino.
original: Katame dhammā cittānuparivattino? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti – ime dhammā cittānuparivattino.
ai: What phenomena accompany mind? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate, bodily intimation, and verbal intimation – these phenomena accompany mind.

text: 1540. Katame dhammā no cittānuparivattino? Cittañca, avasesañca rūpaṃ, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittānuparivattino.
original: Katame dhammā no cittānuparivattino? Cittañca, avasesañca rūpaṃ, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittānuparivattino.
ai: What phenomena do not accompany mind? Consciousness, remaining matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena do not accompany mind.

text: 1541. Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā? Vedanākkhandho , saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā.
original: Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā? Vedanākkhandho , saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā.
ai: What phenomena originate from and are associated with mind? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the formations aggregate – these phenomena originate from and are associated with mind.

text: 1542. Katame dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā? Cittañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā.
original: Katame dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā? Cittañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā.
ai: What phenomena do not originate from and are associated with mind? Consciousness, matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena do not originate from and are associated with mind.

text: 1543. Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno.
original: Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno.
ai: What phenomena are co-existent with, originate from, and are associated with mind? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the formations aggregate – these phenomena are co-existent with, originate from, and are associated with mind.

text: 1544. Katame dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno? Cittañca, rūpañca , nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno.
original: Katame dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno? Cittañca, rūpañca , nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuno.
ai: What phenomena are not co-existent with, originate from, and are associated with mind? Consciousness, matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not co-existent with, originate from, and are associated with mind.

text: 1545. Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino.
original: Katame dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – ime dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino.
ai: What phenomena accompany, originate from, and are associated with mind? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the formations aggregate – these phenomena accompany, originate from, and are associated with mind.

text: 1546. Katame dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino? Cittañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino.
original: Katame dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino? Cittañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino.
ai: Which phenomena do not arise in conjunction with, are not dependent on, and do not follow consciousness? Consciousness, matter, and Nibbana – these phenomena do not arise in conjunction with, are not dependent on, and do not follow consciousness.

text: 1547. Katame dhammā ajjhattikā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… manāyatanaṃ – ime dhammā ajjhattikā.
original: Katame dhammā ajjhattikā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… manāyatanaṃ – ime dhammā ajjhattikā.
ai: Which phenomena are internal? The eye-base... up to... the mind-base – these phenomena are internal.

text: 1548. Katame dhammā bāhirā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ – ime dhammā bāhirā.
original: Katame dhammā bāhirā? Rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ – ime dhammā bāhirā.
ai: Which phenomena are external? The visible-form-base... up to... the dhamma-base – these phenomena are external.

text: 1549. Katame dhammā upādā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – ime dhammā upādā.
original: Katame dhammā upādā? Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro – ime dhammā upādā.
ai: Which phenomena are objects of clinging? The eye-base... up to... edible food – these phenomena are objects of clinging.

text: 1550. Katame dhammā no upādā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, cattāro ca mahābhūtā, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no upādā.
original: Katame dhammā no upādā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, cattāro ca mahābhūtā, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no upādā.
ai: Which phenomena are not objects of clinging? Wholesome states in the four planes, unwholesome states, resultant states in the four planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, the four great essential matters, and Nibbana – these phenomena are not objects of clinging.

text: 1551. Katame dhammā upādiṇṇā? Tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, yañca rūpaṃ kammassa katattā – ime dhammā upādiṇṇā.
original: Katame dhammā upādiṇṇā? Tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, yañca rūpaṃ kammassa katattā – ime dhammā upādiṇṇā.
ai: Which phenomena are clung-to? Resultant states in the three planes, and matter produced by kamma – these phenomena are clung-to.

text: 1552. Katame dhammā anupādiṇṇā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, yañca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā, cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anupādiṇṇā.
original: Katame dhammā anupādiṇṇā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, yañca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā, cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anupādiṇṇā.
ai: Which phenomena are not clung-to? Wholesome states in the three planes, unwholesome states, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, matter not produced by kamma, the four supramundane paths, the four supramundane fruits, and Nibbana – these phenomena are not clung-to.

text: Upādānagocchakaṃ
original: Upādānagocchakaṃ
ai: Upādānagocchakaṃ (The Section on Clinging)

text: 1553. Katame dhammā upādānā? Cattāri upādānāni – kāmupādānaṃ , diṭṭhupādānaṃ, sīlabbatupādānaṃ, attavādupādānaṃ. Kāmupādānaṃ aṭṭhasu lobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Diṭṭhupādānañca sīlabbatupādānañca attavādupādānañca catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu cittuppādesu uppajjanti – ime dhammā upādānā.
original: Katame dhammā upādānā? Cattāri upādānāni – kāmupādānaṃ , diṭṭhupādānaṃ, sīlabbatupādānaṃ, attavādupādānaṃ. Kāmupādānaṃ aṭṭhasu lobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Diṭṭhupādānañca sīlabbatupādānañca attavādupādānañca catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu cittuppādesu uppajjanti – ime dhammā upādānā.
ai: Which phenomena are clingings? The four clingings: sensual clinging, clinging to views, clinging to rites and rituals, clinging to a doctrine of self. Sensual clinging arises in the eight consciousnesses accompanied by greed. Clinging to views, clinging to rites and rituals, and clinging to a doctrine of self arise in the four consciousnesses associated with wrong view – these phenomena are clingings.

text: 1554. Katame dhammā no upādānā? Ṭhapetvā upādāne avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no upādānā.
original: Katame dhammā no upādānā? Ṭhapetvā upādāne avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no upādānā.
ai: Which phenomena are not clingings? Apart from the clingings, the remaining unwholesome states, wholesome states in the four planes, resultant states in the four planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, matter, and Nibbana – these phenomena are not clingings.

text: 1555. Katame dhammā upādāniyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā upādāniyā.
original: Katame dhammā upādāniyā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā upādāniyā.
ai: Which phenomena are objects of clinging? Wholesome states in the three planes, unwholesome states, resultant states in the three planes, functional states in the three planes, and all material phenomena – these phenomena are objects of clinging.

text: 1556. Katame dhammā anupādāniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anupādāniyā.
original: Katame dhammā anupādāniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anupādāniyā.
ai: Which phenomena are not objects of clinging? The four supramundane paths, the four supramundane fruits, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not objects of clinging.

text: 1557. Katame dhammā upādānasampayuttā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, etthuppannaṃ lobhaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā upādānasampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā upādānasampayuttā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, etthuppannaṃ lobhaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā upādānasampayuttā.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with clinging? The four consciousnesses rooted in greed associated with wrong view, and the four consciousnesses rooted in greed dissociated from wrong view, excluding the greed arising therein – these phenomena are associated with clinging.

text: 1558. Katame dhammā upādānavippayuttā? Catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppanno lobho, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā upādānavippayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā upādānavippayuttā? Catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppanno lobho, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā upādānavippayuttā.
ai: Which phenomena are dissociated from clinging? The greed arising in the four consciousnesses rooted in greed dissociated from wrong view, the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure, the consciousness accompanied by doubt, the consciousness accompanied by restlessness, wholesome states in the four planes, resultant states in the four planes, functional states in the three planes, material phenomena, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are dissociated from clinging.

text: 1559. Katame dhammā upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca? Tāneva upādānāni upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca.
original: Katame dhammā upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca? Tāneva upādānāni upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca.
ai: Which phenomena are both clinging and objects of clinging? The clinging factors themselves are both clinging and objects of clinging.

text: 1560. Katame dhammā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā? Ṭhapetvā upādāne avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā . Anupādāniyā dhammā na vattabbā – upādānā ceva upādāniyā cātipi, upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānātipi.
original: Katame dhammā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā? Ṭhapetvā upādāne avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā . Anupādāniyā dhammā na vattabbā – upādānā ceva upādāniyā cātipi, upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are objects of clinging but not clinging itself? All remaining unwholesome states, excluding the clinging factors, wholesome states in the three planes, resultant states in the three planes, functional states in the three planes, and all material phenomena – these phenomena are objects of clinging but not clinging itself. Phenomena that are not objects of clinging cannot be said to be both clinging and objects of clinging, nor objects of clinging but not clinging itself.

text: 1561. Katame dhammā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca? Yattha diṭṭhi ca lobho ca ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca.
original: Katame dhammā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca? Yattha diṭṭhi ca lobho ca ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca.
ai: Which phenomena are both clinging and associated with clinging? Where wrong view and greed arise together – these phenomena are both clinging and associated with clinging.

text: 1562. Katame dhammā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā? Aṭṭha lobhasahagatacittuppādā, etthuppanne upādāne ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā. Upādānavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā cātipi, upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānātipi.
original: Katame dhammā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā? Aṭṭha lobhasahagatacittuppādā, etthuppanne upādāne ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā. Upādānavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā cātipi, upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with clinging but not clinging itself? The eight consciousnesses rooted in greed, excluding the clinging factors arising therein – these phenomena are associated with clinging but not clinging itself. Phenomena dissociated from clinging cannot be said to be both clinging and associated with clinging, nor associated with clinging but not clinging itself.

text: 1563. Katame dhammā upādānavippayuttā upādāniyā? Catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppanno lobho, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā upādānavippayuttā upādāniyā.
original: Katame dhammā upādānavippayuttā upādāniyā? Catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppanno lobho, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā upādānavippayuttā upādāniyā.
ai: Which phenomena are dissociated from clinging but are objects of clinging? The greed arising in the four consciousnesses rooted in greed dissociated from wrong view, the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure, the consciousness accompanied by doubt, the consciousness accompanied by restlessness, wholesome states in the three planes, resultant states in the three planes, functional states in the three planes, and all material phenomena – these phenomena are dissociated from clinging but are objects of clinging.

text: 1564. Katame dhammā upādānavippayuttā anupādāniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā upādānavippayuttā anupādāniyā. Upādānasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – upādānavippayuttā upādāniyātipi, upādānavippayuttā anupādāniyātipi.
original: Katame dhammā upādānavippayuttā anupādāniyā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā upādānavippayuttā anupādāniyā. Upādānasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – upādānavippayuttā upādāniyātipi, upādānavippayuttā anupādāniyātipi.
ai: Which phenomena are dissociated from clinging and are not objects of clinging? The four supramundane paths, the four supramundane fruits, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are dissociated from clinging and are not objects of clinging. Phenomena associated with clinging cannot be said to be dissociated from clinging but objects of clinging, nor dissociated from clinging and not objects of clinging.

text: Kilesagocchakaṃ
original: Kilesagocchakaṃ
ai: The Section on Defilements

text: 1565. Katame dhammā kilesā? Dasa kilesavatthūni – lobho, doso, moho, māno, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thinaṃ, uddhaccaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ. Lobho aṭṭhasu lobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Doso dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Moho sabbākusalesu uppajjati. Māno catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Diṭṭhi catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Vicikicchā vicikicchāsahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Thinaṃ sasaṅkhārikesu akusalesu uppajjati. Uddhaccañca ahirikañca anottappañca sabbākusalesu uppajjanti – ime dhammā kilesā.
original: Katame dhammā kilesā? Dasa kilesavatthūni – lobho, doso, moho, māno, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thinaṃ, uddhaccaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ. Lobho aṭṭhasu lobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Doso dvīsu domanassasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Moho sabbākusalesu uppajjati. Māno catūsu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Diṭṭhi catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Vicikicchā vicikicchāsahagatesu cittuppādesu uppajjati. Thinaṃ sasaṅkhārikesu akusalesu uppajjati. Uddhaccañca ahirikañca anottappañca sabbākusalesu uppajjanti – ime dhammā kilesā.
ai: What are defilements? The ten bases of defilements: greed, hatred, delusion, conceit, wrong view, doubt, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness, fearlessness of wrongdoing. Greed arises in the eight consciousnesses accompanied by greed. Hatred arises in the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure. Delusion arises in all unwholesome states. Conceit arises in the four consciousnesses accompanied by greed, dissociated from wrong view. Wrong view arises in the four consciousnesses associated with wrong view. Doubt arises in the consciousness accompanied by doubt. Sloth arises in prompted unwholesome states. Restlessness, shamelessness, and fearlessness of wrongdoing arise in all unwholesome states. These states are defilements.

text: 1566. Katame dhammā no kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no kilesā.
original: Katame dhammā no kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā no kilesā.
ai: What are not defilements? Excluding defilements, the remaining unwholesome states, wholesome states in the four planes, resultant states in the four planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, matter, and Nibbāna. These states are not defilements.

text: 1567. Katame dhammā saṃkilesikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā saṃkilesikā.
original: Katame dhammā saṃkilesikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā saṃkilesikā.
ai: What are defiling things? Wholesome states in the three planes, unwholesome states, resultant states in the three planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, and all matter. These states are defiling.

text: 1568. Katame dhammā asaṃkilesikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā asaṃkilesikā.
original: Katame dhammā asaṃkilesikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā asaṃkilesikā.
ai: What are non-defiling things? The four supramundane paths, the four fruition states, and Nibbāna. These states are non-defiling.

text: 1569. Katame dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā.
original: Katame dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā.
ai: What are defiled things? The twelve unwholesome consciousnesses. These states are defiled.

text: 1570. Katame dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhā.
original: Katame dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhā.
ai: What are undefiled things? Wholesome states in the four planes, resultant states in the four planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, matter, and Nibbāna. These states are undefiled.

text: 1571. Katame dhammā kilesasampayuttā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā kilesasampayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā kilesasampayuttā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā kilesasampayuttā.
ai: What are associated with defilements? The twelve unwholesome consciousnesses. These states are associated with defilements.

text: 1572. Katame dhammā kilesavippayuttā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā kilesavippayuttā.
original: Katame dhammā kilesavippayuttā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā kilesavippayuttā.
ai: What are dissociated from defilements? Wholesome states in the four planes, resultant states in the four planes, functional indeterminate states in the three planes, matter, and Nibbāna. These states are dissociated from defilements.

text: 1573. Katame dhammā kilesā ceva saṃkilesikā ca? Teva kilesā kilesā ceva saṃkilesikā ca.
original: Katame dhammā kilesā ceva saṃkilesikā ca? Teva kilesā kilesā ceva saṃkilesikā ca.
ai: What are defilements and defiling? The defilements themselves are defilements and defiling.

text: 1574. Katame dhammā saṃkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā saṃkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā. Asaṃkilesikā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesā ceva saṃkilesikā cātipi, saṃkilesikā ceva no ca kilesātipi.
original: Katame dhammā saṃkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā saṃkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā. Asaṃkilesikā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesā ceva saṃkilesikā cātipi, saṃkilesikā ceva no ca kilesātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are defiling but not defilements? All unwholesome states except the defilements; wholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate states in the three planes; and all material phenomena. These dhammas are defiling but not defilements. Undefiling dhammas are not to be called defilements and defiling, nor defiling but not defilements.

text: 1575. Katame dhammā kilesā ceva saṃkiliṭṭhā ca? Teva kilesā kilesā ceva saṃkiliṭṭhā ca.
original: Katame dhammā kilesā ceva saṃkiliṭṭhā ca? Teva kilesā kilesā ceva saṃkiliṭṭhā ca.
ai: Which dhammas are defilements and defiled? The defilements themselves are defilements and defiled.

text: 1576. Katame dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā . Asaṃkiliṭṭhā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesā ceva saṃkiliṭṭhā cātipi, saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesātipi.
original: Katame dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā . Asaṃkiliṭṭhā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesā ceva saṃkiliṭṭhā cātipi, saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are defiled but not defilements? All unwholesome states except the defilements. These dhammas are defiled but not defilements. Undefiled dhammas are not to be called defilements and defiled, nor defiled but not defilements.

text: 1577. Katame dhammā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā ca? Yattha dve tayo kilesā ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā ca.
original: Katame dhammā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā ca? Yattha dve tayo kilesā ekato uppajjanti – ime dhammā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā ca.
ai: Which dhammas are defilements and associated with defilements? Where two or three defilements arise together. These dhammas are defilements and associated with defilements.

text: 1578. Katame dhammā kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā. Kilesavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā cātipi, kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesātipi.
original: Katame dhammā kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā? Ṭhapetvā kilese avasesaṃ akusalaṃ – ime dhammā kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā. Kilesavippayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā cātipi, kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are associated with defilements but not defilements? All unwholesome states except the defilements. These dhammas are associated with defilements but not defilements. Dhammas dissociated from defilements are not to be called defilements and associated with defilements, nor associated with defilements but not defilements.

text: 1579. Katame dhammā kilesavippayuttā saṃkilesikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā kilesavippayuttā saṃkilesikā.
original: Katame dhammā kilesavippayuttā saṃkilesikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā kilesavippayuttā saṃkilesikā.
ai: Which dhammas are dissociated from defilements but defiling? Wholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate states in the three planes; and all material phenomena. These dhammas are dissociated from defilements but defiling.

text: 1580. Katame dhammā kilesavippayuttā asaṃkilesikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā , cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā kilesavippayuttā asaṃkilesikā. Kilesasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesavippayuttā saṃkilesikātipi, kilesavippayuttā asaṃkilesikātipi.
original: Katame dhammā kilesavippayuttā asaṃkilesikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā , cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā kilesavippayuttā asaṃkilesikā. Kilesasampayuttā dhammā na vattabbā – kilesavippayuttā saṃkilesikātipi, kilesavippayuttā asaṃkilesikātipi.
ai: Which dhammas are dissociated from defilements and undefiling? The four supramundane paths, the four fruits of recluseship, and Nibbana. These dhammas are dissociated from defilements and undefiling. Dhammas associated with defilements are not to be called dissociated from defilements and defiling, nor dissociated from defilements and undefiling.

text: Piṭṭhidukaṃ
original: Piṭṭhidukaṃ
ai: The Pair of Eradication

text: 1581. Katame dhammā dassanena pahātabbā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo – ime dhammā dassanena pahātabbā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā dassanena pahātabbā, siyā na dassanena pahātabbā.
original: Katame dhammā dassanena pahātabbā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo – ime dhammā dassanena pahātabbā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā dassanena pahātabbā, siyā na dassanena pahātabbā.
ai: Which dhammas are to be abandoned by seeing? The four mind-moments associated with wrong view, and the mind-moment accompanied by doubt. These dhammas are to be abandoned by seeing. The four mind-moments accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and the two mind-moments accompanied by displeasure. These dhammas may or may not be abandoned by seeing.

text: 1582. Katame dhammā na dassanena pahātabbā? Uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na dassanena pahātabbā.
original: Katame dhammā na dassanena pahātabbā? Uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na dassanena pahātabbā.
ai: Which dhammas are not to be abandoned by seeing? The mind-moment accompanied by restlessness; wholesome states in the four planes; resultant states in the four planes; functional indeterminate states in the three planes; material phenomena; and Nibbana. These dhammas are not to be abandoned by seeing.

text: 1583. Katame dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbā? Uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo – ime dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbā, siyā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
original: Katame dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbā? Uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo – ime dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbā, siyā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
ai: Which phenomena are to be abandoned by development? The mind-state accompanied by restlessness – these phenomena are to be abandoned by development. The four mind-states accompanied by greed disconnected from wrong view, and the two mind-states accompanied by displeasure – these phenomena are sometimes to be abandoned by development, sometimes not to be abandoned by development.

text: 1584. Katame dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
original: Katame dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
ai: Which phenomena are not to be abandoned by development? The four mind-states accompanied by wrong view, the mind-state accompanied by doubt, wholesome consciousness in the four planes, resultant consciousness in the four planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, materiality, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not to be abandoned by development.

text: 1585. Katame dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, etthuppannaṃ mohaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukā, siyā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā.
original: Katame dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, etthuppannaṃ mohaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā dassanena pahātabbahetukā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukā, siyā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā.
ai: Which phenomena have causes to be abandoned by insight? The four mind-states accompanied by wrong view, the mind-state accompanied by doubt, excluding the delusion arising in them – these phenomena have causes to be abandoned by insight. The four mind-states accompanied by greed disconnected from wrong view, and the two mind-states accompanied by displeasure – these phenomena are sometimes having causes to be abandoned by insight, sometimes not having causes to be abandoned by insight.

text: 1586. Katame dhammā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā? Vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā.
original: Katame dhammā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā? Vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā.
ai: Which phenomena do not have causes to be abandoned by insight? The delusion accompanied by doubt, the mind-state accompanied by restlessness, wholesome consciousness in the four planes, resultant consciousness in the four planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, materiality, and Nibbāna – these phenomena do not have causes to be abandoned by insight.

text: 1587. Katame dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā? Uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, etthuppannaṃ mohaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā, siyā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
original: Katame dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā? Uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, etthuppannaṃ mohaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā. Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā, siyā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
ai: Which phenomena have causes to be abandoned by development? The mind-state accompanied by restlessness, excluding the delusion arising in it – these phenomena have causes to be abandoned by development. The four mind-states accompanied by greed disconnected from wrong view, and the two mind-states accompanied by displeasure – these phenomena are sometimes having causes to be abandoned by development, sometimes not having causes to be abandoned by development.

text: 1588. Katame dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato moho, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
original: Katame dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato moho, catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
ai: Which phenomena do not have causes to be abandoned by development? The four mind-states accompanied by wrong view, the mind-state accompanied by doubt, the delusion accompanied by restlessness, wholesome consciousness in the four planes, resultant consciousness in the four planes, functional consciousness in the three planes, materiality, and Nibbāna – these phenomena do not have causes to be abandoned by development.

text: 1589. Katame dhammā savitakkā? Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato dve, kiriyato ekādasa, rūpāvacaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca lokuttaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ vitakkaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā savitakkā.
original: Katame dhammā savitakkā? Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato dve, kiriyato ekādasa, rūpāvacaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca lokuttaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ vitakkaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā savitakkā.
ai: Which phenomena are accompanied by initial application? Wholesome sense-sphere consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, eleven resultant consciousnesses of wholesome sense-sphere kamma, two resultant consciousnesses of unwholesome kamma, eleven functional consciousnesses, the first fine-material jhāna (wholesome, resultant, and functional), and the first supramundane jhāna (wholesome and resultant), excluding the initial application itself arising in them – these phenomena are accompanied by initial application.

text: 1590. Katame dhammā avitakkā? Dvepañcaviññāṇāni, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro arūpāvacarā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, vitakko ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā avitakkā.
original: Katame dhammā avitakkā? Dvepañcaviññāṇāni, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro arūpāvacarā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, vitakko ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā avitakkā.
ai: Which phenomena are not accompanied by initial application? The ten five-sense consciousnesses, the third and fourth fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional), the four immaterial-sphere consciousnesses (wholesome, resultant, and functional), the third and fourth supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant), initial application itself, materiality, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not accompanied by initial application.

text: 1591. Katame dhammā savicārā? Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ , akusalaṃ, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato dve kiriyato ekādasa, rūpāvacaraekakadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraekakadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ vicāraṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā savicārā.
original: Katame dhammā savicārā? Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ , akusalaṃ, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato dve kiriyato ekādasa, rūpāvacaraekakadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraekakadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ vicāraṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā savicārā.
ai: Which phenomena are accompanied by sustained application? Wholesome sense-sphere consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, eleven resultant consciousnesses of wholesome sense-sphere kamma, two resultant consciousnesses of unwholesome kamma, eleven functional consciousnesses, the first and second fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional), and the first and second supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant), excluding the sustained application itself arising in them – these phenomena are accompanied by sustained application.

text: 1592. Katame dhammā avicārā? Dvepañcaviññāṇāni, rūpāvacaratikatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, vicāro ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā avicārā.
original: Katame dhammā avicārā? Dvepañcaviññāṇāni, rūpāvacaratikatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, vicāro ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā avicārā.
ai: Which phenomena are not accompanied by sustained application? The ten five-sense consciousnesses, the third and fourth fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional), the four immaterial-sphere consciousnesses (wholesome, resultant, and functional), the third and fourth supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant), sustained application itself, materiality, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not accompanied by sustained application.

text: 1593. Katame dhammā sappītikā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato pañca, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ pītiṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā sappītikā.
original: Katame dhammā sappītikā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato pañca, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ pītiṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā sappītikā.
ai: Which phenomena are accompanied by rapture? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by joy, four unwholesome consciousnesses, five resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, five functional consciousnesses, the second and third fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the second and third supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant types), excluding rapture itself that arises therein – these phenomena are accompanied by rapture.

text: 1594. Katame dhammā appītikā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato aṭṭha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa, akusalassa vipākato satta, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca pīti ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā appītikā.
original: Katame dhammā appītikā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato aṭṭha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa, akusalassa vipākato satta, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca pīti ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā appītikā.
ai: Which phenomena are not accompanied by rapture? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by equanimity, eight unwholesome consciousnesses, eleven resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, seven resultant unwholesome consciousnesses, six functional consciousnesses, the fourth fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the four immaterial consciousnesses (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the fourth supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant types), rapture itself, all material phenomena, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not accompanied by rapture.

text: 1595. Katame dhammā pītisahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato pañca, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ pītiṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā pītisahagatā.
original: Katame dhammā pītisahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato pañca, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ pītiṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā pītisahagatā.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with rapture? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by joy, four unwholesome consciousnesses, five resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, five functional consciousnesses, the second and third fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the second and third supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant types), excluding rapture itself that arises therein – these phenomena are associated with rapture.

text: 1596. Katame dhammā na pītisahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato aṭṭha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa, akusalassa vipākato satta, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, pīti ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na pītisahagatā.
original: Katame dhammā na pītisahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato aṭṭha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa, akusalassa vipākato satta, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukadukajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, pīti ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na pītisahagatā.
ai: Which phenomena are not associated with rapture? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by equanimity, eight unwholesome consciousnesses, eleven resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, seven resultant unwholesome consciousnesses, six functional consciousnesses, the fourth fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the four immaterial consciousnesses (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the fourth supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant types), rapture itself, all material phenomena, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not associated with rapture.

text: 1597. Katame dhammā sukhasahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ sukhaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā sukhasahagatā.
original: Katame dhammā sukhasahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ sukhaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā sukhasahagatā.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with happiness? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by joy, four unwholesome consciousnesses, six resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, five functional consciousnesses, the third and fourth fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the third and fourth supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant types), excluding happiness itself that arises therein – these phenomena are associated with happiness.

text: 1598. Katame dhammā na sukhasahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato aṭṭha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato satta, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, sukhañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na sukhasahagatā.
original: Katame dhammā na sukhasahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato aṭṭha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato satta, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, sukhañca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na sukhasahagatā.
ai: Which phenomena are not associated with happiness? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by equanimity, eight unwholesome consciousnesses, ten resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, seven resultant unwholesome consciousnesses, six functional consciousnesses, the fourth fine-material jhāna (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the four immaterial consciousnesses (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the fourth supramundane jhāna (wholesome and resultant types), happiness itself, all material phenomena, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not associated with happiness.

text: 1599. Katame dhammā upekkhāsahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato cha , rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ upekkhaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā upekkhāsahagatā.
original: Katame dhammā upekkhāsahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato cha , rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ upekkhaṃ ṭhapetvā – ime dhammā upekkhāsahagatā.
ai: Which phenomena are associated with equanimity? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by equanimity, six unwholesome consciousnesses, ten resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, six resultant unwholesome consciousnesses, six functional consciousnesses, the fourth fine-material jhāna (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the four immaterial consciousnesses (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the fourth supramundane jhāna (wholesome and resultant types), excluding equanimity itself that arises therein – these phenomena are associated with equanimity.

text: 1600. Katame dhammā na upekkhāsahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato cha, akusalassa vipākato eko, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, upekkhā ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na upekkhāsahagatā.
original: Katame dhammā na upekkhāsahagatā? Kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato cha, akusalassa vipākato eko, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, upekkhā ca, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā na upekkhāsahagatā.
ai: Which phenomena are not associated with equanimity? Four sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses accompanied by joy, six unwholesome consciousnesses, six resultant sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, one resultant unwholesome consciousness, five functional consciousnesses, the third and fourth fine-material jhānas (wholesome, resultant, and functional types), the third and fourth supramundane jhānas (wholesome and resultant types), equanimity itself, all material phenomena, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are not associated with equanimity.

text: 1601. Katame dhammā kāmāvacarā? Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, sabbo kāmāvacarassa vipāko, kāmāvacarakiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā kāmāvacarā.
original: Katame dhammā kāmāvacarā? Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, sabbo kāmāvacarassa vipāko, kāmāvacarakiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā kāmāvacarā.
ai: Which phenomena belong to the sense-sphere? All sense-sphere wholesome consciousnesses, all unwholesome consciousnesses, all resultant sense-sphere consciousnesses, all functional sense-sphere consciousnesses, and all material phenomena – these phenomena belong to the sense-sphere.

text: 1602. Katame dhammā na kāmāvacarā? Rūpāvacarā , arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na kāmāvacarā.
original: Katame dhammā na kāmāvacarā? Rūpāvacarā , arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na kāmāvacarā.
ai: Which phenomena do not belong to the sense-sphere? All fine-material sphere phenomena, all immaterial sphere phenomena, and all unincluded phenomena – these phenomena do not belong to the sense-sphere.

text: 1603. Katame dhammā rūpāvacarā? Rūpāvacaracatukkapañcakajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca – ime dhammā rūpāvacarā.
original: Katame dhammā rūpāvacarā? Rūpāvacaracatukkapañcakajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca – ime dhammā rūpāvacarā.
ai: Which phenomena are fine-material sphere? The fourfold and fivefold fine-material absorptions, whether wholesome, resultant, or functional – these phenomena are fine-material sphere.

text: 1604. Katame dhammā na rūpāvacarā? Kāmāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na rūpāvacarā.
original: Katame dhammā na rūpāvacarā? Kāmāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na rūpāvacarā.
ai: Which phenomena are not fine-material sphere? Sense-sphere, immaterial-sphere, and unincluded phenomena – these phenomena are not fine-material sphere.

text: 1605. Katame dhammā arūpāvacarā? Cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca – ime dhammā arūpāvacarā.
original: Katame dhammā arūpāvacarā? Cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca – ime dhammā arūpāvacarā.
ai: Which phenomena are immaterial sphere? The four immaterial attainments, whether wholesome, resultant, or functional – these phenomena are immaterial sphere.

text: 1606. Katame dhammā na arūpāvacarā? Kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na arūpāvacarā.
