original: Katame dhammā na arūpāvacarā? Kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na arūpāvacarā.
ai: Which phenomena are not immaterial sphere? Sense-sphere, fine-material sphere, and unincluded phenomena – these phenomena are not immaterial sphere.

text: 1607. Katame dhammā pariyāpannā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā pariyāpannā.
original: Katame dhammā pariyāpannā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā pariyāpannā.
ai: Which phenomena are included? Wholesome, unwholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, and all matter – these phenomena are included.

text: 1608. Katame dhammā apariyāpannā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā apariyāpannā.
original: Katame dhammā apariyāpannā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā apariyāpannā.
ai: Which phenomena are unincluded? The four transcendent paths, the four transcendent fruits, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are unincluded.

text: 1609. Katame dhammā niyyānikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyyānikā.
original: Katame dhammā niyyānikā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyyānikā.
ai: Which phenomena lead to liberation? The four transcendent paths – these phenomena lead to liberation.

text: 1610. Katame dhammā aniyyānikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā aniyyānikā.
original: Katame dhammā aniyyānikā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā aniyyānikā.
ai: Which phenomena do not lead to liberation? Wholesome and unwholesome phenomena in the three planes, resultant phenomena in the four planes, functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena do not lead to liberation.

text: 1611. Katame dhammā niyatā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā niyatā siyā aniyatā. Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyatā.
original: Katame dhammā niyatā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā – ime dhammā siyā niyatā siyā aniyatā. Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā – ime dhammā niyatā.
ai: Which phenomena are fixed? The four consciousnesses associated with wrong view and the two consciousnesses accompanied by displeasure – these phenomena are sometimes fixed, sometimes unfixed. The four transcendent paths – these phenomena are fixed.

text: 1612. Katame dhammā aniyatā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā aniyatā.
original: Katame dhammā aniyatā? Cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā aniyatā.
ai: Which phenomena are unfixed? The four consciousnesses rooted in greed dissociated from wrong view, the consciousness accompanied by doubt, the consciousness accompanied by restlessness, wholesome phenomena in the three planes, resultant phenomena in the four planes, functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, matter, and Nibbāna – these phenomena are unfixed.

text: 1613. Katame dhammā sauttarā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā sauttarā.
original: Katame dhammā sauttarā? Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, sabbañca rūpaṃ – ime dhammā sauttarā.
ai:
Which phenomena are with superior? Wholesome, unwholesome, resultant, and functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, and all matter 
– these phenomena are with superior.

text: 1614. Katame dhammā anuttarā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anuttarā.
original: Katame dhammā anuttarā? Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca – ime dhammā anuttarā.
ai:
Which phenomena are without superior? The four supramundane paths, the four fruitions of recluseship, and Nibbāna 
– these phenomena are without superior.

text: 1615. Katame dhammā saraṇā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā saraṇā.
original: Katame dhammā saraṇā? Dvādasa akusalacittuppādā – ime dhammā saraṇā.
ai:
Which phenomena are with refuge/defilement? The twelve unwholesome consciousness-arisings 
– these phenomena are with refuge/defilement.

text: 1616. Katame dhammā araṇā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā araṇā.
original: Katame dhammā araṇā? Catūsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catūsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyābyākataṃ, rūpañca, nibbānañca – ime dhammā araṇā.
ai:
Which phenomena are without refuge/defilement? Wholesome and resultant phenomena in the four planes, functional indeterminate phenomena in the three planes, matter, and Nibbāna 
– these phenomena are without refuge/defilement.

text: Atthuddhāro niṭṭhito.
original: Atthuddhāro niṭṭhito.
ai: The summary of meanings is concluded.

text: Dhammasaṅgaṇīpakaraṇaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ
original: Dhammasaṅgaṇīpakaraṇaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ
ai: The treatise Dhammasaṅgaṇī is concluded.
